items.description: About Life360 Life360’s mission is to keep people close to the ones they love. Our category-leading mobile app, Tile tracking devices, and Pet GPS tracker empower members to protect the people, pets, and things they care about most with a range of services, including location sharing, safe driver reports, and crash detection with emergency dispatch. Life360 serves approximately 107.7 million monthly active users (MAU), as of September 30, 2026, across more than 180 countries. Life360 delivers peace of mind and enhances everyday family life with seamless coordination for all the moments that matter, big and small. By continuing to innovate and deliver for our customers, we have become a household name and the must-have mobile-based membership for families (and those friends who are basically family). Life360 has more than 500 (and growing!) remote-first employees. For more information, please visit life360.com . Life360 is a Remote First company, which means a remote work environment will be the primary experience for all employees. All positions, unless otherwise specified, can be performed remotely (within the US and Canada) regardless of any specified location above. We are AI Native We are building an AI native company where AI is an integral part of how we build and operate. AI tool usage during interviews varies by role. You may be asked to demonstrate proficiency with AI tools, discuss how you leverage AI, or complete interview exercises without AI assistance. Your Recruiter will provide clear guidance as you move through the interview process. Undisclosed use of AI not previously discussed with or approved by your Recruiter may impact your candidacy. About The Team The Ads Data Engineering team's purpose is to design, build, and maintain scalable and efficient data infrastructure that empowers Life360 teams to make data-driven decisions. We transform raw data into reliable, accessible, and actionable insights, ensuring data quality, compliance, security, costs and performance at every step. We help teams across the business unlock the full potential of their data, driving operational excellence and strategic growth. We also push the boundaries of how work gets done by adopting AI tools that accelerate our development and expand what we can deliver to stakeholders, so families get faster, more reliable experiences. About the Job At Life360, we collect an enormous amount of data: billions of location points, user actions, and miles driven every month, and so much more. Our analysts, ad strategists, and sales team rely on that data to run campaigns, report performance, and close deals. The core datasets and pipelines behind that work are built and in production, and the demand for new datasets, metrics, and self-serve access is growing. As a Senior Ads Data Engineer, you will own that platform on Databricks: making the existing pipelines faster, cheaper, and more reliable, and extending them as new questions come in. You will work directly with the people who use the data, and you will keep one agreed definition for each core metric so every team sees the same numbers. For candidates based in the US, the salary range for this position is $129,000 to $192,000 USD. For candidates based out of Canada, the salary range for this position is $149,500 to $177,500 CAD. Note: Please be aware that the job title for positions in Canada will be "Developer" in lieu of "Engineer." We take into consideration an individual's background, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience in determining final salary. Base pay may also vary based on geographic location, with US work locations falling into one of three geographic tiers. Total compensation is inclusive of equity compensation in the form of Restricted Stock Units (RSUs) , as well as a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, vision, financial, and other benefits. What You’ll Do Primary responsibilities include, but are not limited to: Enhance, extend, and operate our existing batch and streaming pipelines and Delta Lake tables on Databricks, evolving the platform across ingestion, orchestration, storage, and serving as data volume and business needs grow. Partner with business analysts, ad strategists, and the sales team to understand their questions and turn them into durable data and insights products, such as campaign performance, audience, and revenue reporting. Build and maintain dbt models and tests for curated Silver/Gold datasets, and own the semantic layer and core business metrics so every team works from a single, trusted definition of performance. Manage Databricks and AWS infrastructure as code with Terraform. Integrate and reconcile data from ad platforms, CRM, partner feeds, and internal systems, including migrations off legacy tools and reports. Implement data quality tests, monitoring, lineage, SLAs, and alerting, and define data contracts with upstream producers, leading root-cause analysis when data breaks. Tune Spark and Databricks workloads for performance and cost (query plans, partitioning, shuffle and skew, cluster sizing), and make cost-aware design decisions as the platform grows. Establish engineering best practices (version control, CI/CD, code review, testing, documentation), and mentor engineers and help shape the team’s technical roadmap. Apply data governance, privacy, and access controls (PII, GDPR, CCPA, SOX) across the platform. Enhance our LLM development support capabilities by creating tools, skills, and agents that give our LLMs more context and help us debug, build, and maintain systems faster. Success in Year One Within the first year, the person hired will be the go-to engineer for our foundational data models and pipelines. Pipeline runtime and compute spend will be measurably lower, and the datasets and metrics that analysts, ad strategists, and sales use will have clear owners and documented definitions. Stakeholders will answer more of their own questions without waiting on the data team, and the first set of enhancements they asked for will be in production. What We’re Looking For 5+ years of experience in data engineering building production data platforms at enterprise scale, with demonstrated ownership of data products and cross-functional collaboration. Deep, hands-on expertise with Apache Spark (PySpark and/or Scala), including partitioning and shuffle behavior, joins, skew handling, caching, and diagnosing and tuning slow or costly jobs. Deep knowledge of the Databricks platform, including Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, Jobs/Workflows, Databricks Asset Bundles, Structured Streaming, and SQL Warehouses, with proven experience optimizing workloads for performance and cost (cluster and warehouse sizing, autoscaling, Photon, serverless). Strong SQL and Python (or Scala) skills for pipeline development, automation, and query optimization. Hands-on production experience with dbt, including model design, testing, documentation, and incremental strategies, running on Databricks in CI/CD-driven workflows. Hands-on experience with Terraform for managing cloud and data platform infrastructure as code, and with AWS (S3, IAM, and networking fundamentals as they relate to data platforms). Strong experience with orchestration frameworks (Airflow, Databricks Workflows, or similar), Git, and CI/CD, and with building reliable, observable pipelines. Solid understanding of data modeling (dimensional modeling, star schemas, medallion architecture) and experience building semantic layers or metric definitions. Experience inheriting, refactoring, and improving existing data models and pipelines, with an eye toward reliability, maintainability, and backward compatibility for downstream consumers. Experience using AI/LLM coding assistants (for example, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, or Claude Code), with a disciplined approach to reviewing, testing, and owning generated code rather than accepting it at face value. Strong business acumen and excellent communication skills, with the ability to translate requirements from analysts, ad strategists, and sales teams into well-designed data products and explain technical concepts to non-technical audiences. Familiarity with data governance and compliance requirements (GDPR, CCPA, SOX) and with BI tools (Domo, Tableau, Looker, or similar). Prior experience with advertising, ad tech, or media data (campaign delivery, attribution, audience, or revenue reporting) is preferred. Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field. AI-Native Expectations The Ads Data Engineering team leverages LLMs to support code generation, analysis, and other use cases. Your experience with AI / LLM usage should include managing code generation with a close eye on quality, standards, and testing, while owning the outputs as your own. Your work with and ability to leverage these tools (Claude, Cursor, Copilot) will drive your velocity and ability to effectively work within our environment. We use AI coding tools as a professional standard on this team. In practice: Daily use — You use AI coding assistants for real, substantive tasks: analysis, coding, refactoring, testing, navigating codebases, and documentation, not just research or autocomplete. Judgment and ownership — AI-generated code gets the same review you'd give any PR. You are accountable for everything you ship. Velocity — We expect senior engineers who use AI well to operate with meaningful leverage, taking on problems that would otherwise require a larger team. Team leadership — You share what works, automate prompting strategies others can build on, and help teammates earlier in their AI workflow adoption get up to speed. Continuous learning — The tooling changes fast. You stay current and bring recommendations to the team when something would meaningfully improve how we work. Our Benefits Medical, dental, vision, life and disability insurance plans (100% paid for US employees). We offer life and disability as well as supplemental plans for medical and dental for Canadian employees. 401(k) plan with company matching program in the US and RRSP with DPSP plan for Canadian employees. Paid parental leave. Mental Wellness Program & Employee Assistance Program (EAP) for mental well-being. Generous time off: flexible PTO, companywide holidays throughout the year plus summer and winter shutdowns. Learning & Development programs. Equipment, tools, and reimbursement support for a productive remote environment. Free Life360 Platinum Membership and Tile trackers. AI Usage: We use AI to help make our hiring process efficient. That said, every hiring decision is made by real Life360 hiring teams Life360 Values Our company’s mission-driven culture is guided by our shared values to create a trusted work environment where you can bring your authentic self to work and make a positive difference Be a Good Person - We have a team of high integrity people you can trust. Be Direct With Respect - We communicate directly, even when it’s hard. Members Before Metrics - We focus on building an exceptional experience for families. High Intensity, High Impact - We do whatever it takes to get the job done. Our Commitment to Belonging Life360 is an equal opportunity employer. We don’t discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status, or any other legally protected status. We believe diverse perspectives make us better, and we’re building a workplace that reflects the communities we serve. Don’t meet every qualification? Apply anyway. #LI-Remote ____________________________________________________________________________

items.description: Our Mission: 6sense 's mission is to multiply what matters: growth, retention, and efficiency. We envision a future where companies, teams and people reach their full potential. Our People: People are the heart and soul of 6sense. We serve with passion and purpose. We live by our Being 6sense values of Win as One Team, Stay Curious, Do The Right Thing, Own the Outcome, and Create Belonging. Every 6sensor plays a part in deﬁning the future of our industry-leading technology. 6sense is a place where difference-makers roll up their sleeves, take risks, act with integrity, and measure success by the value we create for our customers. We want 6sense to be the best chapter of your career. Data Scientist, Forward Deployed (Impact & Analytics) Forward Deployed Engineering · Predictive track TEAM Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE), Predictive track, in Data Science & AI Engineering REPORTS TO Director of Data Science LEVEL Sr. (5+ years) — measures engagement impact and works on customer models LOCATION United States About 6sense Our mission. 6sense's mission is to multiply what matters: growth, retention, and efficiency. We envision a future where companies, teams and people reach their full potential. Our people. People are the heart and soul of 6sense. We serve with passion and purpose. We live by our Being 6sense values of Win as One Team, Stay Curious, Do The Right Thing, Own the Outcome, and Create Belonging. Every 6sensor plays a part in defining the future of our industry-leading technology. 6sense is a place where difference-makers roll up their sleeves, take risks, act with integrity, and measure success by the value we create for our customers. We want 6sense to be the best chapter of your career. 6sense is Intelligence for Agentic GTM. We turn every signal — yours and ours — into intelligence that every team, tool, and AI agent can act on and trust. Every day, the 6sense Signalverse™ captures one trillion signals to power AI that pinpoints who's ready to buy, how to engage them, and when to act. 6sense was named a Leader in The Forrester Wave™: Revenue Marketing Platforms for B2B, Q1 2026. THE ROLE IN ONE PARAGRAPH We're hiring a Sr. Data Scientist to show the impact our work has for customers. You'll measure how each engagement moves customers' pipeline and renewals, build the value analysis customers and leadership rely on, and work hands-on with the senior data scientists on customer models. This role sits where analytics meets modeling. It suits someone who wants to see the business outcome of their work and grow into a forward-deployed data scientist. What You'll Do Build for the customer Set a baseline for every engagement before work starts, then track the results: account health, renewal outcome, and how predictive scores perform for the customer's sales team. Measure how scored accounts perform against unscored ones: close rate, sales cycle length and deal size. Assess the impact of model and configuration changes on model performance, qualified-account volume and pipeline timing. Run before-and-after and holdout-style analyses that separate a change's real effect from noise. Work on live engagements with the senior data scientists: validate account lists, compare a customer's CRM fields with 6sense firmographic data, and help tailor and tune models. Productize for everyone Build value analysis Data Science can run for any customer on demand, such as qualified-account efficiency, deal journeys and conversion by score bucket. Build the dashboards and reporting the team, Customer Success and leadership use to follow engagement outcomes. What You'll Bring Required: 5+ years in data science or advanced analytics, with experience building models and measuring business outcomes. Strong SQL and Python, and experience turning messy data into analysis people trust, including matching records across systems by ID. Solid grounding in statistics and experiment design: baselines, control groups, and knowing when a difference is real. Experience building dashboards or reporting for business stakeholders. Clear communicator who can explain what the numbers mean, and what they don't. Comfortable switching between several projects at once. Nice to have: B2B go-to-market or SaaS customer data (CRM, renewals, pipeline, customer health); a customer-facing, consulting or analytics-for-clients role; BI tools such as Tableau; data platforms such as SingleStore, Snowflake or Hive. What Success Looks Like In 3 months: every active engagement has a documented baseline and an agreed success measure. In 6 months: leadership reviews engagement results from reporting you built, and you've contributed to at least one customer model. In 12 months: the team can show the business value of its work across all engagements, and you're leading data science work on engagements of your own. Why this role is different: you see the business outcome of the work directly, and you're the one who shows customers and leadership what it's worth. It's also a direct path into forward-deployed data science. Base Salary Range: $168,349.50 - $230,912.60. The base salary range represents the anticipated low and high end of the base salary range for this position. Actual salaries may vary and may be above or below the range based on various factors, including but not limited to work location and experience. The base salary is one component of 6sense’s total compensation package for this position. Other compensation may include a bonus program or commission plan, and stock options if approved by 6sense’s board. In addition, 6sense provides a variety of benefits, including generous health insurance coverage, life, and disability insurance, a 401K employer matching program, paid holidays, self-care days, and paid time off (PTO). #Li-remote Notice of Collection and Use of Personal Information for California Residents: California Recruitment Privacy Notice and Policy Our Benefits: Full-time employees can take advantage of health coverage, paid parental leave, generous paid time-off and holidays, quarterly self-care days off, and stock options. We’ll make sure you have the equipment and support you need to work and connect with your teams, at home or in one of our oﬃces. We have a growth mindset culture that is represented in all that we do, from onboarding through to numerous learning and development initiatives including access to our LinkedIn Learning platform. Employee well-being is also top of mind for us. We host quarterly wellness education sessions to encourage self care and personal growth. From wellness days to ERG-hosted events, we celebrate and energize all 6sense employees and their backgrounds. Equal Opportunity Employer: 6sense is an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employers. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, or disability status. If you require reasonable accommodation in completing this application, interviewing, completing any pre-employment testing, or otherwise participating in the employee selection process, please direct your inquiries to jobs@6sense.com . We are aware of recruiting impersonation attempts that are not affiliated with 6sense in any way. All email communications from 6sense will originate from the @6sense.com domain. We will not initially contact you via text message and will never request payments. If you are uncertain whether you have been contacted by an official 6sense employee, reach out to jobs@6sense.com

items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: Philippines URL: https://jobs.workable.com/company/dcaVtKQqXr9FwBNppNCBH9/jobs-at-d2b Position: Senior Performance Marketing Manager Salary: PHP 80,000 to PHP 120,000/monthly Working Hours & Conditions: Sydney, AU Business Hours and Holidays Employment: Full Time - Independent Contractor ABOUT THE COMPANY: The company is an integrated property and place marketing agency combining brand strategy, high-end creative, and performance-driven lead generation. Our client portfolio primarily consists of leading Australian property developers marketing off-the-plan residential communities, completed luxury stock, and premium commercial assets. We believe true marketing effectiveness requires total alignment across creative narrative, digital targeting, technical attribution, and sales enablement. ROLE OVERVIEW: We are seeking an autonomous, hands-on Senior Performance Marketing Manager to take full operational ownership of paid advertising across our client roster. In this role, you will steer paid media strategy and day-to-day execution across Meta Ads and Google Search, scaling an account base expected to expand to approximately seven multi-channel client accounts in early 2027. Operating alongside our senior strategy, video, and design directors, you will look beyond basic surface metrics to optimize the entire acquisition funnel. Your core mandate is turning paid traffic into qualified buyer enquiries, booked display suite appointments, and closed developer sales. RESPONSIBILITIES: Paid Media Execution & Management: Architect, launch, and optimize high-converting Meta Ads and Google Search campaigns. Manage budget pacing, audience segmentation, bid strategies, search queries, and negative keyword lists. Maintain meticulous account hygiene, access controls, billing protocols, naming conventions, and policy compliance. Creative Strategy & Iterative Testing: Translate high-level project personas, narrative angles, and visual hooks into rigorous creative testing frameworks. Set minimum spend thresholds, monitor fatigue indicators, and deliver structured briefs to internal design and video teams for iterations, variations, and net-new creative concepts. Tracking, Attribution & Offline Data: Set up, audit, and troubleshoot tracking architecture via GA4, Google Tag Manager (GTM), Meta Pixel, and Conversions API (CAPI). Integrate CRM data pipelines to enable closed-loop offline conversion tracking. Data Visualization & Client Reporting: Build and manage Looker Studio dashboards demonstrating true acquisition ROI, downstream appointment volume, and sales conversion rates. Deliver structured weekly written updates detailing performance drivers, strategic shifts, and upcoming optimizations. Conversion Rate Optimization & Funnel Operations: Audit full user journeys from click to qualification, proposing ongoing landing page enhancements. Execute technical SEO and Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) initiatives in coordination with senior leadership, including site speed fixes and email nurture workflows. AI Workflow Integration: Leverage AI tools across daily operations, data analysis, reporting synthesis, and rapid creative ideation. Develop and document standard operating procedures that leverage AI to increase throughput without compromising quality or strategic rigor. Agency & Account Scale: Minimum of 5 years of direct, hands-on performance marketing experience, with a proven track record managing multi-client portfolios within an agency setting. Channel Mastery: Deep, current technical proficiency in Meta Ads Manager and Google Ads (Search). Downstream Conversion Focus: Demonstrated history driving high-intent B2C or high-consideration lead generation, measuring success by sales outcomes rather than raw lead volume. Technical Infrastructure: Hands-on experience configuring GA4, GTM, Meta CAPI, offline conversion feeds, and custom Looker Studio dashboards. Attribution Acumen: Solid understanding of multi-touch attribution, channel mix modeling constraints, and cross-platform reporting discrepancies. AI Fluency: Active, daily integration of AI workflows into campaign development, copy iteration, or analytical operations. Communication & Cadence: Exceptional written and verbal communication skills; ability to produce executive-ready client summaries and precise creative briefs. Operational Alignment: Full availability to work aligned with Sydney, Australia (AEST/AEDT) business hours. Preferred Conversion Optimization: Practical expertise in landing page design principles, conversion rate optimization (CRO), and site speed auditing. Modern Search: Exposure to technical SEO execution and AI search optimization (AEO/GEO). Vertical Experience: Prior exposure to Australian real estate, specifically residential off-the-plan project marketing. Lifecycle Marketing: Hands-on automation experience configuring email qualification funnels in platforms such as Zoho or Brevo. What You’ll Bring Full-Funnel Ownership: A commercial mindset that views media spend as an investment engine tied directly to pipeline appointments and revenue. Analytical Independence: The confidence to diagnose sudden performance shifts, troubleshoot faulty tracking scripts, and proactively bring solutions rather than problems. Creative Curiosity: The ability to decipher why specific visual hooks work, bridging data analysis with sharp creative direction. Process Rigor: Strong personal project management, high attention to operational detail, and the discipline to maintain structured experiments across dynamic accounts. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/d2b-senior-performance-marketing-manager-dayshift-remote

items.description: About Carrot: Carrot is the leading global fertility and family care platform, built on intelligent care orchestration: the right clinical guidance, at the right moment, in the context of each member’s life. More than a thousand multinational employers, health plans, and health systems trust Carrot to support millions of members across 195 countries – from pre-pregnancy through menopause and major life moments in between. Carrot's comprehensive clinical program delivers industry-leading cost savings for plan sponsors and award-winning experiences and improved outcomes for millions of people worldwide. Carrot is widely regarded as a defining force in healthcare innovation as a recipient of several top-tier awards, including Fast Company's 'Most Innovative Companies' and CNBC's '100 Barrier Breaking Startups'. The company is regularly cited by leading global outlets — including The Economist, Bloomberg, The Wall Street Journal, NPR, ABC News, and Harvard Business Review — as a leading voice on digital health, the future of work, and family health. Learn more at get-carrot.com . The Opportunity 🚀 Carrot is seeking a Sr. Data Engineer to lead the evolution, reliability, and scalability of our modern data infrastructure across analytics, reporting, and business intelligence. In this role, you will architect, build, and maintain robust, automated data pipelines, orchestrate workflows, integrate diverse data sources, and partner with stakeholders across the business to deliver secure, compliant, high-quality data solutions. Your work will span the full data lifecycle, from architecting resilient ETL/ELT pipelines and developing real-time and batch data integrations to automating reporting, reducing technical debt, and enabling advanced analytics. Sr. Data Engineers at Carrot are operational stewards and technical mentors, driving improvements in system maturity, cost efficiency, automation, and collaborative practices. You will join our Data Engineering team, which develops and optimizes scalable data pipelines and cloud infrastructure to enable secure, automated reporting and analytics across Carrot. The team collaborates closely with Business Intelligence, Product, Finance, Legal, and Commercial partners to deliver reliable integrations and self-serve solutions that drive business insights and operational efficiency. What You’ll Own 💼 In this role, you will: Architect, build, test, deploy, and maintain scalable, automated ETL/ELT pipelines using Python, dbt, and orchestration tools such as Prefect and Airflow Administer and optimize cloud-based data warehouse and lake platforms, including Snowflake, AWS (S3, Redshift), and Google Cloud, integrating new sources and tuning for performance and cost Orchestrate data workflows with custom scheduling, alerting, dependency management, monitoring, and error resolution Design and maintain secure external data flows through SFTP, Files.com, and APIs, with a focus on reliability and compliance Automate manual reporting and operational tasks, building robust, reusable pipeline components that reduce operational overhead Partner with backend product engineers to optimize production database schemas with analytics use cases in mind Strengthen data quality, lineage, governance, and documentation practices across key data domains Mentor teammates and reinforce best practices in version control, code review, and structured workflow management What Success Looks Like 📈 In your first 12–18 months, you will have: Taken end-to-end ownership of core pipelines and integrations, with measurable improvements in reliability, data recency, and cost efficiency Automated high-effort manual workflows, reducing operational risk and freeing capacity for higher-value engineering work Delivered secure, compliant data integrations that stakeholders across the business trust for decision-making Strengthened observability across the platform, including monitoring, alerting, and incident response for critical data workflows Established yourself as a technical mentor and a go-to partner for Business Intelligence, Product, and cross-functional teams About You ✨ You likely have: Expert-level proficiency in Snowflake, dbt, and Python for data modeling, transformation, pipeline development, and advanced analytics Advanced SQL skills for complex querying, large-scale data model design, and database optimization Proven experience architecting, building, testing, deploying, and maintaining scalable, automated ETL/ELT pipelines using modern orchestration tools such as Prefect and Airflow Hands-on administration of cloud-based data warehouse and lake platforms, including Snowflake, AWS (S3, Redshift), and Google Cloud A strong understanding of secure external data flows through SFTP, Files.com, and APIs, with a focus on reliability and compliance Mastery of version control (Git, GitHub) and structured workflow management (Jira) for code review, audit trails, and operational transparency A demonstrated ability to automate and simplify complex manual tasks, building robust, reusable pipeline components Dependability, adaptability, and a collaborative approach to engineering, thriving in dynamic and ambiguous environments Nice to Have ⭐ While not required, we would be especially excited if you bring: Hands-on experience in startup or rapid-growth environments, delivering technical solutions under shifting priorities A background supporting business intelligence, analytics, and data science teams through large-scale integrations and multi-tenant reporting Familiarity with both batch and event-driven ingestion paradigms, including near-real-time pipelines built on Snowflake, dbt, and Python Experience automating operational, financial, or compliance-driven workflows within cloud data environments Exposure to audit, privacy, and compliance frameworks such as SOC 2, HIPAA, GDPR, ISO, and SOX, particularly in data governance and secure access controls Experience in regulated industries such as healthcare, healthtech, or SaaS Why This Role Matters 🧡 Reliable data is the foundation of how Carrot operates, from the analytics that guide business decisions to the reporting our customers and partners depend on. The systems this role owns determine the accuracy, recency, and security of data used across the entire company. As Carrot scales globally, the Sr. Data Engineer will make our data platform more automated, resilient, and cost-efficient, enabling teams across the business to move faster with data they trust. This work directly supports Carrot's mission of expanding access to fertility and family-building care worldwide. Interview Process 🤝 We believe in a thoughtful and transparent interview process designed to create alignment for both candidates and our team. For this role, candidates can expect: Recruiter Screen — 30 minutes Hiring Manager Interview — 30–45 minutes Cross-Functional Panel Interviews — 45 minutes Executive Leadership Conversation — 30 minutes Hiring Manager Wrap-Up — 15 minutes Throughout the process, we will share additional context about the team, business priorities, customer landscape, and what success looks like in this role. Why Candidates Join Carrot 🌍 Carrot offers the opportunity to do meaningful work in service of a deeply human mission. Highlights include: A mission-driven company focused on expanding access to fertility and family-forming care globally. A high-growth environment where leaders are empowered to shape strategy and drive impact. Competitive compensation, equity, and comprehensive benefits. Flexible Time Off and a culture that actively encourages employees to recharge. Comprehensive parental leave and family-forming benefits. A collaborative, inclusive, and values-driven culture. The opportunity to work alongside passionate, thoughtful teammates committed to improving healthcare outcomes worldwide. Compensation: Carrot offers a holistic Total Rewards package designed to support our employees in all aspects of their life inside and outside of work, including health and wellness benefits, retirement savings plans, short- and long-term incentives, parental leave, family-forming assistance, and a competitive compensation package. The starting base salary for this position will range from $145,000-$165,000. Actual compensation may vary from posted base salary depending on your confirmed job-related skills and experience. Fraud and Security Notice: Please note that all communication regarding job opportunities at Carrot will come exclusively from an @get-carrot.com email address. If you receive messages from any other domain, please disregard them and report the incident to: securityreporting@get-carrot.com A Note on AI At Carrot, we believe AI can help us work smarter, move faster, and create more meaningful experiences for our members, customers, and each other. While not every role requires deep technical AI expertise, we value people who are curious, eager to learn, and excited to thoughtfully incorporate AI into their day-to-day work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement—and we'll call that out clearly in the qualifications. For everyone else, we're looking for people who embrace new ways of working, use AI responsibly to improve quality and efficiency, and continue to learn as the technology evolves. Why Carrot? Carrot has received national and international recognition for its pioneering work, including Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies and World Changing Ideas, Inc. Power Partners, and Modern Healthcare’s Innovators. Carrot’s global workforce has been acknowledged with several accolades, including Fortune’s Best Workplaces in Healthcare, Great Place to Work, and Age-Friendly Employer certifications. Carrot is regularly featured in media reporting on issues related to the future of work, women in leadership, and healthcare innovation, including MSNBC, The Economist, Bloomberg, The Wall Street Journal, CNBC, National Public Radio, Harvard Business Review, and more. Learn more at carrotfertility.com.

items.summary: Job Summary:We are seeking a talented Data Scientist to join our remote team.
items.description: Job Summary: We are seeking a talented Data Scientist to join our remote team. As a Data Scientist, you will be responsible for analyzing complex datasets, developing machine learning models, and deriving actionable insights to drive business decisions. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in statistics, machine learning, and programming, along with the ability to work independently in a remote environment. This is an exciting opportunity to apply your skills to real-world problems and contribute to innovative projects from anywhere in the world. Responsibilities: Analyze large datasets to extract meaningful patterns, trends, and insights using statistical techniques and machine learning algorithms. Develop predictive models and algorithms to solve business problems and optimize decision-making processes. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define project objectives, gather requirements, and prioritize tasks. Clean, preprocess, and manipulate data to ensure accuracy, completeness, and consistency for analysis. Build and deploy machine learning models into production environments, and monitor their performance over time. Interpret and communicate analysis results and insights to stakeholders through visualizations, reports, and presentations. Stay updated with the latest developments in data science, machine learning, and AI technologies, and apply them to improve existing models and methodologies. Conduct experiments and A/B tests to evaluate model performance and validate hypotheses. Mentor junior data scientists and provide guidance on best practices in data analysis and modeling. Requirements: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, or related field; Master's or Ph.D. degree is a plus. Minimum of 3 years of experience in data science, machine learning, or related fields. Proficiency in programming languages such as Python or R, along with experience with data manipulation and analysis libraries (e.g., Pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn). Strong understanding of statistical concepts and methods, and experience with hypothesis testing, regression analysis, and time series forecasting. Hands-on experience with machine learning techniques such as classification, regression, clustering, and natural language processing. Familiarity with data visualization tools and techniques (e.g., Matplotlib, Seaborn, Tableau). Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform, and proficiency in SQL and NoSQL databases. Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail, with the ability to work independently and as part of a remote team. Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to effectively communicate technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders. #DataScientist #RemoteWork #MachineLearning #DataAnalysis #DataScience #RemoteJob #AI #PredictiveModeling #DataMining #Statistics #RemoteTech #WorkFromAnywhere #TechJobs #DataAnalytics #ArtificialIntelligence #Python #RemoteOpportunity Originally posted on Himalayas

items.description: Full-Stack Programming Headquarters: Remote - USA Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way. The Community You Will Join: People Analytics & Research is a strong team of Data Scientists, Data Engineers, and Analysts. Our work is highly sought-after, and impacts stakeholders in our People function, and across the business. In this role, you'll take on some of the hardest questions about Airbnb's workforce - how we recruit, pay, develop, and retain our people - partnering with leaders across Recruiting, Compensation, Talent, and the wider business to turn rigorous analysis into decisions they act on. The Difference You Will Make: The People Analytics & Research team is looking for an experienced Data Scientist to lead and/or contribute to our most important research - applying causal inference and quasi-experimental methods to high-stakes people questions: how we recruit, hire, promote, and retain a best-in-class workforce; how we keep key company processes fair; and how work itself is changing. Employee listening and survey analysis are part of the mix, but the heart of the role is rigorous inferential research on observational people data. The role is highly cross-functional, and you will partner with Recruiting, Talent Leaders, Compensation, Legal, and Diversity & Belonging. We need a Data Scientist with a proven track record of translating data into insight and action. If you have a proven background in this field and are excited to help build Airbnb’s community, we want to hear from you. A Typical Day: Collaborate with partners and stakeholders to understand people-related business problems, and gather relevant people data to analyze Utilize appropriate statistical models and data science methodologies to gain insights, explain, or predict a wide variety of people-related processes, such as recruiting and hiring, promotion, retention, pay equity, productivity, and organizational effectiveness, among others Translate data and insights into meaningful visualizations and stories to drive strategy, action, and decision-making with leaders across the business Align research priorities with business priorities and take a customer-focused mindset in working with stakeholders Lead the team's compensation analytics - the recurring, legally sensitive analyses that inform Total Rewards decisions on pay, compensation structure, and talent awards - in close partnership with Employment Legal and Total Rewards Lead design and measurement of Airbnb's quality-of-hire metric with Recruiting, and own sensitive statutory and governance reporting Be a constant learner, active listener, and teacher to advance data science, people analytics, and Airbnb Use AI fluently - including the team's AirPanda platform and LLM-based agents - to accelerate analysis, prototyping, and synthesis, and to extend what a single researcher can deliver Your Expertise: 5+ years in industry experience and a Master's degree/PhD in a quantitative field Deep experience with causal inference on observational data and quasi-experimental research design and analysis Proficiency in R or Python for statistical analysis, and SQL for data access Familiarity with survey design and analysis, as one of several methods in the toolkit Experience applying data science to compensation, recruiting, or broader workforce and organizational questions, including work with legally sensitive data Ability to communicate clearly and effectively to cross functional partners of varying technical levels and drive impact Experience working with large practical datasets Your Location: This position is US - Remote Eligible. The role may include occasional work at an Airbnb office or attendance at offsites, as agreed to with your manager. While the position is Remote Eligible, you must live in a state where Airbnb, Inc. has a registered entity. Click here for the up-to-date list of excluded states. This list is continuously evolving, so please check back with us if the state you live in is on the exclusion list . If your position is employed by another Airbnb entity, your recruiter will inform you what states you are eligible to work from. Our Commitment To Inclusion & Belonging: Airbnb is committed to working with the broadest talent pool possible. We believe diverse ideas foster innovation and engagement, and allow us to attract creatively-led people, and to develop the best products, services and solutions. All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply. We strive to also provide a disability inclusive application and interview process. If you are a candidate with a disability and require reasonable accommodation in order to submit an application, please contact us at: reasonableaccommodations@airbnb.com . Please include your full name, the role you’re applying for and the accommodation necessary to assist you with the recruiting process. We ask that you only reach out to us if you are a candidate whose disability prevents you from being able to complete our online application. Equal Employment Opportunity : Airbnb values diversity & belonging and is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. All individuals seeking employment at Airbnb are considered without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, age, gender, sex, marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, or any other legally protected characteristic. How We'll Take Care of You: Our job titles may span more than one career level. The actual base pay is dependent upon many factors, such as: training, transferable skills, work experience, business needs and market demands. The base pay range is subject to change and may be modified in the future. This role may also be eligible for bonus, equity, benefits, and Employee Travel Credits. Pay Range $180,000 — $210,000 USD Reasonable Accommodations: We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the recruitment process for applicants with disabilities. If you need assistance, or an accommodation, please let your recruiter know once you are contacted about a role. A Note on Recruiting Scams: Scammers sometimes pose as Airbnb recruiters to get money or personal information from candidates. A few things that will always be true for Airbnb’s hiring process: our open roles are posted on Airbnb’s Career’s Page at careers.airbnb.com, and our recruiters correspond only from @ airbnb.com or @ ext.airbnb.com email addresses. Our recruiters will never ask for your Social Security number, bank account details, passport, or payment app information while you are interviewing. We’ll also never ask you to pay a fee, send money, deposit or cash a check, or purchase work-related equipment (such as a company laptop) during the interview process. We encourage candidates to remain vigilant of these recruiting scams and not share sensitive information if you do not believe an individual is actually affiliated with Airbnb. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/airbnb-senior-data-scientist-people-analytics-research

items.description: About ElevenLabs ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology. We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always. We have expanded from voice into three main platforms: ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale. ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages. ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models. Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you. How we work High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy. Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you. AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations. Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models. Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location. What we offer Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible. Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities. Learning & development : ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend. Social travel : We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose. Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún Co-working : If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend. About the role We're looking for a Data Scientist - Product Analytics to join our Growth Data team. You'll own the analysis behind how people discover, adopt and stick with ElevenLabs' products, partnering closely with Product, Growth and the central Data team's certified metrics layer. Define and own product health metrics: activation, feature adoption, retention and engagement across ElevenCreative, ElevenAgents and ElevenAPI. Design, analyse and communicate the results of product experiments (A/B tests, feature launches, onboarding changes). Partner with Analytics Engineering on the certified product KPI layer in dbt, and with Product on turning ambiguous questions into trusted analysis. Work alongside fellow Growth data scientists on marketing- and revenue-adjacent questions that touch the product funnel. Requirements Demonstrated experience as a data scientist embedded with a product or growth team, ideally at a product-led company. Strong SQL and Python , with hands-on experience in experimentation (A/B testing) and product analytics. Ability to translate ambiguous product questions into clear, reusable analysis and defensible metrics. Comfort working directly with Product and Growth stakeholders , and pushing back on ill-defined asks. Structured thinker who can move fast without sacrificing rigour. Bonus Experience with activation / retention modelling or lifecycle analytics at a consumer or prosumer product. Experience with dbt or a modern warehouse, partnering directly with analytics engineers. Experience using AI tools or agents to speed up analysis or enable self-serve data access. Growth potential We believe in hiring the best talent in the world to make an impact in the right role at the right time. At ElevenLabs, strong performance creates opportunities for growth. Here are some of the career paths you can expect after excelling in this role: Grow into a Senior or Staff Product Data Scientist role as the Growth Data team scales. Expand scope across additional product lines (ElevenAgents, ElevenAPI). Path into a Growth Data Science lead or broader data leadership track. Location This role is remote-first, so it can be executed from anywhere in Europe, with the ability to operate in GMT and GMT+1 timezones. If you prefer, you can work from our offices in London and Warsaw. #LI-Remote We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

items.description: About CookUnity : Food has lost its soul to modern convenience. And with it, it has lost the power to nourish, inspire, and connect us. So in 2018, CookUnity was founded as the first-of-its-kind platform that connects the world with the source of truly great food: chefs. Today, CookUnity delivers 50 million meals a year from the industry’s best chefs to homes all over the country. Fresh. Ready-to-eat. And crafted with the passion that nourishes body and soul. Unwilling to stop there, CookUnity is expanding beyond delivery to become an ever-innovating marketplace focused on our singular mission: empower Chefs to nourish the world. If that mission has you hungry in more ways than one, you’ve found the right job posting. About the Role As a Senior Product Data Analyst , you will be an analytical partner to Product, Design, Engineering, and User Research. You will help teams understand both sides of CookUnity's marketplace: how customers find meals that fit their lives and how chef supply, variety, and merchandising shape that experience. You will own measurement and analysis for a product area, turn ambiguous questions into testable hypotheses, and use evidence to guide product decisions. Our teams operate through clear success metrics, rapid learning, and controlled experiments. You will help them distinguish meaningful customer and business outcomes from activity, evaluate tradeoffs across the funnel and customer lifecycle, and make insights accessible in day-to-day decisions. This is a hands-on senior individual contributor role with meaningful autonomy and close cross-functional partnership. What You'll Do in 12 Months Make the marketplace easier to discover and more relevant: Study how customers browse chefs, meals, cuisines, dietary options, and price points. Analyze the relationship between local assortment, variety, personalization, and ordering behavior. Help Product identify where better discovery or merchandising can improve repeat ordering and retention. Improve the journey from first visit to lasting habit: Map the customer funnel from acquisition through first order, early repeat orders, and longer-term retention. Find friction in onboarding, menu exploration, checkout, and weekly ordering. Segment customers thoughtfully so teams can improve conversion and retention without hiding weak experiences behind averages. Measure product bets with credible experiments: Partner with Product and Engineering to define hypotheses, primary metrics, guardrails, sample sizes, and holdouts for changes to the funnel, personalization, loyalty, and in-product interventions. Analyze heterogeneous effects and uncertainty, and recommend whether to launch, iterate, or stop. When a randomized test is impractical, use the strongest available observational approach and explain its limits. Connect customer value to marketplace economics: Help teams evaluate how product changes affect order rate, churn, revenue per customer, discounts, chef engagement, and unit economics together. For new categories and ordering formats, define the measures that show whether customers find value and whether the model can scale. Reduce the work and stress of ordering: Combine behavioral data with research and customer feedback to understand where subscriptions, delivery information, account management, or support journeys create friction. Measure whether self-service and product improvements solve the underlying problem, not just move contacts to another channel. Build a trusted measurement foundation: Define and document product metrics, cohorts, event tracking, and dashboards. Work with Engineering and Data partners to validate instrumentation and maintain reliable behavioral data. Create compelling dashboards that let product teams explore results, spot meaningful patterns, and monitor outcomes after launch. Shape a focused learning agenda: Work with Product, Design, and User Research to prioritize the most consequential unknowns, design analyses and tests, and tell a clear story about what the team learned. Share methods and review work with other analysts to raise the quality of product analytics across the team. What Success Looks Like Product teams use clear metrics and guardrails to make decisions about discovery, conversion, ordering, and retention. Major launches are supported by credible tests or well-explained evidence, including their impact on different customer segments. Insights lead to measurable improvements in customer experience and repeat ordering while accounting for marketplace and financial tradeoffs. Stakeholders trust and regularly use self-service reporting, and core behavioral data is sufficiently complete to diagnose product performance. Core Competences/Requirements Approximately 5–7 years in product analytics or a closely related analytical role, with demonstrated ownership of complex analyses and influence on product decisions. Equivalent experience and evidence of impact are welcome. Practical fluency with AI tools for accelerating analysis, coding, research synthesis, documentation, and repeatable workflows; able to verify outputs and handle company and customer data responsibly. Strong SQL and hands-on experience analyzing large, complex behavioral datasets; ability to validate data and write clear, reusable analyses. Practical command of product metrics, funnel and cohort analysis, segmentation, and marketplace or subscription dynamics. Experience designing and interpreting A/B tests, including holdouts, guardrails, uncertainty, and tradeoffs; sound judgment about causal claims. Ability to turn an ambiguous product problem into a focused learning plan, work independently, and communicate an actionable recommendation. Clear data storytelling and constructive partnership with Product, Design, Engineering, User Research, and business teams. Ability to build powerful, intuitive dashboards in any tool that answer important product questions, reveal actionable insights, and enable trustworthy self-service analysis. Ability to evaluate AI-enabled product experiences through clear success metrics, experiments, user feedback, and appropriate quality and safety checks. Curiosity about food, chefs, customer behavior, and the practical constraints of operating a local marketplace. If you’re interested in this role, please submit your application, and if we think you might be a fit, we'll get in touch with you. Thank you for your time! CookUnity is an Equal Opportunity Employer . We are dedicated to creating a community of inclusion and an environment free from discrimination or harassment. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, citizenship status, protected veteran status, genetic information, or physical or mental disability. A quick note for all candidates We’ve recently seen an increase in recruitment scams across the industry, and we want to make sure you (and your data) stay safe while applying to CookUnity. We also want you to know that we take this seriously — sometimes, as part of our process, we may ask for a brief “proof of humanity” to confirm that we’re connecting with a real person, not an impersonator. Here are a few tips to help you protect yourself and know what to expect from us: Apply only through our official channels. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: careers.cookunity.com Our recruiters are real people — and easy to verify. You can always find them on LinkedIn with verified profiles. If you’re unsure, feel free to reach out to us on our official LinkedIn Company Page . We only communicate through official CookUnity channels. We’ll never ask for payment or personal financial details. If anyone does, please don’t share any information and let us know right away. If something ever feels off or you’re unsure about a message, we’d much rather you double-check with us. You can always contact us directly through any of our social media channels. We appreciate your interest in joining CookUnity — and we care about keeping your experience (and safety) as genuine as possible.

items.description: All Other Remote Headquarters: Remote - MX Who We Are Oportun (Nasdaq: OPRT) is a mission-driven financial services company that puts its members' financial goals within reach. With intelligent borrowing, savings, and budgeting capabilities, Oportun empowers members with the confidence to build a better financial future. Since inception, Oportun has provided more than $22.7 billion in responsible and affordable credit, saved its members more than $2.5 billion in interest and fees, and helped its members set aside an average of more than $1,800 annually. The Opportunity As Senior Manager, Credit Strategy, you'll play a critical role in shaping the underwriting and pricing strategy for one of Oportun's largest lending portfolios. You'll develop and optimize strategies that balance responsible growth, credit performance, customer outcomes, and long-term profitability. You'll operate as a strategic leader across Risk, Product, Marketing, and Finance, using rigorous analytics and sound business judgment to identify opportunities, develop proposals for senior management and committee approval, and translate approved strategies into action. Success in this role means materially improving portfolio performance through disciplined strategy development, implementation, and monitoring while helping Oportun responsibly expand access to affordable credit. At Oportun, we move fast and we hold each other to a high bar. If you care about doing your best work while actually moving the needle for real people, you'll fit right in. What You'll Do Your day-to-day You'll lead the development and ongoing optimization of underwriting and pricing strategies for a large lending portfolio, balancing responsible growth, credit performance, customer outcomes, and risk-adjusted profitability. You’ll develop data-driven proposals for these strategies, clearly articulating expected impacts on approval rates, credit losses, growth, revenue, customer outcomes, and profitability for review by senior management and governance committees. You’ll design and evaluate tests to optimize loan amounts, terms, and other offer attributes at the appropriate level of granularity, balancing customer access, loss performance, and lifetime profitability within defined business and risk constraints. You'll serve as a strategic Risk partner to Product, Marketing, and Finance, bringing a credit-risk and portfolio-economics perspective to major business decisions and cross-functional initiatives. You’ll leverage or enhance the existing marginal profitability and valuation frameworks to assess risk-adjusted returns by customer and risk segment, informing underwriting, pricing, and offer strategy decisions. You'll establish monitoring and measurement frameworks for strategy changes, perform deep portfolio, customer, and strategy analysis using Python and SQL to identify emerging risks, performance trends, and opportunities for optimization. You'll bring ideas for how we can do things better — proactively, not just when asked — including thoughtful use of AI and analytical tools to reduce manual work, accelerate insights, and improve decision quality. Who You Are The right fit looks like this You're a highly analytical strategist who is comfortable navigating complex, ambiguous problems and turning data into clear business decisions. You combine strong consumer credit judgment with the ability to influence senior stakeholders across functions, and you take ownership from initial analysis and recommendation through implementation and performance monitoring. You're comfortable navigating complexity and don't wait for perfect information to move forward. You communicate clearly, give direct feedback, and expect the same in return. What You Bring Skills & experience Required 8+ years of experience in consumer lending, credit risk, underwriting, pricing, portfolio strategy, or a closely related analytical strategy function. Bachelor's degree, preferably in a quantitative or business discipline such as Economics, Finance, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, or a related field. Strong expertise in consumer credit, underwriting strategy, pricing, portfolio analytics, and risk-return trade-offs. Advanced hands-on proficiency with Python and SQL, including the ability to independently analyze large and complex datasets. Experience using data visualization platforms or tools to communicate portfolio trends and strategic insights. Demonstrated ability to develop analytically rigorous recommendations, frame strategic trade-offs, and influence senior management and governance committees. Strong cross-functional leadership skills, with demonstrated ability to partner effectively across Risk, Product, Marketing, Finance, and technical or operational teams. Demonstrated ability to translate approved strategies into implementation plans and establish monitoring frameworks that measure business and credit outcomes. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to distill complex analyses into clear, executive-ready recommendations. Nice to Have 10+ years of related experience. Advanced degree in a quantitative or business discipline. Experience developing and implementing direct marketing and pre-qualified offer strategies. Familiarity with modern lending decisioning, experimentation, and portfolio monitoring frameworks. You've used AI tools (ChatGPT, Copilot, or similar) to improve your own productivity. Our AI Mindset We build with AI. We lead with judgment. AI isn't a feature here. It's how we work. We're excited about what AI makes possible, and we're looking for people who share that curiosity. You don't need to be an expert. You need to be open to experimenting , willing to learn, and able to apply new tools in ways that actually move the needle. In this role, you'll be encouraged to explore AI tools, find practical use cases for your function, and bring ideas for working smarter. We believe the best outcomes come when human judgment and AI capability work together. Why Oportun What's in it for you Oportun offers a competitive compensation and benefits package designed to support your physical, financial, and professional well-being. Benefits vary by country of employment. Some of the benefits available to eligible employees include: Mexico Benefits: Medical Insurance Savings Fund Life Insurance Internet and Electricity Allowance Paid time off such as vacation and parental leave Eligibility and plan details vary by location and employment status. To learn more about Oportun and our benefits, visit oportun.com/careers #LI-REMOTE #LI-GK1 We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and consider all qualified applicants for employment opportunities without regard to race, age, color, religion, gender, national origin, disability, sexual orientation, veteran status or any other category protected by the laws or regulations in the locations where we operate. California applicants can find a copy of Oportun's CCPA Notice here: https://oportun.com/privacy/california-privacy-notice/ . We will never request personal identifiable information (bank, credit card, etc.) before you are hired. We do not charge you for pre-employment fees such as background checks, training, or equipment. If you think you have been a victim of fraud by someone posing as us, please report your experience to the FBI’s Internet Crime Complaint Center (IC3). To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/oportun-senior-manager-risk-strategy-r14349

items.description: Job Title: PhD Scientist - STEM Expert Job Type: Contractor Location: Remote(Worldwide) Commitment: Flexible — fits alongside your current role Location: Fully remote You’ll need: A completed PhD in a STEM field, plus hands-on research experience Your tasks: Build difficult technical problems from your own research and define what makes an answer correct These tasks are hard to build, and that’s the point. We’re looking for people with genuine depth in their field: the problems where the textbook answer isn’t enough, where the right approach depends on reading the constraints correctly, where a plausible-looking answer is quietly wrong. Required Skills Research Data Analysis Experimental Design Scientific Writing Statistical Analysis Laboratory Skills Wet Lab Clinical Research MATLAB Python SolidWorks Biostatistics Epidemiology Clinical Trials Data Visualization Spectroscopy Chromatography What you’ll do Design difficult technical problems drawn from your own research area, with realistic constraints and supporting data. Provide the correct solution and walk through the reasoning that gets there. Define objective criteria for correctness, so another researcher reviewing the work would reach the same verdict. Review problems built by other contributors for technical accuracy and soundness of method. Flag problems that turn out to be ambiguous or ungradable rather than submitting them. What we’re looking for Completed PhD in a STEM field. This is a hard requirement. Hands-on research experience — work you did yourself, not work you read about. Wet lab, research lab, or academic experience is strongly preferred. Able to explain why an answer is correct clearly enough that another researcher could verify it. Publications or a record of research contribution is a strong plus. Prior experience on AI training or evaluation projects is a plus, not a requirement. How the selection process works Apply and complete the screening questions Complete the AI interview for this role — it’s how your expertise gets in front of the client Profile review Onboarding — our Talent Ops team will get you set up Originally posted on Himalayas
