items.description: Role Title: Statistician Role Type: Contractor Location: Remote micro1 is selecting Statistician to contribute expert knowledge to a customer project focused on advancing data-driven solutions. In this role, you'll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input. No prior experience in AI is required — your domain knowledge is what matters. Scope of Work Clean, preprocess, and structure complex and messy datasets using advanced statistical software (such as R, Python, SAS, or Stata). Apply and document basic descriptive and inferential statistical analyses to uncover trends and patterns in real-world data. Develop clear and compelling data visualizations to illustrate key findings and support model development. Contribute expertise in dataset annotation, labeling, or enrichment to enhance the quality of AI model training datasets. Draft concise, well-organized written summaries of methods, analyses, and results for a non-technical audience. Collaborate asynchronously with project stakeholders to clarify requirements, resolve ambiguities, and improve deliverables through effective written and verbal communication. Continuously identify data quality issues, provide actionable recommendations, and document solutions for handling dirty or incomplete data. Preferred Qualifications Advanced degree (MS or PhD) in Statistics, Data Science, Mathematics, Biostatistics, or a related quantitative field. Expertise in cleaning and preparing complex, messy (“dirty”) datasets with R, Python, SAS, or Stata. Proficiency in basic descriptive and inferential statistical techniques, including hypothesis testing and regression analysis. Strong programming skills in Python or R for statistical analysis, data manipulation, and visualization. Demonstrated ability to communicate complex findings to non-technical and technical audiences with clarity and precision. Experience working with large, unstructured, or noisy datasets across a variety of domains. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with a focus on detailed documentation and collaboration in remote environments. Originally posted on Himalayas

items.description: Product Headquarters: Burlington, MA OR US Remote Looking for an innovative, high-growth, multi-award-winning company in one of the hottest segments of the security market? Look no further than Veracode! Veracode is a global leader in Application Risk Management for the AI era. Powered by trillions of lines of code scans and a proprietary AI-generated remediation engine, the Veracode platform is trusted by organizations worldwide to build and maintain secure software from code creation to cloud deployment. Learn more at www.veracode.com , on the Veracode blog , and on LinkedIn and Twitter . We are looking for a motivated Performance Test Engineer with 3–5 years of experience to join our Quality Engineering team. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience in performance testing, scripting, and analyzing application performance. You will work closely with Performance Engineers, Developers, and Quality Engineers to identify performance bottlenecks, validate application scalability, and ensure our products meet performance and reliability expectations. Key Responsibilities Design, develop, execute, and maintain performance test scripts using tools such as Apache JMeter, Locust, and K6 . Conduct load, stress, scalability, and endurance testing for APIs and web applications. Execute weekly release performance tests , analyze results, identify regressions, and report findings to ensure release readiness. Analyze performance test results to identify bottlenecks, response-time degradation, and resource utilization issues. Monitor application and infrastructure metrics, including CPU, memory, throughput, latency, and error rates. Collaborate with development teams to investigate performance issues and validate fixes. Develop and maintain reusable performance testing scripts and test data. Participate in integrating performance tests into CI/CD pipelines. Document test scenarios, execution results, and performance findings. Support performance regression testing as part of regular release cycles. Work with senior engineers to improve performance testing frameworks and processes. Required Qualifications 3–5 years of experience in software testing, including hands-on performance testing experience. Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. Practical experience with Apache JMeter or similar performance testing tools. Good understanding of performance testing concepts, including load testing, stress testing, throughput, latency, and concurrency. Experience testing REST APIs and understanding HTTP/HTTPS protocols. Basic programming or scripting experience with Python, Java, or JavaScript. Ability to analyze performance results and troubleshoot application issues. Familiarity with Linux environments and basic command-line utilities. Understanding of software development lifecycles, Agile methodologies, and CI/CD processes. Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and communication skills. Preferred Qualifications Experience with K6, Locust , or other modern performance testing frameworks. Familiarity with monitoring and observability tools such as Datadog, Grafana, or Prometheus. Working knowledge of AWS services such as EC2, EKS, CloudWatch, and basic cloud networking concepts. Basic understanding of Kubernetes and Docker , including containers, pods, deployments, and resource utilization. Experience with UI test automation using frameworks such as Cypress, Selenium, or Playwright. Familiarity with AI-assisted testing and development tools , including using generative AI to create test scripts, analyze results, troubleshoot failures, or improve automation efficiency. Basic knowledge of Terraform and Infrastructure as Code (IaC) concepts. Familiarity with Git commands and repository management , including branching, committing changes, creating merge requests, and resolving basic merge conflicts. Experience with GitLab CI/CD, Jenkins, or similar automation pipelines. Basic understanding of databases, SQL queries, and application architecture. Familiarity with distributed systems and microservices. What We’re Looking For A curious engineer who enjoys troubleshooting and understanding how systems behave under load. Someone comfortable analyzing data and communicating technical findings. A proactive team player who can work independently on assigned testing activities while collaborating with senior engineers. An engineer interested in leveraging AI and automation to improve testing efficiency and engineering productivity. A strong desire to learn new performance engineering tools, technologies, and methodologies. What we offer you: Outstanding Medical, Dental, and Vision Coverage to meet all your healthcare needs. Wellness benefits to help you focus on what’s most important. “Take What You Need” time off policy. Extensive development and training offerings to help you grow your career at Veracode. Generous 401k match to help save for your future . Amazing community of professionals who take pride in what we do every day. Compensation Transparency In accordance with U.S. pay transparency laws, Veracode provides compensation transparency for roles based in the United States. Click here to view our compensation ranges by grade. Please note, specific compensation may be influenced by various factors including candidates experience, education, and work location. Job Grade: Career Employment opportunities are available to all applicants without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. Fraudulent Recruitment Alert - Be Aware and Stay Informed At Veracode, we prioritize a secure recruitment process. Unfortunately, fake recruitment and job offer scams are on the rise. They aim to deceive candidates through emails and calls to obtain sensitive information. Here’s our recruitment promise to you: Comprehensive Interview Process: We never extend job offers without a comprehensive interview process involving our recruitment team and hiring managers. Offer Communications: Our job offers are not sent solely through email, and we will never ask you to pay for your own hardware. Email Verification: Recruiting emails from Veracode will always originate from an “@veracode.com" email address. If you have any doubts about the authenticity of an email, letter, or telephone communication claiming to be from Veracode, please reach out to us at careers@veracode.com before taking any further action. We encourage anybody who is interested in this position to please apply! About Thrive Thrive is a leading full-funnel digital marketing agency supporting growth for some of North America’s most ambitious companies. We evolve our services through disciplined learning, continuous improvement, and close partnership with our clients - regularly assessing what works, what doesn’t, and where to raise the bar. Our mission is to help companies grow sustainably. To do that, we’ve built deep expertise across performance marketing, brand marketing, digital design, and data and measurement, managing more than $5 billion USD in advertising spend over the past decade. Our work spans startups, scale-ups, and enterprise organizations, including Alo, Zoom, Slack, Uber, Asana, Masterclass, Snapchat, Change.org, and lululemon. Our culture values curiosity, accountability, and thoughtful problem-solving. We challenge our teams to grow and take ownership of their work while respecting boundaries and long-term sustainability. Thrive is a place where experimentation is encouraged, learning is continuous, and people are supported to do high-quality work they’re proud of - together. The Opportunity This is a build-and-grow moment. We're expanding our performance practice around lead generation, and the work comes with a portfolio most marketers only get to admire from the outside — think category-defining B2B software and technology brands, the kind of companies whose products you already use and whose growth story is still being written. You won't just be running campaigns for them; you'll be the strategic partner helping them figure out how demand generation compounds into pipeline, market share, and durable growth. That means owning the questions that actually move a business: how do we reach the right buyers earlier, turn intent into qualified pipeline, and build a lead engine that scales as they do? The tactical craft matters — funnel design, lead quality, CPL and lead-to-opportunity performance — but here it's in service of something bigger: shaping how some of the most ambitious brands in tech grow. If your best work has been measured in ROAS, purchases, or app installs, this likely isn't your fit. But if you think about demand gen as a growth strategy, not just a channel, let's chat. The Role Joining the Performance department (performance marketing) as our Performance Strategist, you'll ensure Thrive operates at peak performance by establishing efficient processes, implementing best practices, and fostering growth within your team in both technical and strategic areas. Your mission will be to develop and execute project growth initiatives, lead a high-performing team, and uphold our company philosophy. You’ll focus on setting your team up for success by enhancing the systems used to build, maintain, and grow client relationships through continuous improvement of philosophies, programs, policies, and processes. Working Within Our Values: At Thrive, we value teamwork and a "no politics" culture. This means that no matter your title, everyone is committed to contributing in whatever way is needed to ensure project success. Your role involves both high-level, strategic leadership and rolling up your sleeves for hands-on execution when required. Your focus of responsibilities will be: Domain: Recognized as an emerging leader in performance marketing at Thrive, you solve client challenges, elevate team skills, and drive program growth by enabling teams to excel in their projects and careers. Example: You'll lead teams in the research, media planning and strategic roadmaps across mid-sized projects. You’re responsible for mobilizing internal teams and working alongside them from inception through to hands-on, ongoing execution and optimization, while reporting to stakeholders on key performance indicators. Client : Organizing and leading high-impact client relationship drivers, such as client onboards and business reviews, and using the latest and most cutting-edge methods and tools available to achieve successful outcomes. Example: You lead strategic conversations with small to mid-sized clients 1:1, proactively engaging in and consistently monitoring client sentiment to ensure we’re addressing any challenges and opportunities. You provide constructive feedback to team members and work with the senior operational team to address any resourcing, performance or economic shifts. People: Elevating people you work directly and indirectly with to bring best-in-class solutions to projects through their thinking and execution. Supporting the development of team members to grow company performance expertise. Example: You either manage team members directly or work closely with them in a mentor and advocate capacity. Operating at a manager level, you address any role performance challenges proactively and appropriately. You set team members up for success to continuously elevate their roles on projects, are an expert at giving feedback and approach difficult conversations with confidence and care. Company: Lead a culture of project excellence in the Performance department by guiding daily interactions, developing initiatives, and aligning individual efforts with organizational goals. Monitor team workflow, use business intelligence tools to optimize people and project allocation. Example: You lead team-level conversations and support initiatives that keep Thrive on the leading edge of performance marketing. You get buy-in, work through change management, and successfully collaborate with cross-functional support as needed. We’re committed to delivering an exceptional onboarding experience that will create a strong foundation for your launch in this role: In your first 30 days you’ll familiarize yourself with Thrive’s tools and processes and begin onboarding to projects and teams across your department, identifying performance opportunities and building relationships. In your first 60 days you’ll be playing an active role across projects, collaborating with teams on day-to-day and longer term account initiatives. You’ll begin developing processes and strategies to improve team and project success and sharing key insights with others. In your first 90 days you’ll be stepping into account leadership opportunities, providing support across project planning, strategy, client partnerships and team skills development. Qualifications You have executed, planned and maintained multi-channel, full funnel performance marketing accounts of $200k+ USD media spend per month at a consistently positive ROI for the client across multiple platforms at a time (e.g., Meta, Google Ads, YouTube, Display, Programmatic Platforms, TikTok, Twitter, Spotify and others). You have experience directly collaborating with and delegating to junior team members as a senior account manager. You have contributed to the development of multiple team members by leading training and providing strategic guidance and project leadership to the point of developing others to the next stage of seniority / role level. You have advanced analytical skills and are experienced in using visualization tools like Google Sheets, Excel, Google Data Studio, Tableau or similar platforms to pull, sort, analyze and draw insight from ad platforms, analytics, and / or business intelligence tools. You’ve managed performance media across a range of business verticals and sizes (ecommerce, demand gen, etc), and have been responsible for pacing, forecasting and reporting the impact of performance media on overarching business goals. You have successfully managed client and / or key stakeholder relationships (ranging in seniority) via weekly touchpoint meetings, quarterly business presentations and asynchronous communication channels (Slack, email, Asana, etc). You’ve resolved difficult stakeholder situations, keeping priorities organized and objectives aligned and have consistently received buy-in on strategic proposals or deliverables. You have effectively communicated with clients on marketing concepts such as incrementality, KPI selection, attribution and business economics and have incorporated marketing measurement considerations into your strategic approaches. --- Equal Opportunity Employer Thrive is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse, inclusive, and respectful workplace. This commitment applies to all aspects of employment, including recruitment, hiring, performance management, training, compensation, and advancement. items.description: About Valdera : At Valdera, we empower innovators to turn ideas into reality by transforming how manufacturers source materials. We make it effortless for companies to find the best materials and suppliers for their needs, enabling them to build high-quality products at scale and deliver them to millions of consumers worldwide. We are a team of ambitious, results-driven individuals with a proven track record of working with Fortune 500 industrial manufacturers, beauty brands, and chemical companies. We are a fast-growing company that hires talented, hardworking people who excel in high-performance environments and want to grow their careers quickly. Our culture is built for exceptional individuals to take on meaningful challenges, collaborate with the top minds in our industry, and see the direct impact of their work. If you’re looking for a fast-paced environment where your ideas will drive real change, Valdera is the place for you. Join us, and let’s shape the future of manufacturing together. Role Description: We are hiring a C hemical Data Scientist to build and maintain the pipelines that keep Valdera's supplier and chemical product data accurate, current, and structured — the foundation every buyer and supplier relies on across Valdera's procurement platform. Data quality plays a critical role at Valdera. When a buyer launches a request, they expect to be matched with the right suppliers and accurate specs on the first try. Delivering that depends on clean, current data — CAS numbers, specifications, certifications, and regulatory documents pulled from thousands of inconsistent, often messy sources. This requires strong data engineering fundamentals and a working knowledge of chemical industry data. For example, you might take dozens of differently structured chemical supplier catalogs and turn them into one clean, standardized product database. You will take ownership of the full data pipeline — from scrapers and ETL workflows to data cleaning, matching, and classification models that connect suppliers to buyer requirements. You're energized by messy, real-world data and confident partnering with Supplier Management and Engineering to close coverage gaps. As a data-obsessed professional, you're dedicated to the accuracy our buyers and suppliers depend on. Apply statistical techniques to analyze complex datasets, diagnose operational issues, and support data-driven decision-making. Perform exploratory data analysis, identify trends, and work with stakeholders to interpret findings and drive continuous improvement. Extract, transform, and analyze data to generate actionable insights that support lab production operations and business decisions. Document analytical processes, best practices, and insights to ensure consistency and knowledge transfer across teams. Minimum 3 years of experience working in a highly regulated environment (e.g., CLIA and/or FDA compliant settings). Minimum 3 years of hands-on experience in data analysis, extraction, querying in production support roles. KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES: Working knowledge of the business processes and requirements of diagnostic laboratories. Knowledge of molecular biology, genetics, genomics, and/or bioinformatics is a plus. Proficient in data analysis and statistical techniques. Proficient in Python and SQL development. Working knowledge of Snowflake platform and cloud technologies. Strong understanding of statistical concepts such as hypothesis testing, central limit theorem, time series analysis, anomaly detection, and regression modeling. Good documentation practices and coding style. Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to present technical findings to both technical and non-technical audiences. Experience using version control systems such as GitHub or GitLab for managing code and collaboration. Ability to work collaboratively in a cross-functional team environment. Strong interpersonal skills. Strong integrity. items.description: Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution. The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing. This is an exciting opportunity for an exceptional software engineer passionate about open source software, Linux, and Web Services at scale. Come build a rewarding, meaningful career working with the best and brightest people in technology at Canonical , a growing international software company. Canonical 's Store team develops and operates a large system of backend services that power the Snap Store and marketplaces. Our services are built primarily in Python, with a bit of Golang. We have some exciting challenges ahead including continuing to scale our production architecture, significantly expanding the range of software we can deliver through the system powering our marketplaces, and enhancing our offering for the booming world of IoT and for large Enterprise solutions. If you have a passion for clean APIs, have a bias towards shipping, and believe that automated tests are the key to higher velocity and reliability, you'll fit right in. What you’ll do Collaborate remotely with a globally distributed team. Write clean web service APIs to support both CLI and web frontend clients, using Python (and optionally Golang). Design and implement new features and enhancements from spec to production and ongoing operations at scale. Review code and technical designs produced by other engineers. Discuss ideas and collaborate on finding good solutions. Work remotely with global travel for 2 to 4 weeks for internal and external events. Who you are You have demonstrated professional proficiency in developing public-facing APIs and web applications using Python. You have a broad technology base but favour backend code and infrastructure. You know your way around relational and non-relational databases and can effectively design data models that perform well, and tune queries to access them. You are comfortable with Ubuntu as a development and deployment platform. You have demonstrated strong academic performance in Computer Science, STEM or a similar degree. You love technology and working with a diverse set of talented people. You are curious, flexible, articulate, and accountable. You value soft skills and are passionate, enterprising, thoughtful, and self-motivated. About Canonical Canonical is a growing, international software company that works with the open-source community to deliver Ubuntu -- the world’s #1 cloud operating system. Our mission is to realise the potential of free software in the lives of individuals and organisations. Our services are helping businesses worldwide to reduce costs, improve efficiency and enhance security with Ubuntu. Canonical is a unique tech company - global, remote-first, open source, with 700 professionals across 50 countries - we want to be the world’s best, not biggest, global software company. With almost every team remote by default, Canonical sets the pace on the 21st-century digital workplace. What Canonical offers: Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004.​ Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game. Canonical is an equal opportunity employer We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products.Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration. #stack Originally posted on Himalayas

items.description: ABOUT THE ROLE We are looking for a Senior Analytics Engineer to bring robust, integrated data models and products to life within the VTEX Ads platform. You will be the data modeling reference point across the entire Ads ecosystem—advertisers, publishers, events (clicks, views, impressions), and performance—translating these domains into reliable data for product, client, data science, and business teams. From requirements gathering to production pipelines in our Lakehouse, you will ensure scalability and reliability for decisions that sustain the platform's operations and revenue. ABOUT THE TEAM You will join Campaign Intelligence, the newest team in our Data & Analytics organization, focused on the engine behind the VTEX Ads platform: pacing, target ROAS, budget forecasting, and auction optimization. We are responsible for structuring and serving this platform's data, giving product, data science, business teams, and clients reliable visibility into advertisers, publishers, and Ads performance—accelerating data-driven decisions on a global scale. WHAT YOU WILL DO Build and maintain robust, scalable analytical models in AWS Cloud. Participate in defining data requirements alongside product and technology teams. Develop ingestion, transformation, and data modeling pipelines using the VTEX data platform. Support stakeholders with technical and analytical topics, translating needs into practical solutions. Monitor performance, optimize queries, and ensure reliability across SQL and Python environments. Contribute to spreading best practices and driving the evolution of the data stack. WHO YOU ARE Hard Skills Familiarity with metrics and concepts from ad tech/martech platforms (campaign performance, attribution, ROAS/CTR/CPC, etc.). Experienced in data modeling for large-scale analytics. Experienced with databases and data warehouses on AWS (Athena, Trino, Redshift, etc.). Advanced SQL, Spark, and Python, along with query optimization skills. Hands-on experience with orchestration and data transformation tools (Airflow, Python, Spark, EMR, Glue, etc.). Knowledge of AWS Cloud environments (preferably Redshift, S3, Glue, EMR). Practical experience using GenAI tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, ChatGPT) to accelerate daily development, debugging, and documentation. Knowledge of semantic data layers (dbt semantic layer, LookML, Cube, etc.). Knowledge of software engineering is considered a plus. Soft Skills Excellent communication skills with the ability to engage both technical and business audiences. Analytical mindset, strong problem-solver, and results-oriented. Autonomy, proactivity, and comfort working in dynamic, iterative environments. Collaborative mindset with a strong focus on organizational impact. Curious mindset, always seeking to understand the "why" behind problems before proposing solutions. About VTEX VTEX (NYSE: VTEX) is the composable and complete commerce platform that delivers more efficiency and less maintenance to organizations seeking to make smarter IT investments and modernize their tech stack. Through our pragmatic composability approach, we empower brands, distributors, and retailers with unparalleled flexibility and comprehensive solutions, enabling them to invest solely in what provides a clear business advantage and boosts profitability. VTEX is trusted by 2,400 global B2C and B2B customers, including Carrefour, Colgate, Motorola, Sony, Stanley Black & Decker, and Whirlpool, having 3,400 active online stores across 43 countries (as of FY ended on December 31, 2024). Founded in the year 2000, VTEX has a history of being unstoppable. Completely against the odds, VTEX is leading a high-tech industry and positioned above market giants. We are building an extraordinary future with more than 1,300 employees scattered across 25 locations in 16 countries in Latin America, North America, Europe, and Asia. For more information, visit www.vtex.com . At VTEX, you will work in a challenge-driven environment and collaborate with amazing peers. If you are powerful individually, join us, and we will be unstoppable together. BENEFITS Annual profit-sharing program and equity eligibility; Health, dental, and life insurance with national coverage provided by VTEX; Annual budget for professional development in Tech; Language development incentive program (English, Spanish, Portuguese); Flexible meal allowance; Extended parental leaves; Child-care assistance; Flexible work schedule and remote-first culture; Financial assistance to build your work-from-home setup; Wellness program; Free shipping on 1000+ VTEX stores #LI-Remote

Whether collaborating with Fortune 500 giants or scaling startups, we deliver results that make a difference. By applying for this position, you’re taking the first step in joining a dynamic team that values your expertise and aspirations. We aim to align your skills with opportunities that foster exceptional career growth and success while contributing to transformative projects that shape the future. Our Client Our client is a global technology and creative network that brings together engineering and creative expertise in equal measure to help businesses drive innovation, digital transformation, and long-term growth. The Senior Data Engineer will lead technical workstreams, contribute to defining data engineering best practices, and mentor other engineers while collaborating closely with Machine Learning Engineering teams and cross-functional stakeholders to solve complex data challenges. Deep expertise in cloud data platforms, with clear, well-reasoned opinions on which work best and why Proficiency in Python and SQL for data processing and ETL Experience building and deploying data workloads in cloud environments (AWS, GCP, or Azure) Strong product orientation, with the ability to identify opportunities, prioritize initiatives, and deliver measurable business value Hands-on experience with AI-powered coding, agentic engineering, and AI-enabled workflows Proven experience mentoring others, establishing engineering standards, and contributing to a culture of learning Familiarity with marketing data ecosystems (GA4, advertising platforms, CRMs, CDPs) Solid software engineering fundamentals: version control, testing, code review, and CI/CD Strong communication skills, with the ability to work with every technical level at an organization that is 50/50 tech and creative Experience working in complex, ambiguous projects from definition through delivery Advanced English (B2 or higher) Nice to Have Experience with data governance, privacy compliance, and security best practices Experience integrating AI/ML capabilities into data pipelines, with exposure to GenAI applications Familiarity with MLOps tooling (MLflow, SageMaker, Vertex AI) and vector databases or RAG patterns Experience working across multiple verticals or client types Track record of advocating for and implementing process improvements What We Offer 100% Remote Work: Enjoy the freedom to work from the location that helps you thrive. Paid Time Off: We value your well-being. Our paid time off policies ensure you have the chance to unwind and recharge when needed. Work with Autonomy: Enjoy the freedom to manage your time as long as the work gets done. Focus on results, not the clock. Work with Top American Companies: Grow your expertise working on innovative, high-impact projects with Industry-Leading U.S. Companies. Why You’ll Like Working Here A Culture That Values You: We prioritize well-being and work-life balance, offering engagement activities and fostering dynamic teams to ensure you thrive both personally and professionally. Diverse, Global Network: Connect with over 600 professionals in 25+ countries, expand your network, and collaborate with a multicultural team from Latin America. Team Up with Skilled Professionals: Join forces with senior talent. All of our team members are seasoned experts, ensuring you're working with the best in your field. Apply now!

items.description: What Makes Cloudbeds Unique At Cloudbeds, we're not just building software, we’re transforming hospitality. Our intelligently designed platform powers properties across 150 countries, processing billions in bookings annually. From independent properties to hotel groups, we help hoteliers transform operations and uplevel their commercial strategy through a unified platform that integrates with hundreds of partners. And we do it with a completely remote team. Imagine working alongside global innovators to build AI-powered solutions that solve hoteliers' biggest challenges. Since our founding in 2012, we've become the World's Best Hotel PMS Solutions Provider and landed on Deloitte's Technology Fast 500 again in 2024, but we're just getting started. How You'll Make an Impact: We are seeking a dynamic Data Reports & Insights Analyst to join our Customer Success team. This role bridges the gap between data services and business intelligence. As a Reports & Insights Analyst, you'll help Cloudbeds customers turn raw operational and financial data into decisions they can act on. You'll build, analyze, and optimize reports across our PMS reporting suite, troubleshoot discrepancies before they become customer frustrations, and coach hoteliers on how to read metrics like ADR, RevPAR, occupancy, and channel performance with confidence. Every report you refine and every question you answer on calls or emails, directly shapes how hospitality businesses understand their own performance and grow their revenue. Our Team: Data Services sits at the intersection of hospitality expertise and reporting technology, working to make sure Cloudbeds customers never have to guess what their numbers mean. Reporting to your lead, you'll join a team that partners closely with Product, Onboarding, Support, and Customer Success to keep improving how customers access and interpret their data. It's a hands-on, collaborative group that treats every reporting question as a chance to make the platform and the customer's business a little smarter. What You Bring to the Team: You've spent time inside hotels and property management systems; you understand hospitality data isn't just numbers on a screen; it's occupancy, revenue, and guest behaviour telling a story. You're comfortable with advanced Excel or Google Sheets (pivot tables, formulas) and have worked with BI or reporting tools involving dashboards, filters, and custom reports. You communicate clearly in written and verbal English, translating technical reporting concepts into plain language for customers who may not be data experts. You're detail-oriented, adaptable to shifting priorities, and genuinely enjoy solving the puzzle when a report doesn't add up. What Sets You Up for Success: Hospitality Tech Background: Direct experience working with Hotel Property Management Systems, channel managers and similar systems Client-Facing Expertise: A proven track record in onboarding, implementation, or Tier 2/3 technical support with a natural ability to teach and guide users. Advanced Spreadsheet Proficiency: Power-user skills in Excel and Google Sheets (VLOOKUPs, Pivot Tables, advanced formulas, and data cleaning). Analytical Mindset: Strong understanding of basic data management principles, data mapping, parsing, and root-cause error analysis. Meticulous Attention to Detail: Exceptional precision when handling sensitive historical, financial, and guest records. Remote-First Readiness: Highly tech-savvy with cloud-based workflows and equipped with a reliable, high-speed internet connection for video coaching sessions. Bonus Skills to Stand Out (Optional): Multilingual Capabilities: Professional proficiency (verbal and written) in Spanish or Portuguese. BI & Analytics Familiarity: Prior experience working with business intelligence dashboards or advanced financial reporting structures. What to Expect - Your Journey with Us Behind Cloudbeds' revolutionary technology is a team of redefining what's possible in hospitality. We're 650+ employees across 40+ countries, bringing together elite engineers, AI architects, world-class designers, and hospitality veterans to solve challenges others haven't dared to tackle. Our diverse team speaks 30+ languages, but we all share one language: a passion for innovation and travel. From pioneering breakthroughs in machine learning to revolutionizing how hotels operate, we're not just watching the future of hospitality unfold – we're coding it, designing it, writing it, and shipping it. If you're ready to work alongside some of the brightest minds in tech who are obsessed with using AI to transform a trillion-dollar industry, this is your chance to be part of something extraordinary. Learn more online at cloudbeds.com Company Awards : Best All-In-One Hotel Management System | HotelTechAwards (2025) Overall 10 Best Places to Work | HotelTechAwards (2025) Most Loved Workplace® Certified (2024) Top 10 People’s Choice (2024) Deloitte Technology Fast 500 (2024) Discover our Benefits: Remote First, Remote Always PTO in accordance with local labor requirements Monthly Wellness Fridays - enjoy an extra-long weekend every month Fully Paid Parental Leave Home office stipend based on country of residency Professional development courses in Cloudbeds University Access to professional development, including manager training, upskilling and knowledge transfer Everyone is Welcome - A Culture of Inclusion Cloudbeds is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer that celebrates the diversity in our global team! We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. Cloudbeds is committed to the full inclusion of all qualified individuals. As part of this commitment, Cloudbeds will ensure that persons with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodations in the hiring process. We encourage deaf, hard-of-hearing, deaf-blind, and deaf-disabled individuals to apply. If reasonable accommodation is needed to participate in the job application or interview process or to perform essential job functions, please contact our HR team by phone at (858) 201-7832 or via email at accommodations@cloudbeds.com . Cloudbeds will provide an American Sign Language (ASL) interpreter where needed as a reasonable accommodation for the hiring processes. To all Staffing and Recruiting Agencies: Our Careers Site is only for individuals seeking a job at Cloudbeds. Staffing, recruiting agencies, and individuals being represented by an agency are not authorized to use this site or to submit applications, and any such submissions will be considered unsolicited. Cloudbeds does not accept unsolicited resumes or applications from agencies. Please do not forward resumes to our jobs alias, Cloudbeds employees, or any other company location. Cloudbeds is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes/applications. #LI-REMOTE

items.title: 🌍 Finance Research Expert, Remote- Contract
items.summary: Role Title: Finance Research Expert Role Type: Contract Location: Remote Required Skills: • Equity Research • FP&A • Corporate Finance • Accounting or Audit • Investor Relations • Credit Analysis Opportunity Snapshot: • Time per task: around 4 to 8 hours • Location: Remote, worldwide • You’ll need: Hands-on experience reading US SEC filings and familiarity with US GAAP • Your tasks: Write finance research questions with a verified, sourced answer, and check each one against what AI models answer Scope of Work: • You will work on questions about real US public companies.
items.description: Role Title: Finance Research Expert Role Type: Contract Location: Remote Required Skills: Equity Research FP&A Corporate Finance Accounting or Audit Investor Relations Credit Analysis Opportunity Snapshot: Time per task: around 4 to 8 hours Location: Remote, worldwide You’ll need: Hands-on experience reading US SEC filings and familiarity with US GAAP Your tasks: Write finance research questions with a verified, sourced answer, and check each one against what AI models answer Scope of Work: You will work on questions about real US public companies. Each question points to information that sits in long filings or IR materials, or that requires comparing several of them to find the right answer. Write questions that require finding a specific figure in a 10-K, 10-Q, 8-K, proxy statement, earnings release or investor presentation. Write questions where two documents show different numbers and the answer depends on knowing which one is correct (for example, original vs. restated figures, or adjusted vs. reported). Pay attention to period and document version: the right fiscal year, the right filing, the latest amended version. Test each question against current AI models and keep only the ones they answer incorrectly. Rewrite questions when the wording allows more than one valid answer. What we’re looking for: Hands-on work with US filings in one of these backgrounds: Equity research or investment analysis (sell-side or buy-side) covering US companies. Investment banking or corporate development. (M&A, equity capital markets), with experience in deal filings, prospectuses, ownership history and subsidiary structures. Credit or restructuring analysis, with experience in credit agreements, bond terms and bankruptcy filings. SEC reporting or audit. (Big 4 audit, corporate reporting), with experience in restatements, footnotes and how figures change across filings. Corporate law or due diligence. (Securities law, KYC, investigations), with experience tracing entities, executives and related parties across records. You should also be comfortable reading long filings, including footnotes and tables, and have clear written English. How the selection process works: Apply with your resume and a short profile. Complete the finance interview. It is a short conversation about your experience with US filings and financial reporting. You don’t need to prepare or write anything. Finishing it is what moves your application forward. Review. We check your experience against what the project needs. Onboarding and first task. If selected, you get the guidelines and start with an initial task, which is reviewed before you continue. Originally posted on Himalayas

items.description: Love PowerShell, know your way around Active Directory, and enjoy making repetitive IT tasks disappear? We might have just the role for you. Join Australia’s #1 MSP and build practical automation solutions that make IT operations simpler, faster and more reliable, all while working from home. Strong PowerShell and Active Directory scripting experience is essential. You’ll also need to work some overlapping hours with US-based teams. And yes, that means no battling Manila traffic just to attend a Teams meeting. You’re welcome. Why you’ll love this role 100% work from home: Skip the commute and collaborate with an international technology team. Meaningful work: Build automation that reduces manual effort and improves everyday IT operations. Real ownership: Improve existing processes, contribute ideas and see the impact of your work. Room to grow: Develop your automation skills alongside experienced technology professionals. 12-month contract: With the possibility of extension. What you’ll be doing You’ll use PowerShell to automate Active Directory administration , including: Developing and maintaining PowerShell scripts for everyday IT operations Automating user account creation, deletion, disabling and updates Managing AD user properties, organisational units and security group memberships through scripting Building automated onboarding, offboarding and account lifecycle workflows Troubleshooting, testing and improving scripts to ensure they’re reliable and secure Working with international teams to identify opportunities for smarter automation Working with YAML configuration files and REST APIs to support scripting, system integrations and automation workflows Because clicking through the same process 400 times a month isn’t a personality trait. It’s an automation opportunity. What we’re looking for Here’s what really matters: Strong, hands-on PowerShell scripting experience in a professional IT environment Proven experience writing scripts for Active Directory account management Experience automating user property updates and security group assignments Good understanding of AD administration, provisioning and deprovisioning Ability to develop, troubleshoot and maintain reliable PowerShell scripts Experience working with YAML and REST APIs to configure, integrate and automate IT systems and processes You’ll also need good English communication skills, a practical problem-solving mindset and the ability to work independently with some US business hours overlap . Nice to have: Active Directory migrations, Microsoft Entra ID, Microsoft 365 automation, Git or MSP experience. AI development experience isn’t required. Migration experience is a bonus, not a dealbreaker. A little about Us We’re Australia’s #1 MSP (Cloudtango, 9 years running), with over 500 staff across 4 countries. We’ve been growing for more than 15 years, and we believe in hiring capable people, trusting them to do great work and supporting them along the way. Our values Keep it Simple and Be the Solution fit this role perfectly. We love people who find smarter ways to work and take ownership of making things better. And with Never Stop Growing , we’re big believers in continuous learning, sharing knowledge and developing our people. Learn more about us: https://www.firstfocus.com.au/about-us/ Why work with us? You’ll join a supportive international Technology team where your ideas matter and the solutions you build make a genuine difference. You’ll enjoy 100% remote working from the Philippines , opportunities to develop your technical skills, collaboration with experienced professionals and meaningful automation projects. This is a 12-month internal contract with the possibility of extension , requiring some overlap with US business hours. Sound like your kind of role? If you’ve built PowerShell scripts that automate Active Directory accounts, user properties and group memberships, we’d love to hear from you. You don’t need to know every technology under the sun. Just bring your scripting skills, curiosity and a genuine desire to make things work better. Apply now and help us make repetitive IT tasks a thing of the past. Neurodiversity: First Focus welcomes applications from Neurodiverse candidates. We recommend & appreciate disclosure along with the application so that a copy of our Neurodiversity Statement can be provided outlining the flexible options we can offer to best showcase your skills. AI in Recruitment: We use AI-assisted recruitment tools to support application review. These tools do not make hiring decisions. All applications are handled by our recruitment team in compliance with the Philippine Data Privacy Act.

items.description: KnowBe4 empowers the modern workforce to make smarter security decisions every day. Trusted by more than 70,000 organizations worldwide, KnowBe4 is the pioneer of digital workforce security, securing both AI agents and humans. The KnowBe4 Platform provides attack simulation and training, collaboration security, and agent security powered by AIDA (Artificial Intelligence Defense Agents) and a proprietary Risk Score. The platform leverages 15-years of behavioral data to combat advanced threats including social engineering, prompt injection, and shadow AI. By securing humans and agents, KnowBe4 leads the industry in workforce trust and defense. Position open to candidates located in Brazil . Please submit your resume in English. To learn more about our team and office culture in São Paulo, Brazil, visit the following links. Careers Page: https://www.knowbe4.com/careers/locations/sao-paulo Glassdoor : https://www.glassdoor.com/Location/KnowBe4-S%C3%A3o-Paulo-Location-EI_IE969384.0,7_IL[…]M_-C1lsxoZq7Cx8IriVE8MkrzuTmnJzqego77RAWZz9sqGt_55BflwYKpQeg LinkedIn : https://www.linkedin.com/company/knowbe4/life/brazil/ This is a Data Platform Engineering seat. Your mission is to build the tooling, infrastructure, and pipelines that allow engineering and product teams to self-serve while reliably delivering high-integrity data to customer-facing applications, internal reporting, ML models, and autonomous AI agents. You will join the core team behind our data platform: an event-driven lakehouse on AWS handling tens of thousands of events per second. You will design, build, and operate the near-real-time pipelines that model product and service events through medallion layers using open table formats and analytical engines, delivered as strictly tested, peer-reviewed, and version-controlled software. We build with agents, for agents: Our platform is itself agentic. We actively develop and maintain skills and AI agents that scaffold new pipelines, monitor upstream repositories and tickets for data-contract changes before they break downstream systems, autonomously triage alerts, and assist with cross-repo code reviews. Key Responsibilities Architect, deploy, and operate production near real-time streaming workloads on AWS from ingestion to analytical serving layers. Model complex event streams through bronze/silver/gold medallion architectures using modern open table formats (Delta Lake, Apache Iceberg). Implement robust checkpointing, state recovery, schema evolution, and deduplication to safeguard against silent data corruption and ordering anomalies. Develop internal developer agents and automation loops (scaffolding, change detection, quality circuit breakers, and alert triage). Spot platform bottlenecks, architectural debt, or emerging technologies before anyone files a ticket—scope the solution and champion it to production. Requirements & Qualifications Experience owning production Spark streaming workloads, including orchestration, checkpointing, monitoring, alerting and failure recovery. Python you’d put your name on: tested, typed, reviewed and shipped through CI. AWS fluency and comfort reading and changing infrastructure as code. Hands-on experience with modern table formats, including upserts, schema evolution and the maintenance they need. Strong data modelling judgement, including knowing the tradeoffs and limits of a design. Experience with event-stream or CDC ingestion, and the de-duplication and ordering problems that come with it. The ability to take a vague stakeholder request, work out the real question, come back with a design, and explain the result and its caveats to people who don’t read code. The judgement to spot what the platform needs before anyone files a ticket, scope it and make the case for it, including new technologies where they would serve us better. A track record of raising the bar around you: reviewing, mentoring and setting conventions a team actually follows. Interest in or experience building, agentic tooling for engineering work itself: scaffolding, change detection, triage and review loops. Clear verbal and written English communication skills to collaborate effectively across international teams. Our Fantastic Benefits We offer company-wide bonuses based on monthly sales targets, employee referral bonuses, adoption assistance, tuition reimbursement, certification reimbursement, and certification completion bonuses - all in a modern, high-tech, and fun work environment. For more details about our benefits in each office location, please visit www.knowbe4.com/careers/benefits . Note: An applicant assessment and background check may be part of your hiring procedure. Individuals seeking employment at KnowBe4 are considered without prejudice to race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, sexual orientation or any other characteristic protected under applicable federal, state, or local law. If you require reasonable accommodation in completing this application, interviewing, completing any pre-employment testing, or otherwise participating in the employee selection process, please visit www.knowbe4.com/careers/request-accommodation. No recruitment agencies, please.

Join Our Growing Team - Future Opportunities Await! We are excited to share that our company is experiencing significant growth and expansion, and as a result, we’re on the lookout for talented individuals to join our team. We want to be upfront about our hiring process. At this moment, we are in the process of securing projects that align with our business goals and objectives. Our intention is to ensure that once we bring new team members on board, they will have a meaningful and impactful role to play from day one. While we might not be able to extend an offer immediately, we are highly interested in considering you for these future projects. If you’re open to the idea of potentially joining our team in the future, we encourage you to continue with our interview process. We value your time and effort and believe that getting to know you better will help us make an informed decision. Once you have effectively concluded the entire recruitment procedure, we will retain your profile and reach out to you once a suitable opportunity emerges. Additional interviews will not be necessary at this stage, and we anticipate being able to extend an offer to you promptly. What does the recruitment process look like? Recruiter Screen In the first call, our recruiter will learn more about you and your story to check a potential fit for gravity9. This is also an opportunity to ask your questions about the role and company. This step might take around 60 mins. 2. Tech 1 Interview with our software consultants In this meeting your potential future teammate will take a deeper dive into your experience and what you could bring to the team. This step will take around 90 mins. 3. Tech 2 Interview with our tech leads In this meeting your potential future teammate will take a deeper dive into your experience and what you could bring to the team. This step will take around 90 mins. 4. Final Interview You made it to the very last stage! Here we already strive to cooperate with you and give you an opportunity to meet our leadership team during this informal talk. This step will take around 30 mins. items.description: Here at Ooma we empower people to connect in smarter ways. We do this by creating powerful communication experiences through our cloud-based platform to bring people together at work and at home. Our solutions help small business owners stay connected with their customers and manage their businesses from anywhere. For larger companies we provide customized unified communications solutions to meet their unique needs. At home, we help our customers connect with their loved ones by providing the #1 rated VoIP phone service available. We also provide them with peace of mind through our innovative smart home security solution. At Ooma, all our products and services are priced competitively, because we believe advanced technology should be accessible to all. About the Role: As Senior Telephony Engineer, you’ll own the technical direction and reliability of Phone.com’s voice platform, helping business customers stay connected. You’ll combine hands-on engineering with architecture and technical leadership across our voice, cloud, and data center infrastructure. Working with a small team of engineers and contractors, you’ll guide technical decisions, improve performance, and strengthen platform resilience through automation, documentation, and tested recovery plans. What You’ll Do: Lead the design and optimization of the Kamailio, OpenSIPS, and FreeSWITCH SIP platform, including call routing, registration, and media handling. Own SIP trunking, carrier integrations, and least-cost and failover routing across carriers. Set technical standards, review designs and code, and make architecture decisions for voice services. Own reliability, monitoring, alerting, and capacity planning for data center servers and multi-region AWS environments. Design and test failover and disaster recovery for session border controllers, proxies, media servers, and carrier links. Monitor call quality and platform health, including MOS, jitter, packet loss, and answer-seizure ratio; lead corrective action, incident response, and blameless postmortems, and participate in the on-call rotation. Plan telephony software upgrades, patching, and data center hardware lifecycle management. Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure as code using Terraform and Ansible; improve observability with Prometheus, Grafana, logs, and packet captures, and apply automation and AI-assisted troubleshooting to reduce detection and resolution time. Direct the day-to-day technical work of the VoIP engineer and code and DevOps contractors; maintain architecture documentation, runbooks, and change records to eliminate dependence on any one person. Manage carrier and infrastructure vendors, including SLAs, escalations, and technical evaluations; partner with product, support, NOC, and security teams on releases, incidents, and PCI DSS, SOC 2, and HIPAA compliance. Experience We’re Looking For: 8+ years of voice, telecom, or infrastructure engineering experience is required, including production operations for carrier-grade or highly available services. This role requires hands-on production experience with Kamailio or OpenSIPS and FreeSWITCH, deep knowledge of SIP, SDP, and RTP, and the ability to troubleshoot signaling and media issues using packet captures and logs. Candidates need experience designing and operating multi-region AWS environments—including IAM, VPC networking, compute, containers, and Lambda—and running production Linux at scale with containerized workloads and Kubernetes or equivalent. Experience with Ansible and CI/CD pipelines is required; Python or Bash scripting for automation and tooling is preferred. Working knowledge of BGP, OSPF, and carrier interconnects is required. Candidates need experience setting technical direction and reviewing engineers’ or contractors’ work, along with clear written and verbal communication during incidents and with vendors. A bachelor’s degree in information technology, computer science, or a related field, or equivalent experience, is required. Experience owning data center operations during a cloud migration, including hardware lifecycle and capacity planning, is preferred, as is a track record of reducing infrastructure costs through right-sizing, containers, or serverless services. Experience building an observability platform or Network Operations Center using Prometheus, Grafana, or similar tools is preferred. Experience applying LLM-assisted troubleshooting, AIOps, or retrieval-augmented generation to operations is also preferred. Experience supporting PCI DSS, SOC 2, ISO 27001, or HIPAA controls on communications platforms is preferred, as is experience with emergency calling (911 and E911) or other regulated telephony obligations. AWS Solutions Architect, CCNA, Juniper, or Asterisk certifications are preferred. What We Offer: Working at Ooma means being a team player, while allowing your individual voice to come through. And, you’ll receive competitive compensation, benefits and generous company perks. Comprehensive Medical/Dental/Vision insurance for you and eligible dependents HMO, PPO’s or a PPO with a HDHP (including HSA, which Ooma helps fund) Employer Paid Income Protection Benefits (Basic Life and AD&D, Short- and Long-term disability) FSA Healthcare & Dependent Care Commuter Benefits Voluntary Accident, Critical Illness, Hospital Indemnity and Legal 401(k), including employer match, and Roth Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP) Paid Time off, Sick Time, as well as corporate holidays observed Employee Assistance Program Life Balance benefits with Travel Assistance Services and Identity Theft Additional Benefits include a Discount Program, Credit Union, Medicare Assistance, etc. #LI-CC1 Ooma is an equal-opportunity employer committed to recruiting, employing, retaining, promoting, and otherwise treating all employees on the basis of merit, qualifications, and competence. We do not discriminate on the basis of any trait or characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local laws. All interviews are conducted via video. To be considered for a role, candidates must participate in all interviews with their camera enabled, subject to reasonable accommodation. Candidates who need an accommodation should contact their recruiter. We may utilize AI-enabled tools during the hiring process, including for resume review, scheduling, and interview note-taking or transcription. These tools are used solely to support our hiring team; all employment decisions are made by human reviewers. Where interviews are recorded or transcribed, candidates will be notified in advance and their consent will be obtained. The base salary range for candidates within the United States is listed below. Actual base pay will depend on a variety of factors such as education, skills, experience, specific location, etc. The base pay range is subject to change and may be modified in the future. items.description: iFIT ’s vision is to create the world's most holistic health and fitness platform, integrating all elements of health - physical fitness, mental health, nutrition and active recovery - into a seamless interactive experience. We develop proprietary software that learns and adjusts to the habits of each person as it delivers immersive content that guides them on their own individual fitness journey. We're hiring a Director, Digital Analytics & Experimentation to own the numbers behind our direct-to-consumer business on nordictrack.com. This is an AI-first, global role spanning analytics, reporting, forecasting and experimentation, with subscription growth and the customer journey at the center. Leaders across the company make spending, pricing and merchandising decisions on your numbers. Why join iFIT and NordicTrack Connected fitness is a growing category at the center of health and wellness, and iFIT and NordicTrack are right in it. We sell more than equipment: the iFIT membership keeps customers training, so every conversion, test and forecast is a lifetime-value decision, not a one-time sale. As our Director, you'll be the person leadership turns to for what's working, what's next and what it's worth, with a direct line to the executives making the calls. You'll shape the nordictrack.com experience, grow customer lifetime value, and help us move to a new AI-driven personalization platform. We expect AI in every part of the job, to move faster and surface opportunities manual analysis would miss. What you'll do The role splits roughly evenly across three areas, and you own the integrity of all three. Analytics and data Pull and validate data from web analytics, order, media and finance sources, and keep documented KPI definitions as one source of truth. Diagnose performance changes by traffic source, product and funnel step, and make recommendations supported by quantified evidence. Track, analyze and report on our subscription economics, including customer lifetime value (LTV) and the annual iFIT subscription attach rate, and show what moves them. Map the customer journey from first visit through purchase and subscription, find what drives conversion and what blocks it, and tell us where to optimize first. Reporting and forecasting Own the daily, weekly and monthly performance reporting and the dashboards behind it, including LTV and subscription attach. Prepare executive-ready summaries of results versus plan and prior year, with the drivers behind each variance. Build and maintain the full P&L forecast for the DTC business, from traffic, conversion and subscription attach through revenue, margin and marketing spend, including media mix. Reconcile forecasts to actuals and finance, explain every variance, refresh the outlook regularly, and model scenarios (promotions, media shifts, pricing) with the assumptions written down. Experimentation and CRO Run the testing program end to end, from hypothesis and design to QA, readout and decision, and prioritize tests by their potential to lift conversion. Report test results with the correct statistical method, and state clearly what a result can and cannot support. Track the cumulative revenue and conversion impact of shipped tests. Help improve our personalization program by measuring what works, where it falls short and where to expand it. You will partner closely with marketing, digital product, site merchandising and finance, and manage and develop one direct report. What you bring 8+ years in analytics, at least 5 in ecommerce, DTC or subscription businesses, with people management experience. Proficient in SQL and experienced using AI across daily analytics work to move faster and find new opportunities, with the judgment to validate what it produces. Proven experience running a statistically rigorous experimentation program, with strong CRO instincts for what drives conversion and what blocks it. Experience building P&L or revenue forecasts and reconciling them to finance or ERP actuals. A proven record of accurate, reconciled numbers, with QA habits you can describe, and the ability to explain a number, its source and its caveats to executives. Hands-on experience with session analytics and multi-touch attribution tools, such as FullStory and Rockerbox. What success looks like in year one Your work drives measurable top-line and bottom-line growth, through higher conversion, subscription attach and customer lifetime value. A prioritized roadmap of customer journey and CRO improvements is live, with measured conversion lift. Leadership trusts the numbers without double-checking them: core KPI definitions are documented, reported figures tie to finance, and forecasts land close to actuals. AI is embedded in how you analyze, forecast and report, freeing time for higher-value work and surfacing new opportunities. DISCLAIMER Compensation may vary based on the job level, your geographic work location, position incentive plan, and exemption status. Although we currently may consider hiring in the states listed below, not all positions are available in all locations, and work in a particular state is not guaranteed. items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: New York, New York, United States URL: https://sweetspothvac.com/ About SweetSpot Heating & Cooling SweetSpot is a growing home-services company in the New York metro, and we are building our creative team from zero. This is the number one creative seat in the company, not a slot in a large agency hierarchy. The strategist hired here owns the function, works directly with the owner, and has a real path to leading the team as we scale. About the role We are hiring a creative strategist who will own paid ad creative end to end: research, angles, hooks, scripts, briefing creators and editors, and the learnings that turn winners into the next batch. This is not a "make pretty ads" role and it is not strategy-only. You will direct really strong video editors and UGC creators, and you will use AI (including Claude Code) as your production engine for research, hooks, scripts and variants. We are honest about the level this role is hired at: we are looking for strong raw talent with real direct-response instincts who wants ownership and serious training, and who wants to grow into a top-tier strategist with us. You will get mentorship, a proven creative system, and weekly learnings reviews. In return we expect pace, curiosity, and work you can defend. What you will do Build the research base first: homeowner avatars, desires, objections, competitors, and our own ad account history. No angles before research. Plan concepts in a structured roadmap, each with angle, avatar, desire, mechanism, authority, awareness level, emotion, positioning and urgency. Write hooks and scripts built for the first 3 seconds: one desire, one avatar, one message per ad. Brief UGC creators and editors so clearly they can execute with no follow-up call, and review their work to a finished, launch-ready ad. Run the testing system: from one winning angle, build structured iterations where each variation tests something named. Run the learnings: label every ad (Breakthrough, Spend Winner, KPI Winner, Loser), state why it performed, and turn that into the next round. Hit 20 to 30 finished, launch-ready ads per month at full pace, working with our editors and AI workflows. What we are looking for Direct-response ad experience: you have written ads that ran as paid social (Meta or TikTok) and you can show them. A testing system, not just good taste. You can explain how you turn one winner into 20 variations. Research discipline. Your hooks trace to evidence, not guesses. AI fluency: you already use AI tools in your creative workflow and can show how. Execution: you have briefed creators or managed editors and shipped finished ads. Ownership mindset: you talk about business outcomes, not just outputs delivered, and you close feedback loops: you learn, you apply, you show what changed. Local services or lead generation experience is a plus, not a requirement. Seasonal urgency, emergency calls, proof and trust are the game here. Pay and structure Contract (1099), remote, month-to-month: $4,000 to $8,000 per month, 40 hours per week, based on experience. Performance bonus structure discussed after the trial month, tied to winning ads. Growth path: this seat grows into leading the creative team. One of the paths we model is editor or strategist to team lead as spend scales. Our hiring process (exactly how it works) Short application: portfolio of ads you wrote that actually ran, plus 3 short answers (your testing system on a real winner; one ad you iterated and what it tested; your AI workflow). Interview 1 (30 minutes): screening and craft in one call, run as a working session on your past ads: what did you learn, how did you apply it, what feedback loops did you complete. Paid test: $100 flat, 48 hours, capped at 4 hours of work, paid regardless of outcome. A short research snapshot, hooks, scripts, an iteration plan and an execution plan for a real scenario. Interview 2 (final, with the owner): we walk your test together and you defend your choices. References are checked after this call (we will ask to speak with one past employer). Two interviews total, no more. Paid 30-day trial at your full agreed monthly rate, with daily contact, mentorship and a weekly check-in. Written decision at day 30. We hire off the test and the trial, not the interview. If you are the kind of strategist who would rather prove it than pitch it, apply. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/sweetspot-heating-and-cooling-creative-strategist-ai-native-direct-response
