This role balances strategic ownership with hands-on execution. The Senior Website Manager should be comfortable setting priorities, managing stakeholders, improving governance, and jumping into the details of site updates, QA, analytics, campaign launches, and CMS operations when needed. This is a hands-on role. The manager will build and edit pages in Webflow, troubleshoot tracking and form issues, and review agency work in the code and configuration, not just in screenshots. Key Responsibilities Migration Ownership — Take ownership of Veracode’s in-flight migration from WordPress to Webflow and drive it through launch and post launch stabilization. Align stakeholders, leadership, and agency partners on scope, timelines, deliverables, dependencies, risks, and success criteria. Validate and lead work on content and URL audits, redirect mapping, SEO/GEO/AEO preservation, analytics, integration testing and launch planning. Day-to-Day Site Management — Manage daily website operations, intake, prioritization, page updates, QA, publishing, troubleshooting, and stakeholder requests while maintaining high standards for accuracy, usability, performance, and brand consistency. Data and Analytics — Use GA4, Google Tag Manager, heatmaps, dashboards, and campaign data to monitor traffic, behavior, conversions, attribution, and funnel performance, then translate insights into optimization priorities. Content Governance and Quality Control — Maintain site content standards, taxonomy, metadata, redirects, page ownership, review cycles, archival processes, and content hygiene so the website stays accurate, discoverable, compliant, and easy to maintain. Strategic Roadmap and Vision — Architect and execute web strategies that incorporate AI-enabled personalization, SEO, GEO, campaign performance, content experience, and conversion optimization to drive traffic, engagement, and pipeline impact. Design Strategy & Governance — Lead visual and UX evolution, ensuring designs align with brand identity; manage scalable design systems, wireframes/prototypes (e.g., Figma), and trends like micro-interactions, organic layouts, and performance-driven creativity. Own the translation of Figma designs into Webflow components and templates. Conversion-First UX & AI-Enhanced Personalization — Direct user journeys for high-stakes pages; implement AI-driven adaptive experiences and A/B testing to optimize funnels. Privacy, Consent, Accessibility and Compliance — Partner with legal, security, and marketing operations to manage cookie consent, privacy requirements, data collection standards, accessibility, and compliance needs across website experiences. As a security company, our site is held to a high bar for security hygiene, accessibility and privacy. Performance Optimization — Use Core Web Vitals monitoring, A/B and multivariate testing, heatmaps, and performance insights to balance rich visual experiences with site speed and continuously improve funnel performance. Reporting and Executive Visibility — Establish recurring website performance reporting, dashboards, insights, and recommendations that connect website activity to pipeline, campaign impact, SEO performance, conversion trends, and business priorities. SEO, GEO and Growth Management — Lead technical SEO, GEO, keyword strategy, and content performance to improve organic visibility across traditional and generative search experiences. Technical Oversight — Manage Webflow, WordPress, or similar enterprise CMS environments, and coordinate with IT and development teams on infrastructure, security, bugs, integrations, and new features. Manage WordPress through sunset and Webflow as the long-term platform, including CMS structure, permissions, hosting, and custom code. Website Release Management and QA — Own launch readiness for new pages, templates, campaigns, integrations, and site changes, including requirements intake, testing, stakeholder approvals, rollback planning, documentation, and post-launch monitoring. Cross-Functional Leadership — Partner with marketing, creative, product marketing, demand generation, marketing operations, IT, sales, agencies, and vendors to gather requirements, align priorities, manage dependencies, communicate tradeoffs, and deliver website initiatives on time. Vendor and Agency Partnership — Act as the primary liaison for web development partners and agencies. Scope projects, manage timelines and deliverables, conduct quality reviews, and ensure external teams align with Veracode standards, brand guidelines, accessibility expectations, and strategic objectives. Hold agencies accountable to defined acceptance criteria and evaluate their technical work independently. Marketing Automation Integration — Work with marketing ops to ensure seamless ties with Marketo forms, lead capture, and CRM (Salesforce). This role gathers business, technical, design, campaign, and content requirements to deliver high-performing website experiences. You will administer infrastructure, manage CMS operations, build scalable templates and interactive experiences, publish content, improve governance, and continuously optimize site performance. Required Skills & Qualifications 8–10+ years in web management, digital marketing, or web program management, with strong emphasis on strategy, design oversight, and growth. Experience leading a full CMS migration for a large B2B site (hundreds of pages or more), including redirect mapping, SEO preservation, and tracking validation. Strong experience with GA4, Google Tag Manager, UTM strategies, SEO and GEO tools (SEMrush, Ahrefs, Screaming Frog), and CRO (A/B testing, heatmaps like Hotjar). Knowledge of HTML, CSS, JavaScript, PHP, MySQL; frontend literacy (e.g., CSS Grid/Flexbox, animations). Familiarity with website security, ADA/WCAG compliance (accessibility-first design), performance optimization, and 2026 trends like AI personalization and immersive interactivity. Proven project management skills (e.g., Jira, Asana); experience managing agencies, vendors, in-house teams (development/design). Strong analytical mindset; ability to present performance, design, and growth reports to executives. Stakeholder management and cross-functional collaboration expertise. Experience with Marketo and Salesforce form/CRM integrations. Webflow Enterprise experience is a plus. Examples of A/B Testing Strategies This Role Might Lead Headline/CTA variations on landing pages to boost conversions (e.g., testing benefit-focused vs. feature-focused copy). Layout changes (e.g., grid vs. organic/asymmetric) or visual elements (e.g., hero images/videos, micro-animations) for engagement/time-on-page. Form optimization (e.g., multi-step vs. single-page) or personalization (e.g., AI-segmented content) for lead capture. Button colors/sizes/text or navigation tweaks to improve click-through and funnel progression. Compensation Transparency: The total compensation package includes an anticipated base salary range of $125,000–$140,000, along with comprehensive benefits. The base salary offered to the selected candidate, including the candidate’s position within the salary range, will be determined based on a variety of factors, including job-related knowledge, education, skills, experience, and other business considerations. The published salary range represents the Company’s good-faith estimate of the compensation range at the time of posting. Employment opportunities are available to all applicants without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. Fraudulent Recruitment Alert - Be Aware and Stay Informed At Veracode, we prioritize a secure recruitment process. Unfortunately, fake recruitment and job offer scams are on the rise. They aim to deceive candidates through emails and calls to obtain sensitive information. Here’s our recruitment promise to you: Comprehensive Interview Process: We never extend job offers without a comprehensive interview process involving our recruitment team and hiring managers. Offer Communications: Our job offers are not sent solely through email, and we will never ask you to pay for your own hardware. Email Verification: Recruiting emails from Veracode will always originate from an “@veracode.com" email address. If you have any doubts about the authenticity of an email, letter, or telephone communication claiming to be from Veracode, please reach out to us at careers@veracode.com before taking any further action. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/veracode-senior-website-manager

items.description: Who we are: Financeit is a point-of-sale financing provider serving some of the largest home improvement and retail organizations in Canada. Our platform helps businesses close more sales by offering customers affordable monthly payment options for their next big home improvement, vehicle or retail purchase. We are small enough that you can make an impact within the company and large enough to make an impact in the market. Financeit is a company where collaboration, inclusivity, fairness, and respect aren’t just ideas that get talked about, but are part of who we are. If such a workplace intrigues you, we hope you’ll join us. About the role: As our Merchant Fraud Investigator, you’ll be our primary defense economic crimes, syndicated financial operations, and collusive merchant entities. Focusing explicitly on business-level risk rather than consumer borrower fraud, you’ll dig beneath the surface of suspicious merchant profiles, conduct deep-dive forensic investigations, and analyze high-risk transaction trends. Partnering closely with Sales, Operations, and Risk leadership, you’ll own merchant disposition decisions, enforcing critical control to protect the business from large-scale losses. What you’ll be doing: Perform deep-dive forensic reviews on suspicious merchants to verify corporate ownership, legitimate operations, and physical footprints. Track active merchant accounts to catch anomalies, including sudden transaction spikes, early defaults, and chargeback trends. Discover and trace complex shell company structures, identify ultimate beneficial owners (UBOs), and uncover illicit financial flows. Drive complex fraud cases from initial detection to final resolution, presenting risk exposures and recommendations to executive leadership. Lead decisions on high-risk merchant actions, including account terminations, funding holds, and risk mitigation strategies. Collaborate with Risk, Sales, and Operations leaders to enforce critical merchant controls, from volume caps to immediate offboarding. Refine fraud detection rules, onboarding flags, and verification tools to continuously strengthen our defenses. Investigate undetected fraud incidents to recover funds, close operational gaps, and upgrade our internal security frameworks. Leverage OSINT, fraud bureaus, and industry networks to uncover emerging schemes and syndicated fraud rings. Act as the primary investigative liaison for Legal, law enforcement, and insurance providers to deliver comprehensive evidentiary filings and loss reporting. Bachelor’s degree in Business, Criminology, Criminal Justice, or a related discipline. Certified Fraud Examiner (CFE), Certified Anti-Money Laundering Specialist (CAMS), Forensic Accounting credentials, or equivalent industry credentials preferred. 5+ years of specialized experience in fraud case management, financial crimes investigations, or commercial payment risk management. Proficient in evidence gathering, tracing funds, analyzing banking ledgers, identifying money laundering typologies and investigating processes. Strong proficiency in OSINT techniques, link-analysis tools, Canadian corporate registries, and Excel/Google Sheets, with the ability to navigate BI dashboards (Looker) and run basic data queries (or partner with analytics) to spot merchant anomalies. Established community member across peer risk organizations, law enforcement agencies, acquirer forums, and industry fraud working groups. Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with proven experience presenting detailed evidentiary findings to executive leadership, legal teams, and law enforcement. Benefits Winner of Canada’s Most Admired Corporate Cultures, twice. We offer more than just the basics, take advantage of: An award-winning culture with a collaborative & inclusive team. Competitive pay and performance-based bonus: Annual Base Salary: $90,000 - $110,000 Annual Bonus: 20% Committed to flexible work arrangements, offering hybrid workplace options. Comprehensive medical, dental and vision coverage + Lifestyle Account. RRSP Matching and Parental Leave Top UP Program. In office massage, meditation & workout sessions. Virtual events such as Lunch & Learns, company parties, fun team activities and charity initiatives. Career learning and development programs. Next Steps: If what you just read excites you, we’d like to hear from you! Please submit your application and we’ll contact you if you are selected to move forward in the process. _Financeit is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diverse backgrounds and perspectives because we know they make our team stronger and our product better. We hire based on talent, potential, and culture add - no matter your background, identity, or life experience, you are welcome here._ We may use AI to support our hiring process. While these tools assist our team, applications are ultimately reviewed and assessed by our recruiters. If you require accommodation at any stage of the recruitment process, please let our People Success team know. Please note that this posting is for an existing vacancy, and all employment offers are contingent upon a successful background and credit check, among other verifications.

You'll work alongside our creative strategists, creative teams and product team, using evidence to turn great ideas into results for global brands.

items.title: P2P Regional Operations - Africa
items.summary: About Us Established in 2018, Bybit is one of the worldâs leading cryptocurrency exchanges and digital financial platforms, serving over 80 million users across more than 200 countries and regions. Powered by world-class technology and a user-first mindset, Bybit delivers a seamless ecosystem across trading, payments, wealth management, custody, institutional services, and Web3 â connecting users to the future of digital finance. Â Our core values define how we build. We listen, care and improve to create products and experiences that put users first. Backed by a global team of ambitious builders, problem-solvers, and innovators, we foster a high-performance and fast-moving environment where talent is empowered to drive real impact at the global scale. Supported by 24/7 multilingual customer service and a strong commitment to innovation, we are shaping the future of finance through technology, collaboration, and bold execution. Â Today, Bybit is recognized as one of the most trusted and transparent platforms in the digital asset industry, continuing to expand its global presence while building the infrastructure for the next generation of financial services. About the Role As part of the Bybit Fiat team, we are looking for a P2P Regional Operations Manager to own regional growth strategy and day-to-day operational performance in Africa. You will lead a small team of regional Business Development specialists, partner closely with local teams on the ground, and serve as the regional growth engine to accommodate global P2P strategy, develop localised strategy and turn the strategy into execution. Â Reporting to the Global P2P Operations & COE Lead, you will be accountable for P2P regional growth target, merchant ecosystem development, regional product rollouts, and cross-functional coordination across Product, Risk, Compliance, Marketing, Community, and Customer Service. This is a regional team leader role for someone who is equally comfortable in strategy thinking and solid market-level execution. Key Responsibilities Regional Operational Ownership â¢ Own day-to-day P2P business performance across Africa markets and other assigned regions. â¢ Monitor regional OKR including transaction volume, competitiveness, disputes, and fraud patterns, etc. â¢ Identify operational bottlenecks and propose data-driven solutions to improve platform efficiency and user experience. â¢ Provide localised business insights to the P2P Ops Lead, own regional strategy and contribute to product roadmap. Team Leadership â¢ Lead, coach, and develop a small team of regional Business Development managers covering target markets. â¢ Set clear targets, structured workflows, and review cadences for the BD team. â¢ Identify capability gaps and actively drive upskilling, hiring, and team development. â¢ Foster a performance-driven, collaborative, and ownership-led culture. Merchant Ecosystem Development â¢ Drive merchant onboarding, relationship management, performance tracking, incentive programs, and quality improvements across the region. â¢ Oversee and grow merchant community to maintain a healthy, active, and engaged P2P ecosystem. â¢ Serve as the primary liaison between Bybit and the regional merchant community. Cross-functional & Local Coordination â¢ Coordinate with local market teams to align operations with country-specific dynamics, regulations, and user behavior. â¢ Work with Product to communicate regional needs, test new P2P features, and support local rollout. â¢ Work with Risk and Compliance to ensure safe P2P operations (fraud prevention) and adherence to local regulatory requirements. â¢ Collaborate with Marketing and Community on regional campaigns and user education. â¢ Coordinate with Customer Service to support dispute resolution and ensure efficient handling of user cases. â¢ Execute and continuously contribute operational SOPs, working with P2P COE. Market Insights & Growth â¢ Analyze regional P2P market trends, pricing dynamics, payment methods, and competitive landscape. â¢ Surface insights from market research and merchant feedback to Product, Risk, Compliance, and CS, working with COE â¢ Lead regional P2P go-to-market initiatives and growth campaigns in partnership with Marketing. â¢ Drive execution of user acquisition initiatives and campaign rollouts What We're Looking For Must Have â¢ 5+ years of relevant experience in operations, business development, or product operations â ideally in crypto, fintech, tech., marketplaces, or adjacent sectors. â¢ 2+ years of proven experience leading or coordinating small teams. â¢ Hands-on experience operating across multiple countries or markets. â¢ Strong understanding of operational workflows, project management best practices, and structured execution. â¢ Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills â¢ Strategic thinking and analytical mindset: comfortable with dashboards, data-driven decision-making, and translating numbers into strategy and actions. â¢ Fluent in English; additional regional languages are a strong plus. â¢ Comfortable in a fast-paced, ambiguous, and rapidly evolving environment. Nice to Have â¢ Direct experience with P2P platforms, crypto exchanges, or digital asset ecosystems. â¢ Familiarity with merchant management in a marketplace or P2P environment. â¢ Exposure to risk monitoring, anti-fraud methods, KYC/KYB processes, or transaction oversight. â¢ Experience with growth campaigns, user acquisition, or market launches. â¢ Passion for blockchain, financial inclusion, and the future of decentralized finance. Why Join Us At Bybit, we are committed to fostering a supportive and enriching work environment.Â Our benefits include: - Study Growth Fund: We support your professional development and continuous learning. - Internal Events: Participate in regular team-building activities, workshops, and events designed to promote collaboration and innovation. - Global Collaboration: Be part of a diverse, international team, working alongside colleagues from around the world. - Career Advancement: Access opportunities for growth and advancement within a rapidly expanding global company. - Internal Mobility: Grow with us- Your long-term development is important to us. We offer internal job opportunities to help build your career path. Millions of companies — from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups — use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportun
items.description: All Other Remote Headquarters: San Francisco, New York, Seattle, Chicago, Atlanta, Remote in the US Who we are About Stripe Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies — from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups — use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career. About the team The Stripe Marketing organization is undergoing a fundamental transformation in how it works. We're building a team of Forward Deployed AI Accelerators (FDAs) embedded directly with marketing cohorts to make AI the default mode for all work — not an occasional tool, but the foundation of how every marketer at Stripe executes. Today, marketers are already achieving remarkable results — building their own data dashboards, creating agents that compress multi-day processes, and authoring tools that accelerate workflows. The FDA team exists to take what's working and systematically scale it across the entire marketing organization. What you'll do As a Forward Deployed AI Accelerator, you'll be embedded with a cohort of 25–45 marketers organized by functional team, shared workflow, or location. You'll build alongside them, and you'll help them fundamentally change how they operate. Your measure of success is the number of workflows you've permanently transformed and the extent to which those in your cohort start any task with an AI tool. Responsibilities Identify and document the highest-leverage workflow transformations within your cohort's day-to-day work by deeply understanding their processes and outputs Build custom tools, agents, automations, and skills tailored to each marketer's specific responsibilities Coach and partner with each marketer through a progressive journey — from awareness, to first win, to regular AI integration, to full workflow transformation, to self-sufficiency Teach marketers to build and iterate on their own tools over time, creating independence Recognize patterns across your cohort and systematically scale what works — a tool built for one marketer will be reusable for their peers Document every tool, playbook, and transformation pattern you build so the entire FDA team uses each other's work Share wins visibly within your cohort and with leadership to build momentum, inspire, and celebrate success Track individual and cohort progress rigorously against a defined maturity model, moving every marketer toward self-sustaining, AI-first work Prepare marketers for an agentic future — not just prompt writing, but designing, building, and overseeing autonomous, multi-agent workflows Who you are We're looking for people who have already lived the transformation they'll be driving for others. You've used AI to fundamentally change how work gets done, not as a novelty, but as your default operating mode. You are a deep AI practitioner. You build agents, automations, and tools fluently. You don't just know what AI can do in theory. You've built things that changed how real teams operate, and the people you built for actually use what you shipped. You build in real time alongside the people you support. You spot transformation opportunities and execute on them. You look at a team's workflows and see where AI changes the economics: where existing work can be done in a fraction of the time, or where entirely new programs become viable that weren't worth doing before. Then you build the thing, not just the slide. You understand marketing work. You either have direct experience in marketing or quickly learn the workflows, deliverables, tools, and pressures of your assigned cohort. You know that understanding someone's work is a prerequisite to transforming it. You are a pattern recognizer. When you build something that works for one person, you immediately see how it applies to others. You think in systems, not one-off solutions. You are a strong communicator. You explain technical concepts clearly to non-technical audiences, adapt your style to different people, and make progress visible to leadership and stakeholders. You are high-caliber, persistent, and versatile. Your skills and experience are valuable across the company. You're the kind of person who succeeds in many roles at Stripe. You bias toward action and speed. You'd rather show someone a working proof-of-concept on their own deliverable today than present a polished deck about what's theoretically possible next quarter. You are comfortable with ambiguity and evolution. This is a new team building a new operating model. The playbook will be rewritten as we learn. You thrive in that environment. Minimum requirements 5+ years of professional experience in a role requiring diagnostic thinking, problem-solving, and cross-functional collaboration Demonstrated, hands-on experience building and deploying AI-powered agents, tools, automations, or workflows that real people use in their actual work, whether that made existing processes meaningfully more efficient or made previously unviable work possible for the first time Proficiency with AI development tools and platforms (e.g., Claude Code, Codex, custom agent frameworks, API integrations, workflow automation tools) Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical audiences and adapt your style to different learners Comfort working across multiple workstreams and relationships simultaneously (you'll be supporting 25–45 marketers at varying stages of their AI journey) Track record of coaching, teaching, or enabling others, with evidence that people you've helped actually changed how they work Preferred qualifications Experience in a formal AI transformation role where the job was substantially about identifying opportunities for workflow transformation and executing on them with hands-on builds Experience helping people become more expert AI users and capable builders Experience in marketing, marketing operations, growth, or a closely adjacent function, including familiarity with marketing technology stacks (e.g., Marketo, Salesforce, analytics platforms, content management tools) To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/stripe-ai-transformation-lead-marketing

items.description: Full-Stack Programming Headquarters: URL: http://cmswa.com Custom Mechanical Solutions delivers energy-efficient HVAC systems across the Pacific Northwest, with deep expertise in healthcare, education, data centers, and retrofit projects. We work with top manufacturers to meet performance and sustainability goals—always focused on quality, care, and progress. If you're ready to grow your career, we’re glad you found us. At CMS, you’ll join a team that supports your development and gives you space to make an impact. We review every application carefully and appreciate your interest in growing your career with our team. About Custom Mechanical Solutions Custom Mechanical Solutions (CMS) provides commercial HVAC equipment and technical solutions for complex building applications. We partner with contractors, engineers, building owners, and manufacturers throughout the equipment lifecycle—from system design and delivery through startup, troubleshooting, and field support. As part of the Meriton family of companies, CMS maintains its specialized technical expertise and customer-focused approach while benefiting from the resources and long-term investment of a growing national organization. Title: Quality & Reliability Engineer Department: CMS National Accounts Location: Fully remote within the United States Travel: Approximately 10–20% domestic and international travel Turn field challenges into better products, stronger processes, and more reliable outcomes. Join a growing National Accounts team where your technical judgment, curiosity, and follow-through will connect the jobsite to the factory and help shape how quality is managed as the business scales. The opportunity CMS is looking for a Quality & Reliability Engineer to own and continuously improve the field-to-factory quality feedback loop for custom commercial and industrial HVAC equipment. You will lead technical investigations, turn incomplete field information into clear problem statements, and keep root-cause and corrective-action work moving through verified closure. This is a hands-on, highly collaborative role. You will work across field operations, project teams, customers, engineering, manufacturing, suppliers, and factory quality leaders. Your work will help teams respond faster, create repeatable repairs, reduce recurrence, and apply lessons learned to future projects. Work from where you are. This is a fully remote position that can be based anywhere within the United States. Approximately 10-20% domestic and international travel is expected, including travel to customer sites and manufacturing facilities in Mexico. Travel may be heavier initially while you build relationships with key stakeholders and learn the factory systems. Travel to Mexico is generally expected up to four times per year to support investigations, gather technical evidence, collaborate with factory teams, and validate corrective actions. What you will own Lead field-to-factory investigations. Coordinate quality issues from initial report through containment, root cause, corrective action, and verified closure. Turn field intelligence into action. Gather the technical evidence needed for faster decisions and translate recurring trends into improvements in design, manufacturing, supplier controls, installation guidance, training, and documentation. Create field-ready solutions. Develop clear, controlled Field Service Bulletins with approved repair steps, safety requirements, acceptance criteria, and closeout evidence. Drive clarity and accountability. Keep owners, milestones, risks, decisions, and overdue actions visible. Remove blockers and escalate high-impact or aging issues when needed. Use data to improve the program. Maintain quality dashboards and reports, identify systemic trends and emerging risks, and provide concise updates to leadership, project teams, customers, and factory partners. Go where the evidence is. Travel to customer sites and manufacturing facilities in Mexico to inspect equipment, support troubleshooting, gather evidence, collaborate with factory teams, and validate repair effectiveness. You will probably love this role if... When something fails, your first question is “Why?” and you keep digging until the evidence supports the answer. You enjoy both the technical details and the bigger picture, from walking a jobsite and troubleshooting equipment to explaining the path forward clearly. You take ownership without waiting for every step to be laid out, bring the right people together, and keep work moving until the issue is truly closed. You are comfortable influencing across teams, even when you do not directly manage the people involved. You want to help build and improve a quality program, not simply maintain one. Required qualifications A bachelor's degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Industrial, Manufacturing, or Quality Engineering, or an equivalent combination of technical education and relevant professional experience. At least three years of relevant experience in manufacturing quality, field service, commissioning, reliability engineering, technical investigations, or related technical project support. Strong mechanical and/or electrical investigation and troubleshooting skills. Working knowledge of structured problem-solving methods such as RCA, CAPA, 8D, 5 Why, fishbone analysis, or FMEA. Ability to translate incomplete field information into clear technical problem statements and drive corrective actions through verified closure. Ability to communicate complex technical issues clearly to technical and nontechnical audiences. Ability to travel domestically and internationally approximately 10–20%, including travel to manufacturing facilities in Mexico. A valid passport at the time of hire is preferred; candidates without one must be able to obtain one within the first 90 days of employment. Preferred qualifications Five or more years of relevant quality, reliability, field-service, commissioning, or technical investigation experience. Direct experience with commercial or industrial HVAC equipment. Experience with custom air-handling equipment, controls, construction drawings and specifications, startup, commissioning, or active job-site processes. Experience working directly with manufacturing facilities, suppliers, factory quality teams, or field-service organizations. Experience developing technical repair procedures, Field Service Bulletins, corrective-action documentation, or quality dashboards. Compensation and benefits Base salary: $95,000-$125,000 annually, depending on experience. This position is also eligible for a discretionary bonus. Eligible employees may participate in Meriton’s benefits programs in accordance with applicable plan terms. Why CMS National Accounts You will join a fast-moving team supporting complex equipment and significant projects where expectations are high, and the connection between field performance and customer experience matters. This role offers the opportunity to make quality information more complete, corrective actions more durable, repairs more repeatable, and lessons learned more useful across a growing portfolio. If you are ready to solve meaningful technical problems and help build a stronger quality and reliability program, we would like to hear from you. Custom Mechanical Solutions is an Equal Opportunity Employer Employment practices will not be influenced or affected by an applicant’s or employee’s race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, age, disability, genetic information, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran status or any other legally protected status. Reasonable accommodations will be made for qualified individuals with disabilities unless doing so would result in an undue hardship. Salary ranges listed are dependent upon a candidate’s qualifications, experience, internal equity, and the budgeted amount for the specific role and location. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/custom-mechanical-solutions-quality-and-reliability-engineer

About the role: The Senior Manager, Network Medical Economics leads financial analysis and provides actuarial insight to support Oscar's provider contracting and network strategy. You will own end-to-end financial evaluation of complex, high-impact provider negotiations and develops contracting guardrails, unit cost targets, and financial benchmarks to advance network affordability and performance. In close partnership with Network Strategy & Performance, Regional Actuarial, Medical Economics, and Data teams, the Senior Manager evaluates new network strategies, identifies financial risks and opportunities, and strengthens analytical methods and tools. You will report into the Director, Actuarial. Work Location: This position is fully remote and open to candidates residing in the U.S., excluding Alaska; Delaware; Hawaii; Louisiana; Montana; North Dakota; Oklahoma; West Virginia; Wyoming; and U.S. Territories. Daily work is completed from your home office, with occasional travel required for team meetings and company events. #LI-Remote Pay Transparency: The base pay for this role in the states of California, Connecticut, New Jersey, New York, and Washington is: $163,944 - $215,176 per year. The base pay for this role in all other locations is: $147,549 - $193,658 per year. You are also eligible for employee benefits, participation in Oscar's unlimited vacation program and annual performance bonuses. Responsibilities: Own end-to-end financial analysis for complex, high-impact provider negotiations, evaluating proposed reimbursement rates, contract terms, and alternative structures to inform negotiation strategy and decision-making. In collaboration with Network Strategy & Performance, provide recommendations and thought partnership based on financial analysis and actuarial principles related to new network strategies and initiatives. Develop and maintain contracting guardrails, unit cost targets, and financial benchmarks aligned with business objectives. Strengthen analytical methods and processes for evaluating provider contracts, establishing consistent modeling standards and partnering with Regional Actuarial, Medical Economics, and Data teams to improve tools, reporting, and analytical efficiency. Identify and quantify financial risks and affordability opportunities through analysis of provider reimbursement, utilization, medical cost trends, and competitive benchmarks; recommend actions to improve network financial performance. Develop and deliver detailed reports, presentations, and dashboards that distill complex network medical economics insights for internal stakeholders, project teams, and business unit leaders. Maintain strong working relationships with key business and operational leaders (e.g., Network, Market P&L, Payment Integrity, Claim Operations) to ensure analytic solutions meet their needs. Other duties as assigned. Requirements: Bachelor's degree in a STEM field, or 4 years commensurate experience. 7+ years of quantitative analysis in the healthcare industry. Proven experience in health insurance / payer analytics, with an understanding of medical claims data (e.g., CPT/HCPCS, ICD-10, DRGs) and standard healthcare industry data sources. Bonus points: Excellent communication, collaboration, and relationship-building skills. Strong process management skills, with experience streamlining workflows and driving operational efficiency. Experience translating between clinical, business, and analytic vocabularies. Familiarity with ACA-specific healthcare laws, regulations, and compliance requirements. Associate or Fellow of the Society of Actuaries (SOA), or on the track to become one. This is an authentic Oscar Health job opportunity. At Oscar, being an Equal Opportunity Employer means more than upholding discrimination-free hiring practices. It means that we cultivate an environment where people can be their most authentic selves and find both belonging and support. We're on a mission to change health care -- an experience made whole by our unique backgrounds and perspectives. Pay Transparency: Final offer amounts, within the base pay set forth above, are determined by factors including your relevant skills, education, and experience. Full-time employees are eligible for benefits including: medical, dental, and vision benefits, 11 paid holidays, paid sick time, paid parental leave, 401(k) plan participation, life and disability insurance, and paid wellness time and reimbursements. Artificial Intelligence (AI): Our AI Guidelines outline the acceptable use of artificial intelligence for candidates and detail how we use AI to support our recruiting efforts. Reasonable Accommodation: Oscar applicants are considered solely based on their qualifications, without regard to applicant’s disability or need for accommodation. Any Oscar applicant who requires reasonable accommodations during the application process should contact the Oscar Benefits Team (accommodations@hioscar.com) to make the need for an accommodation known. California Residents: For information about our collection, use, and disclosure of applicants’ personal information as well as applicants’ rights over their personal information, please see our Privacy Policy . To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/oscar-health-senior-manager-network-medical-economics

set the product vision and strategy Act as the default decision-maker for your surface and make cross-area trade-offs; defend your calls under ambiguity at leadership review Drive decisions with data and deep customer + business understanding Own the metrics that roll directly into financial and business outcomes for your surface; items.description: Product Headquarters: Remote Storyblok is a headless CMS that enables marketers and developers to create with joy and publish with confidence. It empowers you to deliver structured and consistent content everywhere: websites, apps, AI search, and beyond. Legendary brands like Virgin Media O2, Oatly, and TomTom use Storyblok to make a bigger, faster market impact. WHAT IS IN IT FOR YOU You will be joining a growing company where you can contribute to many “firsts”. Plus these benefits: Monthly remote work stipend (home internet costs, electricity). Home office equipment package right at the start (laptop, keyboard, monitor…) Home office equipment upgrade (furniture, ear plugs …) or membership to a local co-working space after your onboarding Sick leave benefit, parental leave and 25 days of annual leave plus your local national holidays Personal development fund for courses, books, conferences, and material The annual international team-building trip, quarterly and monthly online get-togethers As a fully remote company, with work-life balance at its core, you’ll enjoy flexible schedules An international team that loves to have fun at work and works hard together to accomplish shared goals JOB SUMMARY You will own the reliability, performance, and cost efficiency of the PostgreSQL data platform behind our flagship CMS — primarily Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL — along with the infrastructure and automation around it. This is a reliability engineering role, not a classic administration one. Aurora takes care of patching, backups, failover, and storage growth; you own what it does not — query and index strategy, plan regressions across major version upgrades, vacuum and bloat, connection management, zero-downtime schema change, logical replication, and capacity and cost modeling. Alongside this, you work as a full member of the Infrastructure team on Terraform, CI/CD, observability, and security tooling, and you share the on-call rotation. You will work in a shared-ownership model: backend teams own their queries and schemas, and you own the platform, guardrails, tooling, and knowledge-sharing that make their decisions safe. You will collaborate closely with backend engineers, DevOps engineers, Security, product owners, and the Data team. We measure success by the reliability and predictable performance of the data platform, the quality of your incident response, and how well other engineering teams are equipped to make sound database decisions without you in the room. ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS Database platform (approx. 60%) Own the reliability, performance, and scalability of our PostgreSQL platform (primarily Amazon Aurora): query and index strategy, execution plans, configuration tuning, and capacity planning, with particular attention to hot multi-tenant read paths. Lead zero-downtime version upgrades and schema migrations at scale, including diagnosing and preventing plan regressions across Aurora major versions. Own the operational health of the platform: vacuum strategy and bloat, long-running transactions and wraparound risk, connection management and pooling (including RDS Proxy), lock contention, and logical replication and slot hygiene. Review schema changes and DDL from backend teams for lock behavior, migration safety, and performance impact, and build the guardrails and tooling that make safe changes to the default path. Own backup, restore, and disaster recovery end-to-end, including rehearsed restore drills and the access, encryption, and auditing controls our compliance obligations require. Model database capacity and cost (I/O-Optimized vs. Standard, Serverless v2 sizing, read replica strategy) and drive cost-efficiency without compromising reliability. Infrastructure and automation (approx. 40%) Deliver infrastructure and automation as a full member of the Infrastructure team, using Terraform and cloud-native tooling on AWS, and contribute to CI/CD pipelines including the safe automated handling of database changes. Build and maintain monitoring, alerting, and observability for database and platform systems (e.g. pg_stat_statements, Prometheus exporters, Grafana, Datadog, OpenTelemetry) so problems surface before customers feel them. Use cloud security and vulnerability management tooling (such as Aikido) to triage findings and keep the team's services compliant. Team, incidents, and collaboration Take part in the on-call rotation, incident response, and postmortems, driving root cause analysis and remediation that prevents recurrence. Raise the database competence of the wider engineering organization through design reviews, documentation and runbooks, and mentoring — so this expertise is not concentrated in one person. Demonstrate AI literacy, leveraging AI tools to enhance productivity, decision-making, and quality of work while applying sound judgment and critical thinking. EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE; QUALIFICATIONS Required — PostgreSQL depth 7+ years in database engineering, database reliability, infrastructure, or SRE roles, including significant hands-on ownership of production PostgreSQL. Deep PostgreSQL expertise: internals and MVCC, reading and acting on EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, BUFFERS), indexing strategy, vacuum behavior, locking, connection pooling, and configuration tuning. Strong experience with Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL and AWS-managed database services. Proven track record of zero-downtime upgrades and complex schema migrations on large, busy tables. Hands-on experience with physical and logical replication, partitioning, read scaling, and designing and validating backup and disaster-recovery strategies. Required — Infrastructure and ways of working Solid experience with Infrastructure-as-Code, primarily Terraform, on AWS. Strong Linux fundamentals plus fluency in at least one scripting language (Bash, Python, Ruby, or Go) for automation and tooling. Experience with monitoring and observability tooling, and a solid grasp of security practices (IAM, secrets management, network segmentation). Experience with change, incident, and problem management in production, and with Git and modern CI/CD workflows applied to database changes. Strong written and verbal communication in a remote-first organization, including the ability to explain database trade-offs to backend engineers and non-specialists. Willingness and ability to participate in an on-call rotation. Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. Nice to have Familiarity with backend frameworks that interact with PostgreSQL (Ruby on Rails preferred; Python, Rust, or Elixir valued). Experience with caching layers (Redis, Memcached) and their interaction with database load. Exposure to analytics pipelines and warehousing (Redshift, Snowflake, ClickHouse) or CDC-based data flows. Experience with container platforms (ECS, EKS, Fargate), NoSQL or vector databases, or AWS certification (Database – Specialty, DevOps Engineer – Professional). MENTAL, PHYSICAL AND ENVIRONMENTAL REQUIREMENTS Remote (home) work opportunity or funded by Storyblok co-working space GENERAL TERMS Storyblok has a commitment to diversity and inclusion. We strive to create a hiring environment in which all people feel they are equally respected and valued, irrespective of gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, ethnicity, age, religion, citizenship or any other characteristic. You can find more information about our privacy policy here . All communications regarding job opportunities at Storyblok will come from an official Storyblok employee with an email address ending in @storyblok.com. We will never redirect you to another portal or another site that is unrelated to our domain ( storyblok.com ). Here is a sneak peek of Storyblok’s Visual Editor If you need an accommodation for any part of the application process, please email talent.acquisition@storyblok.com To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/storyblok-senior-database-reliability-engineer-i-germany-austria-uk

items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: Remote, Texas, United States, AMER From Fivetran’s founding until now, our mission has remained the same: to make access to data as simple and reliable as electricity. With Fivetran, customer data arrives in their warehouses, canonical and ready to query, with no engineering or maintenance required. We’re proud that more organizations continue to leverage our technology every day to become truly data-driven. About Us Fivetran and dbt Labs are bringing together two industry-leading companies with a shared mission: helping organizations unlock the full value of their data. Together, we’re delivering the data infrastructure layer that helps organizations move, transform, and trust their data — from the moment data moves, through every transformation, to the context teams and AI systems rely on. Fivetran helps organizations automate data movement across the systems, clouds, engines, and tools they rely on. dbt Labs pioneered analytics engineering, helping teams transform data into reliable, governed insights. Together, we support thousands of organizations as they build a trusted foundation for analytics, AI, and better business decisions. As we bring our teams and technology together, we’re building on the strengths of both companies while continuing to deliver the products and experiences our customers know and trust. It’s an exciting time to join us: we’re creating a company with the scale, talent, and technology to help more organizations put their data to work with greater speed, confidence, and impact. During this transition period, you may see references to both Fivetran and dbt Labs throughout our recruiting process as we integrate our teams, systems, and career sites. About the Role The Enterprise Account Executive will drive towards aggressive new customer and partner revenue goals, while growing our footprint in the Enterprise market. This is a full-time, remote position and must be based out of Texas in the United States. Please note that the compensation listed below does not include commission (uncapped 50/50 split) or RSU value. What You'll Do Collaborate cross-functionally with marketing, customer success, alliances, operations, and analytics to drive pipeline generation and exceed revenue goals. Accelerate the growth & adoption of Fivetran in the Enterprise Market through value-driven sales cycles. Lead in-depth discovery and demonstrate a deep interest in our Enterprise customers’ data challenges, identify required capabilities and positive business outcomes to drive towards valuable long term customer engagements. Speak comfortably about Fivetran’s vision to a broad range of audiences from C-level executives to individual contributors. Seek out and land deals with new Enterprise target accounts, then look to grow their footprint with Fivetran through new use cases, cross-sells and expansion. Build strategic relationships with partners in order to identify new opportunities and accelerate deal cycles. Forecast accurately and provide clear visibility on sales and revenue performance by actively managing and progressing opportunities. Skills We're Looking For 8+ years of large enterprise software sales experience and well-developed pattern recognition for navigating complex organizations. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to hold multiple stakeholders accountable throughout a complex value-driven sales cycle. In-depth familiarity with the modern data technology industry and key players. You are familiar with a solution-based approach to selling, have experience managing a complex sales process and possess excellent presentation and listening skills, organization and contact management capabilities. You thrive in an extremely fast-paced, ever changing work environment. You’re able to keep up with a highly motivated team in a market that is growing extremely fast. You are extremely organized. You are able to juggle lots of things at once while not letting anything drop. You are a strategic thinker. You are able to see and communicate the big picture in an inspiring way. You are a problem solver. You are resilient and creative, able to be resourceful to proactively seek out a solution to a problem. You are enthusiastic! You exhibit passion and excitement for your work and you have a can-do attitude. Previous experience with data integration, database, ETL, or business intelligence technologies is a plus, but not required Please note that the base + uncapped commission compensation listed below does not include RSU value. This position qualifies for Fivetran’s incentive plan, and it’s common for employees in this role to achieve the total on-target earnings. As part of our commitment to setting new hires up for success, all new sales team members attend a one-week, in-person Revenue Bootcamp during their second week at Fivetran. This bootcamp, held at one of our designated company locations, requires travel and is a mandatory part of the onboarding process. The compensation range displayed on this job posting reflects the minimum and maximum target for new hire compensation for the target position and level, and may include sales incentives or target bonuses depending on the role. Our compensation ranges are determined by role, level, and location. Our job titles may span more than one career level. The compensation range is subject to change and may be modified in the future. Your recruiter can share more about the specific compensation range for your location during the hiring process. With customers in 40 countries, we have grown into a globally distributed team across the U
items.description: About Karbon Karbon is the global leader in AI-powered practice management software for accounting firms. We provide an award-winning cloud platform that helps tens of thousands of accounting professionals work more efficiently and collaboratively every day. With customers in 40 countries, we have grown into a globally distributed team across the US, Australia, New Zealand, Canada, the United Kingdom, and the Philippines. We are well-funded, ranked #1 on G2, growing rapidly, and have a people-first culture that is recognized with Great Place To Work® certification and on Fortune magazine’s Best Small Workplaces™ List. We are hiring a Senior Manager of Revenue Operations Systems to lead the team that owns Salesforce across Sales, Marketing, and the Customer organization, and to own the technology stack that powers our sales team. This person sets the architecture and standards for our core GTM platform, runs the team’s intake and allocation, and makes sure every tool we pay for earns its place. This is a player-coach role. Expect roughly half your time building: designing solutions, shipping complex configuration, and reviewing the architecture your team delivers. The other half goes to leading a team of three Revenue Operations Analysts, managing the team’s workload, and partnering with GTM leaders so the right work gets done in the right order. We are looking for someone who is the most capable technical operator in the room and gets real energy from making the people around them better. As the function grows, so will the scope of this role. Karbon is building an agentic organization. Every role here is expected to operate with an AI-first mindset, and this role carries a specific expectation: grow your team’s capacity faster than its headcount. The rest of this JD describes what that looks like for Salesforce and the sales technology stack. About the Role Salesforce Platform Leadership Own Salesforce as the core GTM platform for Sales, Marketing, and the Customer organization, including the data model, lifecycle automation, sharing and security model, and release management. Set the platform standards and architecture principles your team builds to Design and ship solutions end to end, from complex flows and record types to integrations. Review and approve architectural changes from your team and others, and hold a high bar on quality, documentation, and change management Architect how Salesforce connects to the rest of the GTM stack. Own integration patterns (native, middleware, event-driven) and know when to use each. Build with observability in mind so issues are caught before the business feels them Partner with the Senior Manager of Marketing Operations on the data flow between marketing systems and Salesforce, including campaign sync, lead and contact routing, and attribution field architecture Sales Technology Stack Own the sales technology stack, including sales engagement, conversation intelligence, data enrichment, and quoting tools, along with the integrations that connect them to Salesforce. Run vendor evaluations, implementations, renewals, and consolidation analyses Keep technology aligned to how Sales, Marketing, and the Customer organization work. Stay close enough to each team to understand their workflows, translate their needs into the right systems decisions, and say no when a new tool is not the answer Make build vs. buy vs. automate decisions with business-case rigor. Identify redundancies, integration gaps, and where AI can remove manual work across the stack. The expectation is to continuously improve how the sales organization is enabled by technology, not just maintain what we have Maintain the tech stack inventory, ownership, and renewal calendar for your domain so leadership and Finance always know what we use, what it costs, who owns it, and what it returns Data Quality & Governance Own data governance for the Salesforce platform: field definitions and ownership, stage gate enforcement, validation, and dashboard accuracy. Every field has a definition and an owner, and the numbers leaders see can be trusted Run the change management and release process that keeps Salesforce stable as it scales. Enforce scope and intake boundaries without needing escalation Surface issues before they are reported. Connect symptoms to root causes across systems, and frame findings in terms of revenue impact and a proposed action Team Leadership & Workload Management Lead and develop a team of three Revenue Operations Analysts: two focused on Salesforce and connected tools, and one supporting the Customer organization (customer success, service delivery, and support). Coach through weekly 1:1s and semi-annual reviews, build development plans tailored to each person, and grow people into bigger scope Own the performance process for your team: goal setting, mid-year and annual reviews, calibration, and merit and promotion cases. Address underperformance early and directly Own intake, prioritization, and allocation for the team. Publish the queue, manage to defined SLAs, and make the Now/Next/Later call with the Director of Revenue Operations as a partner. Push back on low-ROI work and reallocate toward the highest-leverage activity Run capacity planning for your team. Every headcount ask is justified through the agentic lens: what AI has already taken on, what still needs a person, and why. Design AI-augmented workflows as the default for new work and teach your team to do the same Own hiring for your team as roles open: write the JD, run the interview loop, and build onboarding that gets new hires productive quickly Codify tribal knowledge into documented processes and runbooks. Remove single points of failure on the team, including yourself Cross-Functional Partnership Be a trusted partner to Sales, Marketing, and Customer leaders at the Director and VP level. Translate their questions into the systems and data changes that answer them, and communicate in business terms Own the roadmap for Salesforce and the sales technology stack, and sequence it against the GTM plan. Present priorities and progress to GTM leadership monthly Lead multi-quarter, cross-functional initiatives end to end. Keep stakeholders informed before they have to ask, and never surprise anyone on delivery About You! 8+ years in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, or Salesforce administration in a B2B SaaS environment, including at least 2 years leading a team. You are as comfortable building a complex flow yourself as you are walking the CRO through the roadmap Deep Salesforce expertise. You have personally built and scaled Salesforce at a growing company and understand the architecture beneath the UI: data model, sharing and security, automation, APIs, and release management. Experience supporting post-sale teams in Salesforce is a strong plus Cross-platform breadth. You have owned Salesforce alongside at least three integrated GTM platforms (e.g., sales engagement, conversation intelligence, marketing automation, data enrichment, CPQ) and can speak to how data moves between them A track record of owning a tech stack. You have run evaluations, implementations, renewals, and consolidations, and can point to tools you added, tools you cut, and why A people leader who grows people. You have coached analysts or admins into bigger scope, handled hard performance conversations with clarity, and managed a shared queue with competing priorities from multiple teams Revenue literacy. You understand the full revenue engine, from new business to expansion, retention, and churn, and you prioritize by revenue impact. You can defend why one request matters more than another in terms a revenue leader accepts Operational rigor with architectural thinking. You balance urgency in fixing what is broken today with a clear vision for what the system needs to look like at 2x and 5x scale An AI-first operator. You are using AI in your work today, you have shipped AI-assisted workflows that expanded real capacity, and you have a point of view on how AI reshapes Revenue Operations Clear, direct communicator. Tight for executives, detailed for peers, and willing to push back when the work calls for it Experience in accounting, professional services, or practice management software is a plus but not required Why Work at Karbon? Industry-leading benefits package including medical, dental, and vision insurance for you and up to three eligible dependents. Also: Work-from-home allowance Rice subsidy Meal allowance per working day Laundry allowance 15 paid time off days per year (which includes 5 Karbon Days per year) 7 Sick leave days per year Internet and work-from-home subsidy Discretionary bonus program Work with (and learn from) a very experienced team Be part of a startup team that will continue to grow around you Flexible approach to work environment (we believe in trust and autonomy) A culture of open communication, consistent feedback, and full transparency into company results, metrics, and financial position Please be aware that Karbon will only contact you via email from our domain, karbonhq.com. If you receive an email from any other domain, please do not click any of those links. Karbon embraces diversity and inclusion, aligning with our values as a business. Research has shown that women and underrepresented groups are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single criteria. If you’ve made it this far in the job description but your past experience doesn’t perfectly align, we do encourage you to still apply. You could still be the right person for the role! We recruit and reward people based on capability and a performance-driven mindset. We do not discriminate based on race, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, lifestyle, age, educational background, national origin, religion, physical or cognitive ability, and other diversity dimensions that may hinder inclusion in the organization. If there are any adjustments or accommodations that we can make to assist you during the recruitment process and your journey at Karbon, contact us at people.support@karbonhq.com for a confidential discussion. Please note that, due to the volume, emails sent to this email address that are not for adjustments or accommodations will not receive a response. At this time, we request that agency referrals are not submitted for this position. We appreciate your understanding and encourage direct applications from interested candidates. Thank you!

items.description: StackAdapt is the leading technology company that empowers marketers to reach, engage, and convert audiences with precision. With 465 billion automated optimizations per second, the AI-powered StackAdapt Marketing Platform seamlessly connects brand and performance marketing to drive measurable results across the entire customer journey. The most forward-thinking marketers choose StackAdapt to orchestrate high-impact campaigns across programmatic advertising and marketing channels. About StackAdapt’s Verticals and Performance Team StackAdapt’s Verticals and Performance Team focuses on developing and leading strategic business technology initiatives within priority industries in order to strengthen our suite of programmatic adtech and martech solutions. We collaborate across Product, Engineering, Sales, and Analytics to design innovative, vertical-specific solutions that push the boundaries of programmatic advertising. About the Role The Senior Analyst, Verticals and Performance will work on projects and partnerships that will accelerate the development of vertical-specific advertising solutions and bring new innovations to market. This role blends technical problem-solving, data analysis, and business strategy, offering exposure to multiple cross-functional teams and direct opportunities to shape the future of programmatic solutions. While the preferred location is London, we’re happy to consider candidates based outside of the city. However, please note that the Senior Analyst will be required to travel to London on an ad-hoc basis. What You'll Be Doing: Support the team in executing the technical roadmap for Tier 1 projects, including the development, testing and maintenance of targeting and measurement solutions. Collaborate with Product, Revenue, Marketing, Business Intelligence, and Data Science teams to design, test, and iterate on vertical-focused initiatives. Collaborate with the Revenue team to understand customer needs, and existing AdTech and MarTech stack to identify revenue growth, retention, and collaboration opportunities Promote the adoption and education of existing solutions by partnering with internal enablement and marketing teams Contribute to analytics proof-of-concepts (POCs) with strategic clients; test and validate custom use cases to establish clear paths to productization. Define and track performance OKRs (e.g., data benchmarks, measurement accuracy, lower-funnel KPIs) and communicate strategic impact to senior internal stakeholders. Provide hands-on support with ad-hoc and daily operational tasks which include (but are not limited to) campaign reporting & measurement setup, ad-hoc data analysis and market & competitor research What You’ll Bring To The Table 3-5 years of experience in Consulting, Product Management, Business Analysis or Strategy & Operations in an analytics role. Experience with marketing or advertising systems is an asset but not required. Experience working with relational databases and querying languages (SQL, BigQuery) to extract, manipulate, and validate data. Strong SQL skills, including writing complex queries, optimizing performance, and working with relational database structures. Strong analytical and statistical reasoning skills, including experience with A/B testing, significance testing, and regression analysis to generate insights and guide business decisions. items.description: Management and Finance Headquarters: New York, NY; Remote, US (Hub cities) Maven Clinic is the world's largest virtual clinic for women and families on a mission to make healthcare work for all of us. Through Maven Enterprise, the company partners with more than 2,300 employers and health plans to provide end-to-end women's and family health programs spanning fertility and family building, maternity and newborn care, parenting and pediatrics, and menopause and midlife — improving clinical outcomes, reducing healthcare costs, and expanding equitable access to high-quality care at scale. Through its consumer platform, Maven provides direct access to virtual care across 30+ specialties, as well as dedicated hormone and GLP-1 care programs purpose-built for women. Founded in 2014 by CEO Kate Ryder, Maven Clinic has raised more than $425 million from leading healthcare and technology investors including General Catalyst, Sequoia, Dragoneer Investment Group, Oak HC/FT, StepStone Group, Icon Ventures, and Lux Capital. Recognized for innovation and industry leadership, Maven has been named to the TIME100 Most Influential Companies, CNBC Disruptor 50, Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies, and FORTUNE Best Places to Work. Learn more at mavenclinic.com An award-winning culture working towards an important mission – Maven Clinic is a recipient of over 30 workplace and innovation awards, including: TIME 100 Most Influential Companies (2023, 2026) Fortune Change the World (2024) CNBC Disruptor 50 List (2022, 2023, 2024) Fortune Best Workplaces for Millennials (2024) Fortune Best Workplaces in Health Care (2024) Fast Company Most Innovative Companies (2020, 2023) Fortune Best Workplaces NY (2020, 2021, 2022, 2023, 2024) About the Role: Maven is looking for a Director, GTM Operations & Architecture will own the strategy, systems, design, and reporting that power Maven's commercial engine. This role sits at the center of Salesforce administration, accountable for the business requirements and sales processes that drive it, providing the growth team with clean, trusted data and efficient workflows. You will report to the Head of Revenue Operations and partner closely with Salesforce engineering, Commercial Strategy, Sales, and Finance to keep our systems scalable, well-documented, and built for growth. This is a player-coach role. You will have 1-2 direct reports while retaining end-to-end ownership of a few critical domains. The person in this seat will be the functional owner of our GTM tools and processes: defining what the business needs, translating those needs into system requirements, owning prioritization, and driving projects to completion. We are looking for a builder and an operator. What You’ll Do: Salesforce & GTM Systems Ownership: The Director will own Salesforce as the system of record for the GTM org, ensuring the platform is configured, automated, and maintained to support the sales process end to end Owns the roadmap and end-to-end CRM strategy for Salesforce and adjacent systems Develops deep fluency in how Sales, Finance, and Analytics use our GTM systems — the decisions they drive, the reports and fields they depend on, and the obstacles they face Translates strategic and operational workflows into clear business and functional requirements, partnering with Salesforce engineering to deliver solutions that meet the needs of the business Owns a clean, well-documented sales funnel model — pipeline stages, opportunity fields, account hierarchies — and maps data across systems Leads AI strategy within the Salesforce ecosystem, identifying and building automation that reduces manual work Troubleshoots system issues quickly and is the first point of escalation for sales tooling problems Data Quality & Process Governance: The Director is the steward of data quality and process discipline across our GTM systems Runs regular data hygiene audits — duplicate records, stale opportunities, missing fields — and drives resolution with sales teams Owns QA through the deal lifecycle, from S1 opportunities to go-live — validating products, pricing, and contract terms against Salesforce before a deal is handed off to implementation Defines, governs, and maintains the business rules for Maven's customer account hierarchy, including new accounts, restructures, and ongoing hygiene, to support accurate reporting and client operations Documents and enforces sales process standards (stage definitions, required fields, deal desk workflows) so the pipeline reflects reality Cross-Functional Operations Support: The Director is a hands-on operator across the broader GTM and Finance functions Partners with Sales, Finance, Customer Success, and Engineering to identify bottlenecks and convert them into system-level solutions Drives business analysis and program management for Salesforce-related initiatives, including scoping new requests, running discovery, and managing multi-phase implementation roadmaps Supports Deal Desk with opportunity structuring, approval workflows, new pricing, and contract data accuracy in Salesforce What You’ll Bring: 8+ years across Salesforce architecture, revenue operations, or GTM systems, including time at a B2B SaaS or healthcare company Deep hands-on Salesforce skill: Understands best-practice system architecture and can design clear business and system requirements to achieve that build. Has designed account hierarchies and object models for complex B2B organizations, ideally where revenue moves through more than one channel or contract structure Has built their own automation and AI-enabled tooling to replace manual GTM and revenue operations work; continually identifies inefficient processes and eliminates them Has integrated Salesforce with the systems around it — data warehouse, BI, billing, and GTM tooling. At Maven this means Looker, BigQuery, NetSuite, Gong, ZoomInfo, and Clay Proficient in Looker or equivalent BI, with a track record of owning recurring reporting and QA that other teams depend on Can take an ambiguous request, run discovery, and come back with a scoped, multi-phase plan — and can hold a room of senior stakeholders to a decision once it’s made Writes clearly, and can turn an architecture decision into documentation a sales leader and an engineer can both use Ready to build and lead a team while remaining a deeply hands-on operator Strong Preference For: Salesforce Application Architect or System Architect credentials, or the designer certifications that ladder into them (Data Architecture & Management, Sharing & Visibility, Integration Architecture) Familiarity with Apex and sound judgment on when custom code is warranted over configuration Experience at a high-growth healthcare or healthcare benefits company Has run a migration or system consolidation end to end, including the unglamorous parts: de-duplication, cleansing, bulk loads The base salary range for this role is $204,000 - $230,000 per year. You will also be entitled to receive equity and benefits. Individual pay decisions are based on a number of factors, including qualifications for the role, experience level, and skillset. This role requires active work authorization in the US. Maven embraces a flexible hybrid work model. Our teams primarily operate from the New York Metropolitan area, NY, and remotely via San Francisco/Bay Area, CA, Seattle, WA. For those in our New York City office, we encourage in-person collaboration by requiring team members to work onsite three days a week (Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday). For those based in Boston, DC, Chicago, Seattle, and San Francisco, we encourage in-person collaboration by requiring team members to attend monthly Work Together Days within these cities. This policy aims to balance remote work flexibility with the benefits of face-to-face interaction. At Maven we believe that a diverse set of backgrounds and experiences enrich our teams and allow us to achieve above and beyond our goals. If you do not have experience in all of the areas detailed above, we hope that you will share your unique background with us in your application and how it can be additive to our teams. Benefits That Work For You Our benefits are designed to support your health, well-being and career development, helping you thrive both personally and professionally. We remain focused on providing a competitive benefits package for our employees. On top of standards such as employer-covered health, dental, and insurance plan options, we offer an inclusive approach to benefits: Maven for Mavens: access to the full platform and specialists, including care for mental health, reproductive health, family planning and pediatrics. Whole-self care through wellness partnerships Hybrid work, in office meals, and work together days 16 weeks 100% paid parental leave and new parent stipend (for Mavens who've been with us for 1 year+) Annual professional development stipend and access to a personal career coach through Maven for Mavens 401K matching for US-based employees, with immediate vesting These benefits are applicable to Maven Clinic Co., US-based, full-time employees only. 1099/Contract Providers are ineligible for these benefits. Maven is an affirmative action and equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, disability, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, or genetic information. Maven is committed to providing access, equal opportunity and reasonable accommodation for individuals with disabilities in employment, its services, programs, and activities. Maven Clinic interview requests and job offers only originate from an @mavenclinic.com email address (e.g jsmith@mavenclinic.com). Maven Clinic will never ask for sensitive information to be delivered over email or phone. If you receive a scam issue or a security issue involving Maven Clinic please notify us at: security@mavenclinic.com . For general and additional inquiries, please contact us at careers@mavenclinic.com . To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/maven-clinic-director-gtm-operations-architecture
