items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: Atlanta; San Francisco; United States (Remote) Upgrade helps customers move in the right direction with affordable and responsible financial products. Since 2017, we’ve helped over 7.5 million customers access over $42 billion in consumer credit. With a relentless focus on improving our customers' financial well-being, we build products that put more money in their pocket and support their journey toward a better financial future. We’re backed by some of the most prominent technology investors and were most recently valued at $7.3B. We’re consistently recognized for our collaborative and inclusive culture. Most recently, we were named one of the World’s Top Fintech Companies by CNBC, Best Places to Work by Built In, Best Places to Work by the San Francisco Business Times, America’s Greatest Workplaces by Newsweek, Best Startup Employer by Forbes, and Healthiest Employers by Phoenix Business Journal. We’re looking for new team members who get excited about designing and delivering new and better products. Come join us and help build a better financial future for millions of people. Upgrade is a fintech company focused on providing affordable and responsible credit to everyday consumers. Our Auto business is growing, and demand generation is how we reach the customers, and partners who power that growth. As a Demand Generation Manager , you will own the day-to-day strategy and execution that drive new business across Auto, spanning paid media, email, content, events, and sales-led campaigns. You will build the campaigns, nurture journeys, and reporting needed to drive measurable pipeline growth and revenue impact. This is a highly visible role for someone who is analytical, comfortable owning cross-functional work end to end, and energized by building and scaling a marketing foundation. You will work in close partnership with Sales, Partnerships, Sales Enablement, and Customer Success, and alongside Lifecycle, Product Marketing, Design, Legal & Compliance, and Data partners, so that acquisition efforts line up with onboarding, engagement, and retention. You will sit at the intersection of growth and marketing execution, working directly with the teams closest to revenue, with real ownership and the ability to shape how Upgrade shows up in the Automotive market. What You’ll Do: Own demand generation strategy for Auto across PPC, email, content, events, and web Refine the GTM, messaging, and value proposition for each business, aligned to ICP and buyer personas Optimize lead acquisition, conversion, and pipeline velocity, and manage and improve MQL quality and performance Partner with Account Executives, Partnerships, and Sales leadership to brainstorm, align on, and launch campaigns, including sales incentives, competitions, and referral programs Refine nurture journeys and build segmentation strategies in HubSpot, Salesforce, and Outreach Lead campaigns end to end (strategy, execution, measurement), defining success metrics and setting a clear reporting cadence Work cross-functionally to move campaigns forward: Design tickets within the sprint cycle, Lifecycle requests, and early Legal, Compliance, and bank review Oversee website strategy and optimization, ensuring alignment with campaign messaging, ICP targeting, SEO best practices, and conversion rate optimization Build performance dashboards and attribution reporting tied to revenue outcomes, working with Data and Sales Ops partners across Heap, Google Analytics, Salesforce, and Tableau Manage the demand generation budget and track program spend against results Continuously test and optimize campaigns for efficiency and effectiveness Use AI-enabled tools when helpful to streamline content development, summarize insights, and improve workflow efficiency, so we can move quickly without sacrificing quality What We Look For: 5-7+ years of B2B or demand generation marketing experience, ideally within fintech, consumer lending, auto finance focused products. Proven experience leading demand generation and pipeline growth, including paid digital channels such as Google Ads and LinkedIn Ads. Proficiency in Salesforce and HubSpot. Demonstrated skills or projects with claude, chatgpt, co-pilot or any other AI tool. Data-driven mindset with strong analytical skills, including experience with attribution, funnel reporting, and dashboards in Tableau (or a comparable BI tool). Track record of designing and analyzing test-and-learn experiments (e.g., A/B tests) to optimize campaign performance. Strong understanding of integrated marketing strategy, with the ability to translate strategy into clear plans and messaging. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with experience presenting results and recommendations to senior stakeholders. Self-starter who is organized, detail-oriented, and comfortable managing multiple cross-functional workstreams in a fast-paced environment. BA/BS degree in business or a closely related field, or equivalent practical experience. Curiosity and adaptability with AI-enabled tools, which are already part of how work gets done across our organization and will continue to expand over time. Nice to Have: Experience with Outreach, Heap, or Google Analytics. Experience partnering with Legal and Compliance on marketing review in a regulated environment. Experience with partner, referral, or sales-incentive programs. Familiarity with website strategy, SEO best practices, and conversion rate optimization. What We Offer You: Competitive salary and stock option plan 100% paid coverage of medical, dental and vision insurance Flexible PTO Opportunities for professional growth and development Paid parental leave Health & wellness initiatives #BI-Hybrid #LI-Hybrid For California residents: Upgrade's California Notice at Collection and Privacy Policy describes our practices regarding the collection, use, and disclosure of the personal information of job applicants. Environmental & Working Conditions Work is performed indoors in a fast-paced environment that requires the ability to manage multiple priorities and meet established workflows, schedules, and service expectations. Employees regularly input, retrieve, and exchange information accurately using digital systems and applications to support operational and customer service objectives. The role requires the ability to receive and exchange information with customers, peers, supervisors, and cross-functional partners through available communication channels, which may include meetings, email, phone, and digital collaboration tools, and may involve real-time, verbal, or in-person exchanges depending on business need. J ob duties may involve managing a high volume of inbound and/or outbound customer interactions and work activities using telecommunications and computer systems. The role requires the ability to read, analyze, and interpret information displayed on computer screens and remain in a working posture for extended periods, consistent with the demands of the position. Work may be performed in a contact center, office, or remote environment, depending on business needs and the nature of the role. Onsite work environments may include shared workspaces, standard office lighting, and moderate background noise typical of customer service or operational settings. Employees working remotely are responsible for maintaining a secure and productive workspace with reliable internet connectivity that supports company systems and safeguards the confidentiality of company and customer information. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the position in accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) and applicable state and local laws. We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. Upgrade does not accept unsolicited resumes from staffing agencies, search firms, or any third parties. Any resume submitted to any employee of Upgrade without a prior written agreement in place will be considered the property of Upgrade, and Upgrade will not be obligated to pay any referral or placement fee. Agencies must obtain advance written approval from Upgrade's Talent Acquisition department to submit resumes and only in conjunction with a valid, fully executed agreement. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/upgrade-demand-generation-manager-auto

items.description: Metabase is the easiest way for people to get insights from their data, from tiny startups who get up and running quickly to major corporations with tens of thousands of users. That’s why people love us. We bring data tools with the elegance and simplicity of consumer products to the crufty world of enterprise business intelligence. We provide an opinionated open source starting point for how companies should measure, analyze and share their data, which is used by tens of thousands of companies. Metabase is looking for a Federal Account Executive to help build the next stage of our public sector business. We’ve already closed our first public sector deals, and we’re ready to invest further into the space. We’re now looking for someone who knows how Federal buys and can turn that early traction into a repeatable motion. You won’t be starting from zero, but this isn’t a fully built function either. You’ll have real support behind you, and the role will demand that you take full advantage of it: establishing process where it doesn’t exist yet, being clear about what you need, and managing and closing pipeline along the way. If you’ve been one of the first Federal AEs at a company before, you’ll know what an exciting stage this is. What you’ll do: Manage Federal pipeline from creation to close Build on our closed public sector deals to define target agencies and account plans Establish the process and playbooks for how Metabase sells into Federal What we’re looking for: Experience in a quota-carrying role selling exclusively into Federal Experience being one of the first Federal AEs at one or more of the organizations you’ve worked at Experience selling technical tools A track record of establishing sales process, not just following it A track record of taking advantage of the support and investment you’ve been given Experience with data tools is a significant plus, but not mandatory Compensation _The US base salary with OTE range for this role is ** $300K–$400K annually_** , plus equity and benefits. Compensation is determined by role, level, location, and individual qualifications, including skills, experience, and scope of responsibility. Pay may vary by geographic location and other job-related factors. Benefits We offer meaningful equity and a comprehensive US benefits package, including fully employer-covered medical, dental, and vision insurance (with 75% coverage for dependents), a 401(k) with employer match available to enroll after the first 30 days, flexible and unlimited paid time off including sick time, and an asynchronous, remote-first environment. We’re a global team (50% outside the US), fully distributed (from Thailand to California), who get things done asynchronously, with plenty of uninterrupted time, supporting each other to do the best work of our careers. We offer flexibility (define your own schedule and work from wherever you want), autonomy, and an environment that fosters growth, learning, and development. We’re relentlessly user-focused and believe in building long-term value, not short-term hacks. And we raised a $30M Series B to take our approach to the next level for years to come. For U.S. applicants: Metabase participates in the federal E-Verify program, which confirms employment authorization of newly hired U.S. based employees. E-Verify is not used as a tool to pre-screen candidates and is only initiated upon hire. E-Verify Participation Notice (English/Spanish) Right to Work Notice (English/Spanish) We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

items.description: RainFocus, one of the most innovative software companies in the heart of Utah’s Silicon Slopes, is in search of an exceptional Sales Engineer . About RainFocus RainFocus cares about its employees, customers, and the world in which we live. Our rapidly growing team serves Fortune 500 companies like Adobe, Cisco, IBM, Oracle, VMware, and others to prepare and execute in-person, virtual, and hybrid events, across the world. Those events are delivered through our industry-disrupting software platform, with groundbreaking business intelligence, to elevate the attendee experience, streamline event operations, and accelerate marketing results. We are well-funded, growing fast, and building a company that is changing the market — it will be challenging, fun and exciting. About the Role As part of the Strategic Growth organization, this role supports sales efforts (new, upsell, and renewals) for new and emerging products, including API integrations and AI agents. You’ll also act as the key technical CRM and RevOps advisor, demonstrating how native CRM integrations and the RainFocus Sales Module drive pipeline velocity, governed audience acquisition, and high-level business ROI directly to CROs, CMOs, and CRM Admins. Essential Responsibilities: Architect and deliver technical demonstrations of the RainFocus Sales Module to showcase ease of use and revenue ROI to C-level buyers (CRO, CMO, CFO) Map complex enterprise CRM workflows, including territory hierarchies, quota limits, and multi-level approval chains Address technical objections from Salesforce Admins and IT Security regarding OAuth scopes, read/write permissions, and data security (SOC 2 Type II) Transition technical client requirements to the services team via accurate pre-sales scoping and SOW creation, defining support vs. delivery task ownership Manage external relationships with technical buyers (RevOps, Marketing Ops, CRM Admins) to build long-term strategic partnerships Identify product gaps or custom data-mapping needs and coordinate directly with Product and Engineering teams to influence the roadmap Deliver competitive intelligence on digital signals and CRM integrations to drive account expansion Collaborate with Client Success and Support to ensure excellent service delivery post-sale Required Skills & Experience: 5+ years of experience in technical sales, solutions engineering, or implementation, with 3+ years specifically in CRM/Salesforce ecosystems (event industry experience is secondary) Deep expertise in Salesforce configuration, API push/pull sync dynamics, OAuth scopes, and data hygiene Experience presenting technical integration concepts and handling objections from C-level executives and technical gatekeepers Strong leadership skills to own the technical sales process and manage multiple enterprise deal cycles in parallel Experience creating detailed technical proposals, integration mapping, SOWs, and RFP/RFI responses BA/BS degree; willingness to travel 10-40% Personal Characteristics: The best candidates for this position will have strong chemistry and a culture fit within RainFocus. They are comfortable in a fast-paced, dynamic environment and possess the following qualities: Team-player Self-motivated Strong Communicator Success Measures Seamless alignment of client territory/quota structures with minimal integration delays Reduced friction and rapid security/CRM clearance from technical buyers Growth in Sales Module bookings and successful pre-sales to delivery handoffs Location/Travel This remote role can be based anywhere in the United States. Travel may be required up to 40% for onsite client events, meetings, and postmortems. Why work at RainFocus? At RainFocus we delight millions of attendees at large-scale events by delivering better insights, experiences, and marketing. We were able to pivot our product and services offering in 2020 to continue growing and serving new clients and events. As a member of the RainFocus team, you will have the opportunity to experience first-hand the impact of our platform at events around the world. Additionally, RainFocus offers competitive salaries, competitive benefits, 401k, generous PTO, and countless other team building activities. What are you waiting for? Apply today! We need more talented, hard-working, fun-loving team members just like yourself! items.title: Content Reviewer - United States
items.summary: Every search represents someone seeking reliable information. They depend on search results being accurate, trustworthy, and relevant to their local context. But search engines only learn to return trustworthy information if human evaluators with deep research expertise and cultural knowledge verify and correct them. Your linguistic precision, fact-checking rigor, and understanding of how your culture communicates and values information is irreplaceable in building search systems that people can actually trust. In this role, you will evaluate search queries, results, and AI-generated content for factual accuracy, authority, relevance, and user intent alignment. Your judgment determines whether search systems return trustworthy, contextually appropriate information. Analyze multi-turn search queries and web results for factual accuracy, source authority, and user intent alignment Conduct cross-referencing and fact-checking using regional sources, specialized databases, academic resources, and web directories Assess localized content relevancy across diverse domains—news, sports, local culture, technical queries considering regional context and cultural nuance Evaluate AI-generated content for factual grounding, hallucination risk, and contextual appropriateness Provide structured assessments that train search ranking and content relevance models Qualifications to succeed in this project: Professional fluency in English Residency in the United States for the last 3 consecutive years Active use of Gmail and other forms of social media and experience in the use of web browsers to navigate and interact with a variety of content Deep local cultural awareness and familiarity with regional news, current events, and contemporary culture Strong fact-checking and critical thinking abilities Access to a stable broadband internet, a reliable computer and a smartphone (Android 5.0, iOS 14 or higher) Linguists, cross-cultural researchers, domain specialists, and detail-driven professionals with strong research methodology (preferred) Why join the project: Fully remote flexibility: Structure your contributions around research, consulting, teaching, or other professional commitments without rigid scheduling Comprehensive research support: Access detailed evaluation guidelines, reference materials, databases, and resources for fact-checking across domains Quality recognition: Performance assessments focused on consistency, fact-checking precision, and nuanced judgment Intellectually demanding by design: If you are driven by fact-checking precision, source authority analysis, and the challenge of identifying what makes information truly trustworthy, this work is built for that mindset. Responsive support: Direct access to evaluation support staff for clarification on ambiguous queries or technical guidance Qualification path How to get started: Complete your contributor profile and application Take a qualification assessment at your own pace within the time given Verify your identity through our secure identity verification process Acceptance form & Rater Academy: Complete an acceptance form and approximately 2.5 hours of Rater Academy training Receive your project assignment and access credentials Service Rates The rate of pay is 0.2333 USD per task, with an estimated earning potential of 14 USD per hour. Compensation is based on tasks completed and project availability. Estimated earnings may vary depending on task volume and program requirements including, quality, and productivity, in accordance with the program's quality standards and guidelines. Independent Contractor Relationship This opportunity is offered on an independent contractor basis. Contributors have the flexibility to choose when and how much they work, subject to project availability and quality requirements. This opportunity is not and should not be construed as creating an employment relationship with TELUS Digital.

items.title: Customer Service Representative
items.summary: Work From Home. Pick Your Schedule. Get Paid Weekly. Welcome to ShyftOff! Tired of traditional jobs that expect you to build your life around a fixed schedule? At ShyftOff, we believe work should fit into your life, not the other way around! We're changing the way customer service works by connecting independent professionals with exciting opportunities to support established businesses, all from the comfort of home. Whether you're looking to earn extra income, take greater control of your schedule, or explore a flexible remote opportunity, ShyftOff gives you the freedom to work differently. Why Choose ShyftOff? No commute. No traditional fixed schedule. More flexibility. More control. 100% Remote: Forget the commute! Work from the comfort of your own home. Weekly Pay: Get paid every week for eligible completed work. You Make Your Schedule: Choose available shifts that fit your lifestyle. Work when opportunities align with your availability. Earn $14-$20 Per Hour: Competitive campaign pay with opportunities to increase your earnings based on program and eligibility. Important: Applications will only be considered if you apply on the ShyftOff website at https://www.shyftoff.com/agents The Role As an independent agent, you take inbound calls for ShyftOff client programs and help customers answer questions, resolve issues, and get what they need. After you join, you choose which programs to apply for based on your qualifications and availability. One of our newest programs include: Financial Services Program — $15–$20 per hour plus incentives + $300 certification bonus Help cardholders manage their money with confidence. You'll take inbound calls from people who rely on their banking cards for everyday life: activating a new card, replacing a lost one, sorting out a disputed charge, or getting a time-sensitive payment through. This is credentialed financial services work on an established account, built for people who want to meet a real bar and stick around. What you'll do: Handle inbound calls on card activation, replacements, lost or stolen cards, balances, and account questions Help customers with payments, transfers, and disputes, accurately and securely Verify customer identity and follow strict security and compliance protocols on every call Spot and help resolve potential fraud with composure Document every interaction accurately in the account's systems Who you'll talk to: cardholders and their benefits managers, often at a stressful moment like a lost card or a charge they don't recognize. Your job is to guide them, protect their account, and get them back on solid ground. Healthcare Program — $14–$20 per hour plus incentives + $200 certification bonus Compassionate, detail-oriented agents support a healthcare campaign, where your role is vital in providing clear information and support. What you'll do: Engage with customers to understand their concerns and provide solutions Clearly explain the breach details and the services offered to them Maintain a high level of empathy and professionalism in all communications Accurately submit CRM tickets to ensure effective issue resolution What Makes You a Fit (all programs) Communication: you connect over the phone, listen well, and stay empathetic even when the caller isn't calm Security and accuracy: you take protecting sensitive information seriously Tech comfort: you can move between multiple systems and databases at once Composure: you think clearly and solve problems in a fast-paced environment Remote customer service or contact center experience is a strong plus; 3+ years of customer service experience preferred What You'll Need (all programs) Modern computer, USB headset, and reliable hard-wired internet connection (25 Mbps minimum) A quiet, professional home workspace suitable for customer calls Ability to complete program-specific qualifications, certifications, and onboarding Independent Contractor Disclosure: ShyftOff provides opportunities for independent contractors, not traditional employment. Agents choose whether to accept available opportunities and are responsible for their own taxes, equipment, and business expenses. Compensation, qualifications, and available hours vary by program and are not guaranteed.

items.title: Tier III Service Desk Engineer
items.summary: Unió Digital is an Arizona-based managed service provider (MSP) delivering Managed IT Services, Low Voltage Cabling, Access Control, Video Surveillance, and Intrusion Services. We believe technology should be intuitive, not intimidating. We are looking for an experienced Tier 3 Service Desk Technician with exceptional problem-solving skills. You will serve as the escalation point within the team, resolving complex technical issues while also leading client onboarding and project initiatives. You are expected to be involved in direct end-user support when required. If you have a passion for ensuring top-quality user support and thrive in a collaborative environment, this role is for you. Duties · Lead and support our helpdesk environment for managed service clients · Coordinate and manage client projects, acting as a bridge between the technical team and the client to ensure project success · Provide above and beyond support to our clients and respond to queries for technical assistance in person, via phone, or electronically as required · Provide training and support to clients during the onboarding process to ensure they understand how to effectively use their new IT systems and services. · Develop project plans for client onboarding and standardization projects, outlining tasks, resources required, and estimated timelines · Install, configure, diagnose, test and resolve technical hardware and software issues · Maintain and update written client and process documentation to ensure effective knowledge management · Provide mentorship and guidance to Tier I and Tier II service desk technicians, fostering a collaborative and knowledgeable team environment · Contribute to the development and improvement of IT service management processes and practices · Evaluate and anticipate IT trends and recommend strategies and implement improvement initiatives Our Technology Stack · Helpdesk / Ticketing – HaloPSA · Documentation – Hudu · RMM – Intune / Immybot · Networking – Meraki · Email/Calendar/Voice/AD – Microsoft 365 · Security Cameras – Rhombus / Avigilon · Door Access – Avigilon Qualification · 6+ years of experience providing IT services and end-user support · Prior experience at a managed service provider is critical to understand the fast-paced nature of the industry · Client-oriented approach with a passion for delivering high-quality customer service · Proven experience leading IT projects · A self-starter who is eager to expand their qualifications · Background in providing direct end-user support · High level of attention to detail · Excellent verbal and written communication skills · IT-related degree and/or certifications (Cisco, A+, Network+, Microsoft, or equivalent) · Advanced technical knowledge, including experience with Azure AD, Active Directory, Intune, or other RMM agents Our Core Values Dream Big, Then Make it Real We flex our imagination and challenge ourselves to a higher standard. Do, rather than talk and tell. Client Driven Results Clients trust us to find solutions that deliver exceptional results. When they succeed, we succeed. Own Your Progress We continuously improve through rapid innovation and embracing our mistakes. Own it means a relentless pursuit of the solution. We Do It Right…even when no one’s watching. Period.

items.title: Content Reviewer - United States
items.summary: We are looking for an independent, flexible, remote opportunity where you can help improve AI-powered search technology from the comfort of your home? If you're curious, internet-savvy, and enjoy evaluating online content, this freelance project could be a great fit. A Day in the Life of a Content Reviewer - US In this role, you will analyze and provide feedback on text, webpages, images, and other types of online content for leading search engines using a specialized online platform. By reviewing and rating search results for relevance and quality, you will help improve the overall search experience for millions of users around the world, including yourself. Join our global community and put your skills to work supporting one of the world's leading search technologies. Service Rates The rate of pay is $0.2333 per completed task, with an estimated earning potential of $14 per hour. Compensation is based on tasks completed and project availability. Estimated earnings may vary depending on task volume and program requirements including, quality, and productivity, in accordance with the program's quality standards and guidelines. Please note that only one member per household may participate in this program. If it is identified that more than one person from the same household is participating in the TELUS Digital Rating Program, all associated accounts may be removed from the program. Independent Contractor Relationship This opportunity is offered on an independent contractor basis. Contributors have the flexibility to choose when and how much they work, subject to project availability and quality requirements. This opportunity is not and should not be construed as creating an employment relationship with TELUS Digital. Qualification path Qualification Process No previous professional experience is required to apply for this opportunity. However, participation in this project requires meeting the basic requirements and successfully completing the qualification process. Basic Requirements • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English • Must have resided in the United States for the past three consecutive years • Familiarity with current and historical business, media, sports, news, social media, and cultural affairs in the United States • Active use of Gmail and social media platforms • Experience using web browsers to navigate and interact with a variety of online content • Daily access to a reliable broadband internet connection • Access to a smartphone (Android 5.0 or higher, or iOS 14 or higher) • Access to a personal computer Assessment You must complete an English language assessment, pass an open book qualification exam, and complete an ID verification in order to be successful for this role. These assessments will determine your suitability for the position.

items.title: Freelance Copywriter
items.summary: CT Marketing Agency is seeking skilled Freelance Copywriters to write high-quality, SEO-driven content for eCommerce and lead generation websites. This is a freelance, project-based writing role. The ideal candidate has excellent English writing skills, strong research ability, and experience writing content that follows detailed, client-specific guidelines. Projects commonly include category pages, product descriptions, blog posts, SEO landing pages, and website copy. About the Role Our client base is constantly evolving, and writers may create content across a wide range of industries, including: Fashion, including mass-market and luxury brands Skincare and beauty Tech and software Finance and investing Law, including family law, divorce, and product liability Education Home improvement Automobiles and motorcycles Health and wellness Medical and clinical fields Digital marketing SEO, PR, advertising, and marketing Writers with experience in highly specialized industries such as tech, finance, law, health, medical, SEO, PR, advertising, or marketing are strongly encouraged to apply. Responsibilities Write clear, engaging, SEO-friendly content for eCommerce and lead generation websites Create category pages, product descriptions, blog posts, landing pages, and website copy Research client industries, products, services, audiences, and competitors Follow detailed client guidelines and adapt to different brand voices Blend SEO best practices with brand priorities and conversion-focused writing Complete assignments by deadline and communicate professionally with the team Qualifications Excellent English writing, grammar, editing, and proofreading skills 2 to 4 years of professional, non-academic writing experience preferred Strong understanding of SEO writing best practices Ability to research unfamiliar industries and technical topics Ability to write creative, engaging, accurate, and ROI-focused content Portfolio featuring published work preferred Experience in specialized industries strongly preferred Compensation Writers are paid on a per-word basis. Rates are assessed according to our KPI rubric. Initial compensation is up to $0.06 per word, with $0.034 per word being the most typical rate This equals approximately $30 or $17 per 500-word page After 400 live pages, the top rate increases to $0.064 per word, with $0.038 per word being the most typical rate After 800 live pages, the top rate increases to $0.07 per word, with $0.044 per word being the most typical rate Application Process Candidates should be prepared to provide a portfolio featuring published work. Once an offer is extended, writers will complete a brief training course.

items.title: Applied AI Data Scientist
items.summary: AE Studio builds products, platforms, and internal ventures that increase agency for all conscious beings. We combine world-class software engineering, AI expertise, and product design to ship ambitious projects that matter. ABOUT THE ROLE As a Data Scientist at AE Studio, you’ll work on a mix of client projects and internal research initiatives. You’ll solve…
items.description: AE Studio builds products, platforms, and internal ventures that increase agency for all conscious beings. We combine world-class software engineering, AI expertise, and product design to ship ambitious projects that matter. ABOUT THE ROLE As a Data Scientist at AE Studio, you’ll work on a mix of client projects and internal research initiatives. You’ll solve real-world problems, help build meaningful products, and contribute to groundbreaking AI alignment research. Your work will involve building data-driven solutions, leveraging machine learning models, and using your creativity to deliver results that matter. In addition to client projects, you’ll have the opportunity to propose and pursue high-impact research projects , especially those aligned with our mission of increasing agency. Promising projects could even become prioritized skunkworks initiatives. We want problem-solvers who are adaptable, collaborative, and excited to push boundaries. If this sounds like you, let’s talk. ABOUT YOU You thrive on solving challenging problems and bring a mix of technical expertise, creativity, and humor to your work. You enjoy working independently but also love collaborating with a team that shares your passion for making a difference. Required Skills and Experience Fluency in Python .. Experience with LLM lifecycle: prompt design/engineering, prompting techniques (RAG, few-shot, CoT, etc.), vector databases, multimodality, fine-tuning, and evaluation. Proven data science experience : You’ve been a key contributor to impactful projects and know how to deliver results with real-life outcomes. Statistical & causal ML fundamentals: expertise in experimental design, uncertainty quantification, and rigorous model evaluation across tabular, time-series, and foundation-model fine-tuning tasks. Deep learning experience : Expertise in building/training NLP or computer vision models with PyTorch, TensorFlow, or JAX. Agile & AI-powered development: You run lean Kanban/Scrum cycles and leverage AI-powered tools like Cursor to prototype quickly and ship high-impact solutions. Growth mindset : You embrace challenges, value progress over perfection, and constantly seek to improve. Self-management : You can work independently, take ownership of projects, and deliver without constant oversight. Product and UX understanding : You care about delivering a seamless, user-friendly experience. Effective communication in English : Clear, concise, and maybe even witty communication is essential. Bonus Points for Self-managed projects : Ideally something that you helped develop from zero and shipped to real users. Startup experience : You thrive in dynamic environments and enjoy taking on new challenges. Client relationship management : Experience managing clients and delivering excellent results. Passion for AI alignment : You care deeply about humanity’s future and want to help navigate the challenges of advancing AI. WHAT WE OFFER Remote-first culture: Work from anywhere, or join us in one of our offices. Flexible schedules: We care about outcomes, not micromanagement. Competitive pay: Regular performance-based raises and a diversified employee equity program. Opportunities for growth: Work on cutting-edge R&D and propose projects that could become our next skunkworks focus. Supportive environment: A team that collaborates, mentors, and shares knowledge. Perks: Health insurance, free lunches (at the office), weekly knowledge-sharing talks, and an annual team retreat. The salary range is $180k to $ 240k per year for people based in California. Not in the range? That's fine, you can still apply, and our team may fit you in a more senior position that we're not actively hiring right now, but we are growing fast and may have other openings soon. EQUITY Working at AE means receiving equity in our client projects and in Skunkworks ventures. The equity is priced at $0 when granted for tax reasons, but AE invests millions into these projects. Equity comes from reduced margins on client work and internal funding. You get a real stake in the things you help build. The longer you stay, the more value you create and the more equity you receive. If you leave on good terms, you can retain 20% of your equity by staying engaged. If you spin out a Skunkworks venture, you retain 100%.

items.summary: About Clipboard Our mission is to uplift as many communities as possible. We do this through our app-based marketplace that connects healthcare professionals with the workplaces that need amazing workers. This enables hundreds of thousands of people to achieve financial stability for themselves and their families while providing essential care to millions of people across…
items.description: About Clipboard Our mission is to uplift as many communities as possible. We do this through our app-based marketplace that connects healthcare professionals with the workplaces that need amazing workers. This enables hundreds of thousands of people to achieve financial stability for themselves and their families while providing essential care to millions of people across the U.S. Founded in 2016, we are a remote-first team of over 1,000 people building a top Y-Combinator company and have been profitable since 2022. We’re the leader in Long-Term Care staffing and are rapidly expanding into Home Health, Hospitals, and more, meaning we have more work to do than people to do it, and are growing our team to support millions more people and their communities. About the role: The Revenue Strategy & Growth Associate role is a generalist position at Clipboard, suited to an “all-around athlete” who can do it all and wants exposure to a range of problems and opportunities. You’re likely someone with an analytical mind who’s interested in and capable of solving different problem types. You’re a critical thinker, resourceful, adaptable and confident that you can figure it out if you can sink your teeth in deep enough. These are the ingredients for a problem solver who is eager to flex into multiple types of projects and responsibilities, depending on what’s needed and most impactful. You will: Own a project from framing through delivery, owning the analysis, recommendation, the rollout, and the outputs. Build systems and automations that improve how a workstream runs. Partner with cross functional teams to implement changes. Track and publicly report on the results of your work. What you bring: Solid analytical and modeling skills Project ownership. You can scope, sequence, and deliver without close oversight. Translate analysis into a recommendation. You don’t just stop at the chart. Strong, reliable communication. Experience 1-4 years in S&O, analytics, consulting, or a comparable analytical role. What We Offer Competitive base salary Insurance benefits and 401k options Unlimited PTO and flexible holidays Remote-first flexibility You can also get a sense of what it's like to work in the team by checking out this profile of Ryan . Quick Note on Scammers: Clipboard would never ask you for money or your bank details to participate in our hiring process. Report any scammers impersonating the Clipboard hiring team members here .

items.description: About the Role: At TELUS Digital , we are teaching AI to move from 2D screens into 3D reality. As a 3D Spatial Data Expert , you are the "Mapmaker of the Future." You will join our AI Community as a specialist tasked with identifying and labeling the physical world within 3D datasets, such as LiDAR (Light Detection and Ranging) and 3D meshes. While our Specialists handle complex physics and urban planning, you are the one who teaches the AI the "alphabet" of space—where a curb ends, where a pedestrian begins, and how a robotic arm perceives a shelf. At TELUS, you are helping to build the data foundation for autonomous vehicles, drones, and the industrial metaverse. What You’ll Do (Key Responsibilities): 3D Bounding Box Annotation: Placing precise 3D cubes (bounding boxes) around objects in point-cloud data to help AI identify their size, location, and orientation in space. Semantic Segmentation: "Painting" 3D maps to categorize different surfaces—distinguishing between a drivable road, a sidewalk, and a permanent obstacle. Point-Cloud Cleaning: Reviewing raw sensor data from self-driving cars or robots to remove "noise" (like rain or dust) so the AI sees a clear picture of reality. Simulated Data Validation: Comparing AI-generated 3D environments against real-world captures to ensure the digital version is a faithful "twin" of the physical one. Spatial Logic Testing: Answering simple questions about 3D scenes (e.g., "Is the drone's path clear of the overhead wire?") to validate the model's spatial reasoning. Qualification path What You Bring (Mandatory Qualifications): Education: Minimum of a Bachelor’s Degree in any field. (Preferred: Architecture, Geography, Graphic Design, Game Design, or STEM fields). Native Language: Native-level proficiency in your primary language is mandatory for labeling localized signage and environmental assets correctly. English Proficiency: Minimum B1 (Intermediate) level English to follow technical spatial guidelines. Visual-Spatial Skills: Strong "3D vision"—the ability to look at a flat screen and understand the depth and volume of objects. Assessment: In order to be hired into our community, you’ll go through a subject-specific qualification exam that will determine your suitability for the position and complete ID verification. Payment: Currently, pay rates for experts range from $18 - $50 USD per hour Our Payment terms are defined for each project. Why Join the TELUS Digital AI Community: Community Connection: Work remotely as part of a 1M+ diverse global AI Community of contributors and experts. Impactful Expertise: Use your native language and academic degree to shape real-world AI systems and products used by millions every day. Hands-on Innovation: Gain experience in the latest AI research, evaluation, and fine-tuning methodologies. Global Collaboration: Collaborate with a network of specialists across 20+ domains and 500+ languages and dialects. Flexible Engagement: Manage your own schedule while making a meaningful impact on the future of technology. TELUS Digital AI Community Our global AI Community is a vibrant network of more than one million contributors from diverse backgrounds who help customers collect, enhance, train, translate, and localize content to build better AI models. Become part of our growing community and contribute to the development of innovative AI technologies used by some of the world's largest brands. items.description: Full-Stack Programming Headquarters: Culver City, California, United States URL: https://jobs.workable.com/company/kZSiaRVHB45MDzQ7znFJSV/jobs-at-crazy-maple-studio Crazy Maple Studio is a fast-growing company based in the Bay Area and Los Angeles, focusing on mobile gaming, reading, and streaming. We are proud to have a global team that drives our innovation and success across diverse markets. Our flagship platform, ReelShort, is the #1 vertical streaming app in the U.S., with over 8 million DAU, delivering bite-sized episodic content that keeps viewers hooked. Other standout products include Chapters, where users shape immersive stories across drama, fantasy, and romance, and My Fiction, a platform for consuming and creating serialized romance. We’re proud to be recognized as one of the Global Most Loved Workplaces 2025, reflecting our commitment to innovation, creativity, and an employee-first culture. Position Overview: As an AI-Assisted Story Writer, you will create short, high-hook, pay-per-chapter stories for mobile readers, working hand in hand with external AI and our in-house AI story system. Our system guides every story through a proven pipeline; your job is to steer that process with strong editorial judgment, push every story past "good enough," and turn out titles that readers pay to finish. This is an ROI-driven role. Every story you deliver goes into live testing, and its results (ad performance, reader conversion past the paywall, and return on ad spend) are the main measure of your success. The ideal candidate is a commercial storyteller first: someone who instinctively understands hooks, cliffhangers, revenge payoffs, romance tension, and why a reader taps "unlock" on the next chapter. You are comfortable using AI as a creative partner, you know when to trust it and when to override it, and you are energized rather than intimidated by data. Key Responsibilities: Use AI story system to write complete short stories of roughly 20,000 words, from title and logline through final chapter, delivered on schedule. Develop stories from a wide range of source material, including one-line ideas, trending topics, web novels, user-generated content, and existing hit stories. Approve story direction at each checkpoint: genre track, core reader expectation, paywall placement, and chapter-by-chapter emotional pacing. Edit and polish AI drafts so the final prose is vivid, emotionally specific, consistent in voice, and free of generic or repetitive AI patterns. Write high-impact titles, loglines, opening hooks, and paywall moments designed to drive ad clicks and reader conversion. Review testing results for every story you deliver, utilize retest reports to diagnose what underperformed, and revise promising stories that fall short of targets. Track your own story performance and apply what you learn to each new title. Stay current on trending tropes, hit stories, and reader tastes across short fiction, web novels, and short-form video drama, and bring new story ideas to the team. How Success Is Measured: Test pass rate: the share of your stories that meet or beat performance benchmarks in live testing. Return on ad spend (ROAS): how efficiently your stories turn marketing spend into reader revenue. Reader conversion: how well your opening and paywall turn readers into paying readers. Output and turnaround: consistently delivering finished, test-ready stories on schedule. Revision impact: how much your rewrites improve the results of underperforming stories. Minimum of 2 years of writing experience in commercial fiction, such as serialized fiction, web novels, Wattpad, Kindle Vella, romance publishing, short drama scripts, or a similar medium. A portfolio that shows strong commercial instincts: fast-paced plotting, emotional payoffs, and hooks that keep readers turning pages. Strong command of romance, revenge, family drama, and suspense, including popular tropes and what readers expect from them. Hands-on experience using AI writing tools (ChatGPT, Claude, or similar) in a real writing workflow. Excellent editing skills and the judgment to spot and fix flat, clichéd, or illogical AI output. Comfort with a results-driven environment where performance data shapes priorities and compensation. Ability to read and act on basic performance metrics (click-through rate, conversion, ROAS). Comfortable writing young adult and adult romance and drama, which may include sensitive and triggering content. Native or near-native English writing ability for English-speaking Western readers. Strong attention to detail, self-direction, and the ability to manage multiple stories at once under deadline. Flexibility to work across different time zones and communicate clearly in a remote team. Eagerness to learn and thrive in a fast-paced startup environment. Nice to Have: Experience writing for pay-per-chapter apps or short-form video drama platforms. A track record of stories or titles with measurable commercial results (reads, rankings, sales, or conversion). Experience writing ad copy, hooks, or marketing content for fiction. Bachelor's degree in Creative Writing, English, Journalism, Film, or a related field. Compensation: $3,000. This is an independent contractor (1099) position with an initial one-month term. Improved conversion throughout the funnel—from targeted outreach and conversations to meetings held, qualified opportunities and pipeline created. Strong enterprise account coverage and effective SDR and Account Executive collaboration. Reliable forecasting, trusted dashboards, and consistent CRM and process adoption. Strong SDR ramp, engagement, retention, performance development, and promotion readiness. Effective cross-functional execution with Marketing, Sales and Revenue Operations. COMPENSATION & BENEFITS Salary Range: Base Salary Range $130,000 - $145,000 + Bonus + Stock Equity At Legion, we offer competitive compensation and benefits packages to all employees. As a fully remote employer, pay for positions is determined using local, national, and industry-specific survey data. Our posted salary range is done so in good faith based on national data and may be refined for a candidate's region/town/cost of living. We strive to make competitive offers that allow employees room for future growth. Salaries will be based on the applicant’s location, level of experience, education, and specialized knowledge and skills. Additionally, we consider the external market rate, the amount we have budgeted internally, and the internal equity for the same position within the company. Benefits include, but are not limited to: $0 monthly premium and other flexible medical, dental, and vision plans effective on the first day of employment 401k plan Discretionary Paid Time Off and Paid Holidays Parental Leave Equity Monthly Wellness Reimbursement Monthly Lunch on Legion ABOUT LEGION Join Legion's mission to turn hourly jobs into good jobs. We're a remote, mission-driven team seeking exceptional talent to propel this vision. Embrace a culture that's collaborative, fast-paced, and entrepreneurial. With us, you'll grow your skills, work closely with experienced executives, and contribute significantly to our mission. Legion Technologies delivers the industry’s most innovative workforce management platform. It enables businesses to maximize labor efficiency and employee engagement simultaneously. The award-winning, AI-driven Legion WFM platform is intelligent, automated, and employee-centric. It’s proven to deliver 13x ROI through schedule optimization, reduced attrition, increased productivity, and increased operational efficiency. Legion delivers cutting-edge technology in an easy-to-use platform and mobile app that employees love. If you're ready to make an impact and grow your career, Legion is where you belong. Join us in making hourly work rewarding and fulfilling. BACKGROUND AND OPPORTUNITY There are almost 75 million hourly workers in the United States, representing more than half of the entire workforce. Historically, managing hourly employees has been difficult due to high attrition (average of 60%) and high replacement costs (average of $3,200 per employee in retail). The ongoing labor shortage and competition from the gig economy make it more difficult to attract and retain hourly employees. The top reasons hourly employees leave their jobs are a lack of schedule empowerment, poor communication with employers, and an inability to get paid early. Gen Z and the millennial workforce demand gig-like flexibility, modern technology, and compelling work options. Legion’s mission is to turn hourly jobs into good jobs, serving the hourly workers who make up the majority of the US workforce. We believe in empowering employees and helping employers be efficient and innovative by enabling intelligent automation powered by Legion’s Workforce Management platform to optimize labor efficiency and enhance the employee experience simultaneously. Legion WFM was built for the cloud with AI at the core and designed to handle the complexity of modern businesses and meet the needs of today’s hourly employees. Our team is comprised of dedicated individuals from all backgrounds and experiences, globally distributed across all time zones. For more information, visit https://legion.co EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY Legion Technologies is proud to be an equal-opportunity employer and is committed to maintaining a diverse and inclusive work environment. items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: Remote, Germany Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI. At our core is the Celonis Context Model — which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence into a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can actually understand, turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. World's leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. We believe there's a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet. The Team: Celonis grew up with the private sector: Deutsche Telekom, Mercedes-Benz, Uniper and three quarters of the DAX companies rely on Celonis Process Intelligence. Now we are taking the next big step in Germany: scaling our business with the public sector. To make this happen, Celonis is investing heavily through 2029 in its German public sector business. Over the past year, we have built our Public Sector team from the ground up. Today, a strong go-to-market core team of Account Executives and Value Engineers is in place, working with federal and state-level institutions. The Bundeswehr is one of our primary target organizations in the public sector. With our Celonis for Defense & Security initiative, presented at the Munich Security Conference 2026, we offer a sovereign and trusted platform that integrates data across systems and optimizes military processes along the entire value chain. This means higher operational readiness through optimized logistics and faster maintenance, repair and overhaul (MRO) cycles, greater resilience through end-to-end supply chain transparency, and faster IT modernization by connecting existing systems with modern AI applications. Building on our data analysis solution Metropolis , we also help connect information from a wide range of sources into a comprehensive situational picture , enabling faster and better-informed decisions during the actual mission . To drive this forward, we are now complementing our existing Public Sector team with a highly specialized Account Executive who brings first-hand experience from inside the organization we serve: the Bundeswehr . The Role: This is not a typical Account Executive role. You bring the perspective of someone who knows the Bundeswehr from the inside: how its structures work, how processes in logistics, maintenance or procurement really run, and how decisions are made and budgets are approved. You will use this credibility to build trusted relationships across the Bundeswehr and the defense ecosystem, and to position Celonis as a long-term partner for its digital transformation. Working closely with our Public Sector AEs, Value Engineers and product experts, you will translate the operational reality of the armed forces into compelling use cases, contribute to the creation of solution blueprints, drive opportunities from first conversation to signed contract, and help shape how Celonis enters and grows in this market. The Work you'll do: Build and own relationships across the Bundeswehr – Army (Heer), Navy (Marine), Air Force (Luftwaffe) and Cyber and Information Domain Service (CIR) – and its ecosystem, e.g. the Federal Ministry of Defence (BMVg), the Federal Office of Bundeswehr Equipment, Information Technology and In-Service Support (BAAINBw) and BWI GmbH. Engage with decision-makers from leadership, logistics, procurement, IT and digitalization. Translate operational challenges into concrete, AI-enabled use cases with measurable impact, e.g. in logistics and supply, MRO and materiel readiness, supply chain resilience, procurement and IT modernization. Bring the voice of the Bundeswehr into Celonis: share insights with our product, marketing and value engineering teams to sharpen our offering. Own an individual revenue target and drive complex, long sales cycles to a successful close. Navigate defense procurement and tender processes (e.g. VSVgV, framework agreements) together with our partners and internal experts. Work closely with partners such as consulting firms, system integrators and defense IT providers. Represent Celonis at public sector and defense events and conferences. The Qualifications you need: Several years of professional experience within the Bundeswehr , e.g. as an officer or civilian employee, ideally in a leadership role and/or in logistics, procurement, IT, digitalization, planning or organizational development. A solid network within the Bundeswehr and a deep understanding of its organization, decision-making and budget and planning processes (e.g. the procurement process CPM). First-hand understanding of the process and data challenges in areas such as logistics, materiel readiness, maintenance or procurement. A strong interest in moving into a commercial, customer-facing role. Prior experience in sales, business development or consulting is a plus, but not a must. We will support your onboarding into the sales role. Strong affinity for technology, data and AI, and the ability to explain complex topics in a simple and convincing way. Degree in Technology & Management, Industrial/Business Engineering, Business Informatics, Computer Science, Mathematics, Economics or a comparable degree program Grit, a hands-on mindset, and the drive to build something new. Excellent communication and presentation skills in German (native or fluent) and English. Familiarity with defense procurement processes is a strong plus. Willingness and eligibility to undergo a security clearance (Sicherheitsüberprüfung) if required by our customers. Ability to adapt to a fast-moving, high-growth environment and approach challenges with positivity, creative thinking and a growth mindset. Willingness to be collaborative and inclusive, to embrace diversity, and strong interpersonal skills #differentmakesusbetter Ability to leverage internal resources and work as a team #bestteamwins #LI-SS6 What Celonis can offer you: Pioneer Innovation: Work with the global leader in Process Mining and the Process Intelligence Graph to shape the future of AI-driven business operations. Ownership from Day 1: Every full-time "Celonaut" is an owner, receiving Restricted Stock Units (RSUs) and merit-based refresh grants. Unrivaled Family Support: Benefit from our inclusive parental leave policy—24 weeks of fully paid leave for primary carers and 12 weeks for supporting carers, available from your first day of employment. Work-Life Integration: Enjoy Unlimited PTO (in applicable regions) and generous PTO globally, as well as a flexible hybrid work model that balances remote focus with vibrant office collaboration. Continuous Growth: Elevate your skills through our 70-20-10 learning framework, mentorship programs, and access to a dedicated learning platform. Holistic Well-being: Prioritize your health with subsidized Wellhub memberships, mental health counseling, and dedicated "Wellness Weeks" that prioritize work/life balance. Drive Sustainability: Participate in annual Impact Days, where you receive paid time off to volunteer for community and environmental causes with your local office, or virtually. Global Inclusion & Belonging: Find community through our Inclusion Think Tank and participate in our annual Inclusion Days, ensuring every voice is heard and valued. Value-Driven Impact: Join a mission-led organization where our core values—Live for Customer Value, The Best Team Wins, We Own It, and Earth Is Our Future—drive every decision. About Us: Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI, empowering organizations to analyze, design, and operate AI-driven processes. The Celonis Platform is powered by the Celonis Context Model, which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence to create a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can understand — turning AI’s operational blind spots into operational clarity. Industry-leading companies around the world trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. Celonis is headquartered in Munich, Germany, and New York City, USA, with more than 20 offices worldwide. Get familiar with the Celonis Process Intelligence Platform by watching this video . Celonis Inclusion Statement: At Celonis, we believe our people make us who we are and that “The Best Team Wins”. We know that the best teams are made up of people who bring different perspectives to the table. And when everyone feels included, able to speak up and knows their voice is heard - that's when creativity and innovation happen. Your Privacy: Any information you submit to Celonis as part of your application will be processed in accordance with Celonis’ Accessibility and Candidate Notices By submitting this application, you confirm that you agree to the storing and processing of your personal data by Celonis as described in our Privacy Notice for the Application and Hiring Process . Use of Artificial Intelligence Tools We rely on an artificial intelligence tool to match the information from your resume to the relevant Celonis job descriptions. This processing is limited to the information provided in your resume or in your candidate profile. The tool produces a match score per candidate for a role, suggests preliminary ranking, and provides recommendations. The tool is only used for support in parts of the job application process, including to facilitate the identification of the relevant Celonis Jobs for candidates and recruiters. All final decisions are made by hiring managers and the Celonis talent acquisition team. Hiring managers and HR specialists use this tool responsibly, are aware of the risk of potential bias, and are equipped to mitigate it. Please be aware of common job offer scams, impersonators and frauds. Learn more here . To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/celonis-account-executive-public-sector-germany-defense-bundeswehr

items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: Remote (USA) WHO WE ARE Glossier is a people-powered ecosystem, brought to life by engaging online and offline experiences. In 12 years, we have built an iconic brand that goes far beyond beauty. Our brand is built on trusted emotional connection, empathy, and consistency in how we show up for people every day. We are woven into everyday moments of people’s lives, becoming part of their routines, their self-expression, and their confidence. We are defined not just by what we make, but by how we make people feel and the relationships we build over time. Our north-star values are to be Human, Curious, Playful, and Helpful. We are driven by a shared mission to become the Most Loved Lifestyle Brand in the World. THE ROLE Glossier is seeking a senior brand consultant to help accelerate the brand's cultural & PR relevance, creator ecosystem, and breakthrough marketing initiatives during a pivotal period of growth and evolution. This is not a traditional influencer marketing or PR role. We are looking for a strategic, creatively minded marketer with exceptional cultural instincts, deep relationships across creators, talent, and emerging cultural communities, and a track record of turning ambitious brand ideas into meaningful cultural moments. Working closely with the CMO and cross-functional marketing leadership, this person will bring an outside-in perspective, fresh thinking, and an entrepreneurial approach to building brand heat, relevance, and advocacy. The immediate focus will be an upcoming launch, alongside longer-term brand-first opportunities. Key Areas of Focus New Launch: Develop and help activate an earned-first cultural amplification strategy that extends the launch beyond traditional product marketing. Identify unexpected creators, talent, cultural partners, and communities that can bring the campaign to life in distinctive ways. Originate high-impact brand moments, partnerships, and activations designed to drive conversation, organic advocacy, and cultural relevance. Lead press strategy in partnership with external agency partners Collaborate with Brand Marketing, Influencer, PR, Social, and Creative teams to integrate opportunities into the broader launch plan. Creator & Cultural Ecosystem Help build Glossier's approach to creators and influencers beyond transactional partnerships toward meaningful, sustained brand relationships. Identify emerging cultural voices and tastemakers across beauty, fashion, art, music, lifestyle, and adjacent communities. Develop opportunities for creator-led storytelling, organic advocacy, and innovative collaborations that reinforce Glossier's unique place in culture. Partner with the existing influencer team to elevate strategic thinking and unlock new opportunities. Brand-First Marketing & Narrative Partner with CMO on reinforcing Brand Narrative Collaborate with the CMO and Brand Marketing leadership to identify opportunities for Glossier to show up in culture beyond traditional product launches. Develop compelling ideas for cultural collaborations, community initiatives, and brand platforms that deepen emotional connection with consumers. Explore how Glossier's flagship stores can become meaningful cultural and community destinations through relevant partnerships and programming. Bring fresh inspiration, emerging trends, and outside perspectives to challenge conventional beauty marketing approaches. Compensation for the role will be determined based on permissible, nondiscriminatory factors such as a candidate’s qualifications, skills, and experience. Click here to view the candidate privacy policy under FAQs We are an Equal Employment Opportunity (“EEO”) Employer. It has been and will continue to be a fundamental policy of Glossier not to discriminate on the basis of race, color, creed, religion, gender, gender identity, pregnancy, marital status, partnership status, domestic violence victim status, sexual orientation, age, national origin, alienage or citizenship status, veteran or military status, disability, medical condition, genetic information, caregiver status, unemployment status or any other characteristic prohibited by federal, state and/or local laws. This policy applies to all aspects of employment, including hiring, promotion, demotion, compensation, training, working conditions, transfer, job assignment, benefits, layoff, and termination. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/glossier-senior-brand-consultant-pr-influencer-contractor

items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: Indonesia URL: https://jobs.workable.com/company/3k8LqqAdNwD4WEpupmsk52/jobs-at-mash Location: Malaysia preferred Format: 12-month fixed-term contract Market: Japan Experience: 1–3 years Language: Fluent Japanese and professional English We’re looking for a driven Japanese-speaking Sales Development Representative to support the growth of a publisher acquisition programme across Japan. This role focuses on identifying and qualifying prospective partners, building relationships within the local app developer, gaming and web publisher community, and creating opportunities for the wider sales team. You’ll combine research, outreach and relationship-building with a strong understanding of the local market. You’ll be comfortable starting conversations, learning how digital businesses generate revenue, and helping prospective partners understand the value of digital advertising and monetisation solutions. This is a great opportunity for someone with 1–3 years of early-career sales or business development experience who wants to build their career within technology, apps, gaming and digital advertising. Lead Generation & Qualification Research prospective app developers, gaming studios, web publishers and digital businesses across Japan using Salesforce, Google Play Store, App Store, market intelligence platforms, industry events and networking. Qualify leads using agreed criteria and relevant business and app metrics, including downloads, active users, revenue and growth potential. Build and maintain an organised pipeline of prospects, keeping lead status and activity accurate in Salesforce. Stay close to local market developments and identify emerging businesses, trends and opportunities worth pursuing. Outreach & Relationship Building Execute targeted outreach through email, phone, social media, events and community engagement. Build relationships with prospective publishers and developers and understand their business, growth priorities and monetisation needs. Communicate relevant programme and product value propositions clearly and confidently. Support publishers in understanding digital advertising and monetisation solutions and connect them with the right internal expertise where required. Build credibility within Japan's app developer, gaming and publisher communities through thoughtful and culturally appropriate engagement. Sales & Market Support Schedule and coordinate qualified meetings between prospective partners and the wider sales team. Support preparation for prospect meetings and presentations by gathering relevant company, market and performance information. Track outreach activity, meetings, pipeline progress and conversion in Salesforce. Share recurring prospect feedback, local-market insights and emerging opportunities with regional stakeholders. Support relevant industry events, networking opportunities and partner engagement initiatives. About You Ideally 1–3 years of experience in B2B sales, sales development, business development, partnerships or another client-facing commercial role. Fluent Japanese with strong written and verbal communication skills, alongside professional working English. Strong understanding of Japanese business culture and the confidence to engage professionally with local stakeholders. Curious about technology, apps, gaming, digital advertising and the wider publisher ecosystem. Strong research skills with the ability to identify promising businesses and assess commercial opportunities. Confident starting conversations with prospective clients and developing relationships over time. Comfortable working with data and using simple insights to support outreach and commercial conversations. Organised and detail-oriented, with the ability to manage multiple prospects, follow-ups and priorities. Proactive, self-motivated and eager to learn. Experience with Salesforce or another CRM is useful. Previous experience within technology, apps, gaming, AdTech, media or digital businesses is valuable but not essential. Please note Due to the high volume of applications, we unfortunately can’t get back to every one of you, and only successful applicants will be contacted. When you share your details with us, we consider this as consent for us to use your data during the application process. We may implement AI in various stages of the recruitment process, but human involvement will always remain as part of our hiring ethos. At the moment, MASH is not in a position to sponsor work visas, so you have to be eligible to legally work in the country where we’re hiring. items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: Karnataka, India URL: https://jobs.workable.com/company/2NbDRiTU8do3haEgHLjLGC/jobs-at-lokal-app Role - Video Editor Work Location - Work From Home About Lokal : In 2018, we began with a WhatsApp group with a simple hypothesis: people in tier-2/3 towns weren’t really using the internet meaningfully yet. We believed that if we started with local content in their own language, they’d come back every day; once there was a habit and trust, that same space could naturally grow into classifieds and, eventually, something they used for almost everything online.This spark became Lokal. Our first instinct was to put everything in one place & one app - local updates, classifieds, jobs, matrimony and more. It worked, till it stopped working. Users gave us the insight - when one use case outweighs the others, everything else seems like noise. We listened. Like how Craigslist quietly seeded a generation of focused companies & marketplaces, we began unbundling and verticalising. Today, Lokal is a house of focused apps, many products, one mission: to connect Tier-2/3+ India to the Knowledge, opportunities, tools and experts they’ve always deserved.We now operate dozens of live apps across categories like: Edutainment & Skill Learning – practical skills and learning in regional languages (GyanTV) Matrimonial Matchmaking – hyperlocal, compatibility-first partner search (Lokal Matrimony) Agri Consulting – farmer-first advisory in local languages (AgriLokal) Local Jobs – blue- and grey-collar opportunities close to home (Lokal Jobs, Sahi Jobs) Social & Community – Place to find & post social updates (Lokal app) Emotional Well-being & Peer Support – safe spaces to talk and feel heard (Dostt & Eaze) Astrology & Guidance – instant access to trusted Astrologers via chat and voice (AstroLokal) Advisory Services – early bets in legal help, financial guidance, career counselling, and more Under the hood, Lokal is a discovery and access platform: local-language internet + deep Bharat insight+ AI. When someone opens a product we’ve built, they don’t wade through clutter; they get a straight line to what they came for.This is the story new teammates walk into: a company that started as a whatsapp group, became a family of focused apps, and kept one belief at the centre — access changes lives.We ship fast. We learn fast. We build for Bharat.We are backed by leading global and domestic investors including Y Combinator, Sony, Global Brain, India Quotient, and 3one4 Capital About the role : We are looking for a highly creative and skilled Video Editor to join the marketing/product team of Lokal. The role involves crafting short-form and mid-length video content such as social media reels, promos, and branded content. The candidate will leverage storytelling, editing trends, and cultural nuances to produce videos that drive engagement and impact. Key Responsibilities: ● Edit short-form and mid-length videos such as reels, social media ads, promos, and content explainers. ● Implement engaging hooks, dynamic pacing, and a strong narrative rhythm to maximize viewer retention. ● Tailor editing styles to suit platform-specific behaviors (e.g., fast cuts for Instagram, scroll-stopping openers for YouTube Shorts). ● Enhance video quality through thoughtful color grading, text animations, transitions, and immersive sound design. ● Collaborate closely with writers, designers, and creative leads to bring scripts and visual concepts to life. ● Stay updated on current editing trends, meme formats, cultural references, and audio trends to keep content fresh and relatable. ● Analyze ad performance metrics and apply learnings to improve edits for better click-through and completion rates. ● Edit videos in the required languages, ensuring linguistic accuracy, cultural relevance, and strong storytelling for the target audience. What You’ll Bring ● 1–2 years of experience in video editing for social media or digital content. ● Proficiency in editing software like Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects, Final Cut Pro, or similar. ● Any Bachelor’s degree. ● Strong portfolio of short-form content (reels, ads, promos). ● Good understanding of social platform algorithms and engagement tactics. ● Strong storytelling instincts, visual creativity, and sound design skills. ● Language proficiency: Strong command over two languages minimum — English and TTMK— both written and spoken, to bring cultural nuance and flexibility in writing. ● Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, collaborative environment with tight deadlines ● Must bring their own laptop to perform day-to-day tasks. Why This Role Is Exciting : ● Create high-impact video content that drives engagement and brand growth. ● Collaborate with cross-functional creative and marketing teams. ● Shape storytelling across platforms with visible, meaningful impact. Why Join Us: ● Create impactful video content ● Competitive pay and growth opportunities ● Work with a creative, fast-moving team We’ll Get Along If You… ● Take ownership of your edits and creative output ● Enjoy storytelling and visual creativity ● Are comfortable with fast-paced timelines and feedback ● Believe in learning, experimenting, and continuous improvement We’ll Get Along If You… ● Take ownership of your edits and creative output ● Enjoy storytelling and visual creativity ● Are comfortable with fast-paced timelines and feedback ● Believe in learning, experimenting, and continuous improvement To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/lokal-app-video-editor-ttmk-eaze
